### [129] [Leakage Safe Graph Features for Interpretable Fraud Detection in Temporal Transaction Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06632)
*Hamideh Khaleghpour,Brett McKinney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一套"时间尊重(时序因果)、防泄漏"的有向交易网络图特征提取协议：在每个时间步 t 只用截至 t 观测到的边构建历史子图 G≤t 计算节点结构描述子(度数、PageRank、HITS hub/authority、k-core、邻域度数统计、两跳可达性，并做 log(1+x) 稳定化),再与交易级属性融合,用类别加权的随机森林在严格按时间切分(Elliptic 数据集,训练 t≤34、验证 35–41、测试 t≥42)下训练与评估。最终测试期 ROC-AUC≈0.853、AP≈0.537;消融显示交易属性占主导(T 单独 0.847/0.537,纯图 0.562/0.049,混合 0.853/0.537),图特征增量有限但提供可解释的网络风险上下文;并通过混淆矩阵、Precision@K、阈值权衡、校准曲线与 Brier 分数评估操作效用,校准显著改善概率可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融与加密货币的非法交易往往表现为网络层面的结构性特征——高度连接的中介节点、异常中心性模式、协同的邻域团伙与异常多跳可达性,单笔交易属性难以暴露这类行为。已有的图方法(尤其是 GNN)在时间型交易图上存在关键方法论风险:若在完整图上计算图特征,会隐含使用预测时刻之后的边,造成"前视偏差(look-ahead bias)",导致评估指标虚高、与真实部署表现脱节。同时,深度图模型计算开销大、可解释性弱,难以满足调查与合规场景的透明性要求。因此需要一个既时序严格、可解释、可审计,又能支持实际风控排查工作流的图特征构建与评估流程。

Method: 1) 数据与任务:使用 Elliptic 数据集,节点为交易(含匿名属性向量),有向边为资金流向;标签分 licit/illicit/unknown,仅在已标注样本上建模;任务为二分类 y∈{0,1}。2) 图构建:每个时间步构建有向交易图 Gt=(Vt,Et),对 k-core 与邻居度数等无向拓扑特征另取无向投影 Gt(u)。3) 结构特征:入度/出度/总度,PageRank,HITS hub 与 authority,无向投影上的 k-core,邻居度数均值与最大值,两跳可达性代理;对重尾特征施加 log(1+x) 变换。4) 因果特征提取(核心创新):定义历史子图 G≤t=(V≤t,E≤t),仅含 t 时刻及之前观测到的边,t 时刻交易的图特征在 G≤t 上计算,从而阻断未来边泄漏;节点缺失时补零。5) 建模:随机森林 + 类别加权(应对严重不平衡),对比三种特征配置 T / G / T+G,验证集做超参、阈值与校准拟合,测试集仅用于最终报告。6) 评估指标:ROC-AUC、Average Precision、阈值处混淆矩阵与 precision/recall/F1 权衡曲线、Precision@K(受限于人工排查预算的排序告警效用)、校准曲线与 Brier 分数(sigmoid 与 isotonic 后验校准)、置换重要性与特征-标签 Pearson 相关性。7) 可复现性:固定随机种子、统一特征列顺序。

Result: 类别分布(仅已标注):训练 26,432 合法/3,462 非法,验证 7,154/675,测试 8,433/408;非法率随时间下降,存在时序分布漂移。混合模型在验证集 ROC-AUC 0.977、AP 0.925,测试期降至 ROC-AUC 0.853、AP 0.537,仍显著优于随机水平。消融:仅交易属性 0.847/0.537,仅图特征 0.562/0.049(接近随机),混合 0.853/0.537 —— 图特征对判别力的边际增益几乎为零,但仍能提供中心性、hub/authority、密集邻域等可解释网络上下文。阈值行为呈典型权衡:阈值升高(示例 0.80,偏精确率)假阳性下降、假阴性上升;Precision@K 与 PR 曲线刻画告警预算有限下的排序质量;校准后可靠性图显示预测概率与经验频率对齐更好,Brier 分数下降,判别力基本未受损。置换重要性与相关性分析显示交易级特征占据首位,图特征多位于后段。

Conclusion: 严格的时间尊重(因果)图特征提取协议是时间型交易图建模的可行实践:它避免前视偏差,使评估结果反映真实部署条件下对未来未见时段的外推能力(测试 ROC-AUC≈0.85、AP≈0.54)。在 Elliptic 基准上,交易级属性仍是主导预测信号,手工结构描述符的判别增量有限,因此图特征的主要价值在于可解释性——为已标记交易提供网络位置、邻域可达性与中心性方面的风险上下文,支撑分析师推理与调查工作流;配合概率校准,输出风险分数的可靠性得以提升,便于基于阈值的分诊决策。论文强调阈值应由运营约束与风险容忍度驱动,而非跨时段固定。未来工作方向:(i) 时序图神经网络等更具表达力的图表示;(ii) 学习能刻画超越手工描述符的高阶协同子结构的特征;(iii) 域自适应训练以缓解时序分布漂移;(iv) 在真实分析师预算下用成本敏感指标与决策论阈值选择进行评估。

Abstract: Illicit transaction detection is often driven by transaction level attributes however, fraudulent behavior may also manifest through network structure such as central hubs, high flow intermediaries, and coordinated neighborhoods. This paper presents a time respecting, leakage safe (causal) graph feature extraction protocol for temporal transaction networks and evaluates its utility for illicit entity classification. Using the Elliptic dataset, we construct directed transaction graphs and compute interpretable structural descriptors, including degree statistics, PageRank, HITS hub or authority scores, k-core indices, and neighborhood reachability measures. To prevent look ahead bias, we additionally compute causal variants of graph features using only edges observed up to each timestep. A Random Forest classifier trained with strict temporal splits achieves strong discrimination on a held out future test period (ROC-AUC about 0.85, Average Precision about 0.54). Although transaction attributes remain the dominant predictive signal, graph derived features provide complementary interpretability and enable risk context analysis for investigation workflows. We further assess operational utility using Precision at k and evaluate probability reliability via calibration curves and Brier scores, showing that calibrated models yield better aligned probabilities for triage. Overall, the results support causal graph feature extraction as a practical and interpretable augmentation for temporal fraud detection pipelines.

</details>


### [130] [A new Uncertainty Principle in Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06634)
*V. Dolotin,A. Morozov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper argues that ML optimization problems stem from a fundamental physics phenomenon - an uncertainty principle for sigmoid/Heaviside expansions - which explains why gradient descent gets trapped in local minima and cannot find global optima.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The motivation is to explain why standard ML optimization (steepest descent) gets trapped at local minima far from the true minimum - a problem that standard software tries to solve empirically with random restarts.

Method: The paper uses theoretical analysis, drawing parallels between ML optimization dynamics and physics phenomena, specifically framing the optimization landscape problem as an uncertainty principle.

Result: The result is a new formulation of the uncertainty principle that applies to sigmoid functions, showing that sharper minima require smoother optimization landscapes (canyons), making true optimization impossible.

Conclusion: The paper concludes that ML optimization problems are fundamentally physics problems, not CS problems, and that the uncertainty principle extends beyond Fourier/wavelet analysis to a new class of nearly singular sigmoid functions.

Abstract: Many scientific problems in the context of machine learning can be reduced to the search of polynomial answers in appropriate variables. The Hevisidization of arbitrary polynomial is actually provided by one-and-the same two-layer expression. What prevents the use of this simple idea is the fatal degeneracy of the Heaviside and sigmoid expansions, which traps the steepest-descent evolution at the bottom of canyons, close to the starting point, but far from the desired true minimum. This problem is unavoidable and can be formulated as a peculiar uncertainty principle -- the sharper the minimum, the smoother the canyons. It is a direct analogue of the usual one, which is the pertinent property of the more familiar Fourier expansion. Standard machine learning software fights with this problem empirically, for example, by testing evolutions, originated at randomly distributed starting points and then selecting the best one. Surprisingly or not, phenomena and problems, encountered in ML application to science are pure scientific and belong to physics, not to computer science. On the other hand, they sound slightly different and shed new light on the well-known phenomena -- for example, extend the uncertainty principle from Fourier and, later, wavelet analysis to a new peculiar class of nearly singular sigmoid functions.

</details>


### [131] [Graph Property Inference in Small Language Models: Effects of Representation and Inference Strategy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06635)
*Michal Podstawski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究了小型指令微调语言模型如何从文本表示的图中推断图论属性，发现输入表示的组织方式和推理策略对结构化推理成功至关重要，而不仅仅取决于模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解有限容量的语言模型在文本形式呈现的关系结构中推断形式属性的有效性，以及结构化推理成功或失败的条件，这对于在基于图的领域中应用小型模型至关重要。

Method: 系统性地研究小型指令微调语言模型在图论属性推断方面的表现，隔离输入表示和推理策略的作用。测试了多种局部和全局图度量指标。

Result: 结构性能高度敏感于 relational信息的组织方式。保留邻域结构的表示能够改善估计稳定性和序贯一致性，多分支推理产生最可靠的聚合增益。

Conclusion: 图属性推理的成功取决于输入表示的组织方式和推理策略设计，而非仅由模型规模决定。保留邻域结构的表现更稳定，一致性更好；多分支推理在各种配置下能产生最可靠的聚合增益。这些发现为在有限模型容量下改进结构化推理提供了实用杠杆。

Abstract: Recent progress in language modeling has expanded the range of tasks that can be approached through natural language interfaces, including problems that require structured reasoning. However, it remains unclear how effectively limited-capacity language models can infer formal properties of relational structures when those structures are presented in textual form. Understanding the conditions under which structured reasoning succeeds or fails is essential for applying small models in graph-based domains.
  We conduct a systematic study of graph-theoretic property inference in small instruction-tuned language models, isolating the roles of input representation and reasoning strategy. Across a diverse set of local and global graph metrics, we find that structural performance is highly sensitive to how relational information is organized. Representations that preserve neighborhood structure consistently improve estimation stability and ordinal consistency, while multi-branch reasoning yields the most reliable aggregate gains across configurations.
  These results show that graph property inference in small language models depends critically on representational organization and inference design. Structural competence is therefore shaped not only by model scale, but by how relational information is encoded and how predictions are elicited. The findings identify practical levers for improving structured inference under constrained model capacity.

</details>


### [132] [SmartBench: Evaluating LLMs in Smart Homes with Anomalous Device States and Behavioral Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06636)
*Qingsong Zou,Zhi Yan,Zhiyao Xu,Kuofeng Gao,Jingyu Xiao,Yong Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了SmartBench，这是首个为LLM设计的智能家居数据集，包含正常/异常设备状态及状态转换上下文。评估13个主流LLM发现当前模型在智能家居异常检测任务上表现不佳，Claude-Sonnet-4.5最高仅达66.1%准确率，表明基于LLM的智能家居助手在异常检测能力上仍有很大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注解读和执行用户行为或指令，但智能家居助手的关键功能之一是检测家居环境何时处于异常状态，这需要LLM准确判断是否存在异常条件并提供清晰解释或可操作建议

Method: 引入SmartBench基准数据集，包含正常和异常设备状态以及正常和异常设备状态转换上下文；对13个主流LLM进行评估测试

Result: 大多数最先进的模型无法实现良好的异常检测性能；Claude-Sonnet-4.5在上下文无关异常上准确率为66.1%，在上下文相关异常上仅为57.8%

Conclusion: 当前基于LLM的智能家居助手在异常检测方面表现不佳。最先进的模型如Claude-Sonnet-4.5在上下文无关异常类别上仅达到66.1%的检测准确率，在上下文相关异常上更是低至57.8%。实验表明，下一代基于LLM的智能家居助手距离有效检测和处理智能家居环境中的异常状态仍有较大差距。SmartBench数据集已公开可用。

Abstract: Due to the strong context-awareness capabilities demonstrated by large language models (LLMs), recent research has begun exploring their integration into smart home assistants to help users manage and adjust their living environments. While LLMs have been shown to effectively understand user needs and provide appropriate responses, most existing studies primarily focus on interpreting and executing user behaviors or instructions.
  However, a critical function of smart home assistants is the ability to detect when the home environment is in an anomalous state. This involves two key requirements: the LLM must accurately determine whether an anomalous condition is present, and provide either a clear explanation or actionable suggestions.
  To enhance the anomaly detection capabilities of next-generation LLM-based smart home assistants, we introduce SmartBench, which is the first smart home dataset designed for LLMs, containing both normal and anomalous device states as well as normal and anomalous device state transition contexts. We evaluate 13 mainstream LLMs on this benchmark. The experimental results show that most state-of-the-art models cannot achieve good anomaly detection performance. For example, Claude-Sonnet-4.5 achieves only 66.1% detection accuracy on context-independent anomaly categories, and performs even worse on context-dependent anomalies, with an accuracy of only 57.8%. More experimental results suggest that next-generation LLM-based smart home assistants are still far from being able to effectively detect and handle anomalous conditions in the smart home environment. Our dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/horizonsinzqs/SmartBench.

</details>


### [133] [HEARTS: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning on Health Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06638)
*Sirui Li,Shuhan Xiao,Mihir Joshi,Ahmed Metwally,Daniel McDuff,Wei Wang,Yuzhe Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HEARTS是一个统一基准，用于评估大型语言模型在健康时间序列上的分层推理能力。基准整合16个数据集、12个健康领域、20种信号模态和110个任务，涵盖感知、推理、生成、演绎四类核心能力。评估14个SOTA LLM后发现：LLM显著落后于专业模型，性能与一般推理能力弱相关，常依赖简单启发式方法，性能随时序复杂性增加而下降，表明单纯规模扩展不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅覆盖少量健康时间序列模态和任务，无法反映真实世界生理建模中固有的多样化领域和广泛时间依赖性。大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起已使时间序列分析从窄域分析转向通用推理，但缺乏全面评估LLM健康时间序列推理能力的标准化测试平台。

Method: 构建HEARTS统一基准，整合16个真实世界数据集（覆盖12个健康领域和20种信号模态），定义包含110个任务的综合分类法，划分为四个核心能力维度：感知、推理、生成和演绎。对14个SOTA LLM进行超过20K测试样本的评估。

Result: 1）LLM性能显著低于专业模型，且与一般推理分数仅弱相关；2）LLM常依赖简单启发式方法，在多步时间推理上存在困难；3）性能随时序复杂性增加而下降；4）同一模型家族内存在相似的失败模式。

Conclusion: HEARTS benchmark能够揭示当前LLM在健康时间序列推理方面的显著差距，为开发下一代能够推理多样化健康信号的新一代LLM agent提供标准化测试平台和动态基准。单纯通过模型规模扩展不足以解决这些问题。

研究团队构建了HEARTS（Health Reasoning over Time Series）统一基准，用于评估LLM在一般健康时间序列上的分层推理能力。该基准整合了12个健康领域和20种信号模态的16个真实数据集，定义了包含110个任务的综合分类法，涵盖四个核心能力：感知（Perception）、推理（Inference）、生成（Generation）和演绎（Deduction）。

对14个最先进的LLM在超过20K测试样本上的评估揭示了以下关键发现：1）LLM显著落后于专业模型，且其性能与一般推理分数仅弱相关；2）LLM通常依赖简单启发式方法，难以处理多步时间推理；3）性能随着时间复杂性的增加而下降，同一模型家族内存在相似的失败模式。这些发现表明，单纯扩大模型规模不足以解决这些问题。

Abstract: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has shifted time series analysis from narrow analytics to general-purpose reasoning. Yet, existing benchmarks cover only a small set of health time series modalities and tasks, failing to reflect the diverse domains and extensive temporal dependencies inherent in real-world physiological modeling. To bridge these gaps, we introduce HEARTS (Health Reasoning over Time Series), a unified benchmark for evaluating hierarchical reasoning capabilities of LLMs over general health time series. HEARTS integrates 16 real-world datasets across 12 health domains and 20 signal modalities, and defines a comprehensive taxonomy of 110 tasks grouped into four core capabilities: Perception, Inference, Generation, and Deduction. Evaluating 14 state-of-the-art LLMs on more than 20K test samples reveals intriguing findings. First, LLMs substantially underperform specialized models, and their performance is only weakly related to general reasoning scores. Moreover, LLMs often rely on simple heuristics and struggle with multi-step temporal reasoning. Finally, performance declines with increasing temporal complexity, with similar failure modes within model families, indicating that scaling alone is insufficient. By making these gaps measurable, HEARTS provides a standardized testbed and living benchmark for developing next-generation LLM agents capable of reasoning over diverse health signals.

</details>


### [134] [SR-TTT: Surprisal-Aware Residual Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06642)
*Swamynathan V P*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SR-TTT通过在TTT语言模型中引入损失门控的稀疏残差缓存机制，解决其在精确召回任务（如 Needle-in-a-Haystack）上的灾难性失败问题，同时保持O(1)内存复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTT语言模型使用隐藏状态"快速权重"替换标准精确注意力KV缓存，实现理论无限上下文窗口和O(1)内存占用。然而，快速权重将上下文压缩到信息瓶颈中，导致高度惊讶或独特的 tokens 被后续梯度更新迅速覆盖和遗忘，在精确召回任务上出现灾难性失败。

Method: SR-TTT（Surprisal-Aware Residual Test-Time Training）通过以下方式解决该问题：1) 动态路由仅将不可压缩的、高惊讶度的 tokens 路由到传统精确注意力的残差缓存；2) 对低熵背景上下文保持O(1)内存；3) 仅对关键"needle" tokens 使用精确注意力。

Result: SR-TTT能够在保持O(1)内存效率的同时，解决TTT在精确召回任务上的灾难性失败问题，实现对关键信息的精确回忆。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了TTT架构与精确注意力机制混合的可行性，为长上下文语言模型提供了新的设计思路，兼顾内存效率与精确召回能力。

Abstract: Test-Time Training (TTT) language models achieve theoretically infinite context windows with an O(1) memory footprint by replacing the standard exact-attention KV-cache with hidden state ``fast weights'' W_fast updated via self-supervised learning during inference. However, pure TTT architectures suffer catastrophic failures on exact-recall tasks (e.g., Needle-in-a-Haystack). Because the fast weights aggressively compress the context into an information bottleneck, highly surprising or unique tokens are rapidly overwritten and forgotten by subsequent token gradient updates. We introduce SR-TTT (Surprisal-Aware Residual Test-Time Training), which resolves this recall failure by augmenting the TTT backbone with a loss-gated sparse memory mechanism. By dynamically routing only incompressible, highly surprising tokens to a traditional exact-attention Residual Cache, SR-TTT preserves O(1) memory for low-entropy background context while utilizing exact attention exclusively for critical needles. Our complete implementation, training scripts, and pre-trained weights are open-source and available at: https://github.com/swamynathanvp/Surprisal-Aware-Residual-Test-Time-Training.

</details>


### [135] [Trust Aware Federated Learning for Secure Bone Healing Stage Interpretation in e-Health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06646)
*Paul Shepherd,Tasos Dagiuklas,Bugra Alkan,Joaquim Bastos,Jonathan Rodriguez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于信任感知的联邦学习框架，用于利用频谱特征解释骨愈合阶段。该框架通过自适应信任评分缩放和过滤（ATSSSF）机制评估、验证和过滤客户端贡献，以应对分布式医疗传感环境中的不可靠或对抗性参与者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决分布式医疗传感环境中不可靠或对抗性参与者带来的挑战，确保联邦学习在医学应用中的模型完整性和预测性能。

Method: 采用多层感知器模型，基于Flower联邦学习框架进行训练。集成ATSSSF机制和指数移动平均（EMA）平滑策略，评估客户端可信度。研究了两种信任评分平滑策略：固定因子和基于信任评分变异性的自适应策略。低信任客户端被排除在聚合之外，可靠性改善后可重新加入。

Result: 实验表明，自适应信任管理通过减轻受损客户端的负面影响，在保持检测能力的同时提高了训练稳定性和预测性能。

Conclusion: 验证了联邦医疗传感中自适应信任机制的可行性，为临床跨孤岛聚合的扩展应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: This paper presents a trust aware federated learning (FL) framework for interpreting bone healing stages using spectral features derived from frequency response data. The primary objective is to address the challenge posed by either unreliable or adversarial participants in distributed medical sensing environments. The framework employs a multi-layer perceptron model trained across simulated clients using the Flower FL framework. The proposed approach integrates an Adaptive Trust Score Scaling and Filtering (ATSSSF) mechanism with exponential moving average (EMA) smoothing to assess, validate and filter client contributions.Two trust score smoothing strategies have been investigated, one with a fixed factor and another that adapts according to trust score variability. Clients with low trust are excluded from aggregation and readmitted once their reliability improves, ensuring model integrity while maintaining inclusivity. Standard classification metrics have been used to compare the performance of ATSSSF with the baseline Federated Averaging strategy. Experimental results demonstrate that adaptive trust management can improve both training stability and predictive performance by mitigating the negative effects of compromised clients while retaining robust detection capabilities. The work establishes the feasibility for adaptive trust mechanisms in federated medical sensing and identifies extension to clinical cross silo aggregation as a future research direction.

</details>


### [136] [HURRI-GAN: A Novel Approach for Hurricane Bias-Correction Beyond Gauge Stations using Generative Adversarial Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06649)
*Noujoud Nadera,Hadi Majed,Stefanos Giaremis,Rola El Osta,Clint Dawson,Carola Kaiser,Hartmut Kaiser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HURRI-GAN 是一种基于 TimeGAN 的时空外推框架，可将基于物理模型（ADCIRC）的水位偏差（offset）校正场从有测站的位置外推到任意网格点/无测站区域，从而在不提高网格分辨率的前提下提升风暴潮预报精度并降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ADCIRC 等物理风暴潮模型在高分辨率下计算耗时巨大，难以满足应急响应者的近实时预报需求；模型系统性偏差（源自飓风路径/风速刻画误差、降雨与海洋大尺度运动等未解析驱动、海岸地形与土地利用描述不准）显著影响预报与风险评估。传统偏差订正方法（集合预报、数据同化、分位数映射等）难以给出全域连续订正场；已有机器学习方法（如该组此前的 LSTM 模型）只能在测站位置上预测偏差，无法覆盖无测站海域与内陆区域。因此需要一种能从有限测站学习"偏差时间序列—地理坐标"映射关系并在空间上外推的方法，以扩展预报的空间覆盖度与可靠性。

Method: 数据：来自 CERA 历史风暴潮档案（Historical Storm Surge Archive）的 6 个飓风（Matthew 2016 H4、Hermine 2016 H1、Harvey 2017 H4、Ida 2021 H4、Ian 2022 H5、Idalia 2023 H4），含 ADCIRC 模拟水位与 NOAA/USGS/USACE/TCOON/PRSN 观测水位（逐小时）。偏差定义 offset(t)=H_modeled−H_observed，剔除缺失与离群测站后每场风保留约 236–304 站、1.8万–3.2万小时偏差样本。流程三步：(A) 预处理——用此前 LSTM 模型生成各测站完整偏差信号，MinMax 归一化（训练/测试分开以避免泄漏），重塑为 5×21（Idalia 为 3×23）二维序列，batch=10；坐标 (x,y) 经 4 维静态嵌入并按时间步重复，与偏差矩阵拼接；(B) 建模——HURRI-GAN 骨干为 TimeGAN，含 embedder E、recovery R、supervisor S、generator G、discriminator D：E/R/G 的时间分支为 5 层 GRU(256)+Dense(21)+sigmoid，静态分支为 Dense(4)+sigmoid；S 层数少一；D 为 2 层 Bi-GRU(256)+Dense(1)。训练顺序为先自编码器、再 supervisor、最后联合训练，生成器/嵌入器更新频率高于判别器（判别器损失超阈值才更新），损失含对抗、supervisor 与分布项，判别器用 BCE，全部采用 Adam；(C) 外推与应用——推理时仅输入任意坐标即可生成偏差，校正水位 H_corrected=H_modeled−offset_generated。空间划分：对每个飓风按 K-means 依坐标聚类（簇数=测站数的 10%，每簇≥1 站），每簇随机取 1 站为测试、其余训练，保证 90/10 且测试点空间分散。评估指标为 MSE/RMSE/MAE，同时评估"真实 vs 外推偏差"和"原始预报 vs 校正预报"。超参对每个飓风单独调优（层数 4/5、神经元 128/256、epoch 2000/3000/4000）。实现为 TensorFlow 2.16.2/Keras、Python 3.9.18。

Result: 1) 前置 LSTM 偏差预测精度良好（RMSE 0.257–0.359 ft），可作为 HURRI-GAN 训练输入。2) 超参调优显示最优架构逐飓风不同，但 256 神经元、3000 epoch、4 或 5 层在多数风场最优，可作为新风暴的推荐配置。3) 外推性能：最优模型整体 RMSE 为 0.275 ft（Matthew, 0.083 m）至 0.654 ft（Ian, 0.199 m），多数测站 RMSE 低于 1.5 ft。4) 空间规律：飓风路径/登陆附近站点误差偏高（风暴潮动力学更复杂，如 Ida 路径上的 New Orleans）；USGS 站点误差普遍最高，因其多位于内陆河流或海岸特征复杂（堤坝、突堤）区域。5) 偏差订正效果：多数测试测站的校正后 RMSE 下降约 0.2–1.1 ft（0.06–0.33 m），且与飓风强度关系不大（H5 的 Ian 订正幅度略小）；对高受影响区（Hatteras）和轻影响区（Clearwater Beach）均能给出合理解订正。6) 推理效率：推理时间随坐标数呈近指数增长，10^5 个坐标需 5160 s（约 1 h 40 min），可通过并行化进一步压缩，在 6 小时一次的预报更新节奏下可接受。

Conclusion: HURRI-GAN 首次将 TimeGAN 用于风暴潮水位偏差的时空外推订正，证明可从有限测站学到"偏差序列—坐标"映射并在训练中未见的测站位置生成准确偏差（RMSE 约 0.3–0.65 ft），校正后预报在多数测试测站上 RMSE 明显下降，且推理开销可控，因而可作为与逐站偏差估计器（如 LSTM）串联的后处理组件嵌入实时预报框架（CERA 类系统），并有望在保持精度的前提下降低 ADCIRC 网格分辨率需求。局限与未来工作：飓风路径沿线、内陆或受细微海岸地形影响的站点表现较差；需引入更多风暴类型与地理区域的数据以提升稳健性；优化推理速度；并在业务化实时预报中验证实际效果。

Abstract: The coastal regions of the eastern and southern United States are impacted by severe storm events, leading to significant loss of life and properties. Accurately forecasting storm surge and wind impacts from hurricanes is essential for mitigating some of the impacts, e.g., timely preparation of evacuations and other countermeasures. Physical simulation models like the ADCIRC hydrodynamics model, which run on high-performance computing resources, are sophisticated tools that produce increasingly accurate forecasts as the resolution of the computational meshes improves. However, a major drawback of these models is the significant time required to generate results at very high resolutions, which may not meet the near real-time demands of emergency responders. The presented work introduces HURRI-GAN, a novel AI-driven approach that augments the results produced by physical simulation models using time series generative adversarial networks (TimeGAN) to compensate for systemic errors of the physical model, thus reducing the necessary mesh size and runtime without loss in forecasting accuracy. We present first results in extrapolating model bias corrections for the spatial regions beyond the positions of the water level gauge stations. The presented results show that our methodology can accurately generate bias corrections at target locations spatially beyond gauge stations locations. The model's performance, as indicated by low root mean squared error (RMSE) values, highlights its capability to generate accurate extrapolated data. Applying the corrections generated by HURRI-GAN on the ADCIRC modeled water levels resulted in improving the overall prediction on the majority of the testing gauge stations.

</details>


### [137] [Geodesic Gradient Descent: A Generic and Learning-rate-free Optimizer on Objective Function-induced Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06651)
*Liwei Hu,Guangyao Li,Wenyong Wang,Xiaoming Zhang,Yu Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出测地梯度下降（GGD）算法：用与目标函数诱导的超曲面在当前参数点相切的 n 维球面局部逼近该超曲面，将欧氏梯度导出的法向量与切向量分别用于确定球心与测地线方向，沿测地线终点更新参数。由于切向量范数被限制为球面弧长的四分之一（πR/2），GGD 无需学习率即完成参数更新，在 Burgers' 回归与 MNIST 分类任务上均优于 SGD、SGDM、Adam、Muon 和 SSGD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典欧氏梯度优化（SGD、AdaGrad、RMSProp、Adam、Muon）在参数空间仅利用梯度的一阶近似，既忽视目标函数所诱导的超曲面 M 的曲率、挠率等内蕴几何信息，其线性更新方向也通常不在切空间内，容易把更新轨迹"推离"超曲面。已有的黎曼梯度下降虽通过将欧氏梯度正交投影到切空间、再用指数映射/retraction 拉回 M 来保证轨迹留在线上，但前提是参数空间能由单一经典流形（如 SO(3)、Grassmann、球面）显式约束；而目标函数诱导的超曲面几何结构由网络参数、输入与目标函数共同决定，复杂且难以用单一经典流形刻画（如用球面约束的 SSGD 在 MNIST 上崩溃至 24%~89% 准确率）。因此需要一种能自适应任意复杂几何、且不依赖人工调学习率的通用黎曼优化器。

Method: 将目标函数 L(θ;x) 写成隐式形式 F = f(θ) − L = 0，把点 P_t = concat(θ_t, L(θ_t;x)) 视为 (n+1) 维超曲面上的点。算法每步迭代：(1) 计算欧氏梯度 g_t，令 n_t = concat(g_t, −1) 为超曲面在 P_t 处的法向量（由 ∇F 得到）；(2) 令 v_t = concat(g_t, ||g_t||²)，该向量与 n_t 正交，作为切向量（近似黎曼梯度）；(3) 构造与超曲面在 P_t 相切、半径为 R_t 的 n 维球，球心 C_t = P_t − R_t·n_t/||n_t||，并把 P_t 平移到以原点为心的球面；(4) 半径按径向基函数衰减 R_t = R_0·exp(−(t−μ)²/(2σ²))；(5) 将切向量按最大弧长缩放 v_t ← 0.5·π·R_t·v_t/||v_t||，使更新步长上限为球面弧长的四分之一，从而取消学习率；(6) 按 γ(s) = cos(||v_t s||/R_t)P_t + (R_t/||v_t||)sin(||v_t s||/R_t)v_t 计算测地线，取 s = 1 得终点 P_{t+1}，平移回原球面后取前 n 维分量作为新参数。作者指出一般也可换用其他曲面（如双曲面、Bézier 面），只要能导出其测地线方程。

Result: 回归实验（Burgers' 流场数据集，125,000 样本，t/x/v 为输入、u 为输出，含 3 个全连接网络 FCN_1~3）：GGD 的测试 MSE 相比 Adam 降低 35.79%~48.76%（FCN_1 训练/测试分别降 27.01%/48.76%；FCN_2 分别 −1.59%/40.59%；FCN_3 分别 74.40%/35.79%），且优于 SGD、SGDM、Muon、SSGD；验证曲线随网络加深波动更小、更稳定。分类实验（MNIST，3 个 CNN）：GGD 的交叉熵相比 Adam 降低 3.14%~11.59%（CNN_1 训练/测试降 11.49%/11.59%；CNN_2 降 12.12%/3.14%；CNN_3 降 28.07%/6.21%），准确率最高（99.04%/99.16%/99.30%），优于 Adam 的 98.85%/99.14%/99.20%，而 SSGD 准确率仅 89.12%/63.30%/24.27%。训练开销方面，GGD 随网络加深相对 Adam、Muon、SSGD 呈加速趋势（FCN_3 上 697.33s vs Adam 801.47s）。

Conclusion: GGD 是一种面向目标函数诱导流形的通用、无学习率的黎曼型优化器：用局部相切 n 维球面近似任意复杂超曲面，沿测地线更新以保持轨迹在曲面上，用球面四分之一弧长作为固定最大步长取代学习率，实验表明其在回归与分类任务上均取得更低误差与更高精度。作者同时明确指出局限：半径衰减所需的两个超参数 R_0 与 σ 目前只能凭经验调整，其确定原则尚未明确；未来有望由超曲面的曲率（可由欧氏梯度及其平方范数导出）直接推导半径衰减，从而实现完全无超参数的确定性下降算法。

Abstract: Euclidean gradient descent algorithms barely capture the geometry of objective function-induced hypersurfaces and risk driving update trajectories off the hypersurfaces. Riemannian gradient descent algorithms address these issues but fail to represent complex hypersurfaces via a single classic manifold. We propose geodesic gradient descent (GGD), a generic and learning-rate-free Riemannian gradient descent algorithm. At each iteration, GGD uses an n-dimensional sphere to approximate a local neighborhood on the objective function-induced hypersurface, adapting to arbitrarily complex geometries. A tangent vector derived from the Euclidean gradient is projected onto the sphere to form a geodesic, ensuring the update trajectory stays on the hypersurface. Parameter updates are performed using the endpoint of the geodesic. The maximum step size of the gradient in GGD is equal to a quarter of the arc length on the n-dimensional sphere, thus eliminating the need for a learning rate. Experimental results show that compared with the classic Adam algorithm, GGD achieves test MSE reductions ranging from 35.79% to 48.76% for fully connected networks on the Burgers' dataset, and cross-entropy loss reductions ranging from 3.14% to 11.59% for convolutional neural networks on the MNIST dataset.

</details>


### [138] [ERP-RiskBench: Leakage-Safe Ensemble Learning for Financial Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06671)
*Sanjay Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对ERP系统的财务风险检测重建实验框架，使用集成机器学习方法，结合梯度提升堆叠集成模型，在防止数据泄露的嵌套交叉验证下进行评估，并构建了综合基准数据集ERP-RiskBench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ERP系统中的财务风险检测是机器学习的重要应用但探索不足，现有研究存在数据集描述模糊、流水线易导致数据泄露、评估方法夸大性能等问题。

Method: 1)构建混合风险定义，覆盖采购合规异常和交易欺诈；2)组装复合基准ERP-RiskBench（公共采购事件日志、标记欺诈数据、新合成ERP数据集含规则注入风险类型和条件表格GAN增强）；3)使用时间感知和组感知的嵌套交叉验证防止数据泄露；4)使用梯度提升方法堆叠集成作为主模型；5)使用Matthews相关系数、精确率-召回率曲线下面积、校准概率的成本敏感决策分析进行评估；6)SHAP可解释性分析和特征稳定性分析。

Result: 堆叠集成模型获得最佳检测结果；防泄露协议显著降低了之前夸大的准确率估计；三方匹配差异等采购控制特征是最具信息量的预测因子。

Conclusion: 该框架为ERP审计和治理中的机器学习部署提供了可复现、操作可行的蓝图。

Abstract: Financial risk detection in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems is an important but underexplored application of machine learning. Published studies in this area tend to suffer from vague dataset descriptions, leakage-prone pipelines, and evaluation practices that inflate reported performance. This paper presents a rebuilt experimental framework for ERP financial risk detection using ensemble machine learning. The risk definition is hybrid, covering both procurement compliance anomalies and transactional fraud. A composite benchmark called ERP-RiskBench is assembled from public procurement event logs, labeled fraud data, and a new synthetic ERP dataset with rule-injected risk typologies and conditional tabular GAN augmentation. Nested cross-validation with time-aware and group-aware splitting enforces leakage prevention throughout the pipeline. The primary model is a stacking ensemble of gradient boosting methods, tested alongside linear baselines, deep tabular architectures, and an interpretable glassbox alternative. Performance is measured through Matthews Correlation Coefficient, area under the precision-recall curve, and cost-sensitive decision analysis using calibrated probabilities. Across multiple dataset configurations and a structured ablation study, the stacking ensemble achieves the best detection results. Leakage-safe protocols reduce previously inflated accuracy estimates by a notable margin. SHAP-based explanations and feature stability analysis show that procurement control features, especially three-way matching discrepancies, rank as the most informative predictors. The resulting framework provides a reproducible, operationally grounded blueprint for machine learning deployment in ERP audit and governance settings.

</details>


### [139] [One step further with Monte-Carlo sampler to guide diffusion better](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06685)
*Minsi Ren,Wenhao Deng,Ruiqi Feng,Tailin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ABMS方法，通过额外的反向去噪步骤和蒙特卡洛采样来解决基于SDE的生成模型在条件生成中后验采样估计误差过大的问题，该方法可作为即插即用的调整策略，配合高阶采样器使用，并在多种任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于SDE的生成模型通过训练无关的可微损失引导方法在条件生成中取得进展，但现有后验采样方法存在较大的估计误差，导致引导梯度不准确，生成结果不一致。

Method: 提出ABMS方法（额外的反向去噪步骤和蒙特卡洛采样），作为即插即用的调整策略；提供理论分析；提出双焦点评估框架以突出跨条件干扰问题。

Result: 在多种任务设置和数据类型上验证，包括条件在线手写轨迹生成、图像逆问题（修复、超分辨率、高斯去模糊）、分子逆设计等。实验表明该方法可与高阶采样器有效结合，在所有场景中持续提升生成样本质量。

Conclusion: ABMS方法能有效减少后验采样估计误差，提升条件生成的质量和一致性，为条件扩散模型提供了一种简单有效的改进方案。

Abstract: Stochastic differential equation (SDE)-based generative models have achieved substantial progress in conditional generation via training-free differentiable loss-guided approaches. However, existing methodologies utilizing posterior sam- pling typically confront a substantial estimation error, which results in inaccu- rate gradients for guidance and leading to inconsistent generation results. To mitigate this issue, we propose that performing an additional backward denois- ing step and Monte-Carlo sampling (ABMS) can achieve better guided diffu- sion, which is a plug-and-play adjustment strategy. To verify the effectiveness of our method, we provide theoretical analysis and propose the adoption of a dual-focus evaluation framework, which further serves to highlight the critical problem of cross-condition interference prevalent in existing approaches. We conduct experiments across various task settings and data types, mainly includ- ing conditional online handwritten trajectory generation, image inverse problems (inpainting, super resolution and gaussian deblurring) molecular inverse design and so on. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach can be effec- tively used with higher order samplers and consistently improves the quality of generation samples across all the different scenarios.

</details>


### [140] [Scaling Agentic Capabilities, Not Context: Efficient Reinforcement Finetuning for Large Toolspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06713)
*Karan Gupta,Pranav Vajreshwari,Yash Pandya,Raghav Magazine,Akshay Nambi,Ahmed Awadallah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATLAS是一个强化微调框架，使小型语言模型(SLM)能够在大型工具空间中有效运行，通过将上下文控制和执行结构作为可学习决策，并采用基于Rubric的强化微调方法分解任务成功标准，实现可扩展训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型工具生态系统中，SLM面临上下文饱和、执行错误累积和稀疏奖励等挑战，而前沿模型依赖大规模和长上下文预算。

Method: 1) 将上下文控制和执行结构视为可学习决策，结合迭代工具加载和程序化工具编排来约束上下文增长并稳定长 horizon 轨迹；2) 提出基于Rubric的强化微调方法，将任务成功分解为结构化、任务对齐的标准，使用小型评判模型实现可扩展训练。

Result: 在MCP基准测试中，这些设计选择产生了大幅且一致的提升，使4B SLM能够以更紧的参数和上下文预算接近前沿Agent性能。

Conclusion: ATLAS框架使4B SLM能够在有限参数和上下文预算下接近前沿Agent性能，在MCP基准测试中相比通用RL基线获得大幅且一致的提升。

Abstract: Agentic systems operating over large tool ecosystems must plan and execute long-horizon workflows under weak or non-verifiable supervision. While frontier models mitigate these challenges through scale and large context budgets, small language models (SLMs) remain brittle: eager tool loading saturates context, execution errors compound over time, and sparse rewards limit learning. We introduce ATLAS, a reinforcement finetuning framework that enables SLMs to operate effectively in large-scale toolspace environments by learning how to acquire context and how to execute actions. Our approach makes two key contributions. First, we treat context control and execution structure as learnable decisions, combining iterative tool loading with programmatic tool orchestration to bound context growth and stabilize long-horizon trajectories. Second, we propose rubric-based reinforcement finetuning, which decomposes task success into structured, task-aligned criteria and enables scalable training using small judge models. Across MCP benchmarks, these design choices yield large and consistent gains over generic RL baselines, allowing a 4B SLM to approach frontier-agent performance under far tighter parameter and context budgets.

</details>


### [141] [From Statistical Fidelity to Clinical Consistency: Scalable Generation and Auditing of Synthetic Patient Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06720)
*Guanglin Zhou,Armin Catic,Motahare Shabestari,Matthew Young,Chaiquan Li,Katrina Poppe,Sebastiano Barbieri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出一种集成管道，通过高保真生成和基于大语言模型的自动化审计两步法，生成临床一致的合成电子健康记录（EHR）。在MIMIC-IV数据集上生成的18,071条合成记录在统计特性上与真实数据高度一致（R²=0.99），经审计后效应量从0.59-1.60降至0.18-0.67，下游任务性能匹配或超过真实数据，且无隐私泄露风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 访问电子健康记录（EHR）进行数字健康研究受到隐私法规和机构障碍的限制。现有合成EHR方法虽能捕获整体统计特性，但在临床过程和观察中存在不一致性（如禁忌药物），无法满足临床研究的实际需求。

Method: 开发了包含两个协同步骤的集成管道：1）高保真生成：使用MIMIC-IV数据库训练知识基础生成模型，表示近32,000个临床事件（人口统计学、实验室检查、药物、诊断、程序），强制执行结构完整性；2）可扩展审计：集成基于大语言模型的自动化审计模块，过滤临床不一致记录。

Result: 生成18,071条合成记录（源自180,712条真实记录）。合成事件概率与真实数据高度一致（平均偏差=0.00，R²=0.99）。临床医生审核随机样本（N=20）发现45-60%存在不一致。自动化审计显著降低差异（ Cohen's d从0.59-1.60降至0.18-0.67）。经审计数据训练的下游模型性能匹配或超越真实数据。隐私测试显示无泄露风险（F1=0.51）。

Conclusion: 该集成管道成功生成临床一致的合成EHR，平衡了数据可用性与患者隐私保护。知识基础生成与LLM审计的结合有效解决了合成数据的临床一致性问题，为安全的主权数据共享提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Access to electronic health records (EHRs) for digital health research is often limited by privacy regulations and institutional barriers. Synthetic EHRs have been proposed as a way to enable safe and sovereign data sharing; however, existing methods may produce records that capture overall statistical properties of real data but present inconsistencies across clinical processes and observations. We developed an integrated pipeline to make synthetic patient trajectories clinically consistent through two synergistic steps: high-fidelity generation and scalable auditing. Using the MIMIC-IV database, we trained a knowledge-grounded generative model that represents nearly 32,000 distinct clinical events, including demographics, laboratory measurements, medications, procedures, and diagnoses, while enforcing structural integrity. To support clinical consistency at scale, we incorporated an automated auditing module leveraging large language models to filter out clinical inconsistencies (e.g., contraindicated medications) that escape probabilistic generation. We generated 18,071 synthetic patient records derived from a source cohort of 180,712 real patients. While synthetic clinical event probabilities demonstrated robust agreement (mean bias effectively 0.00) and high correlation (R2=0.99) with the real counterparts, review of a random sample of synthetic records (N=20) by three clinicians identified inconsistencies in 45-60% of them. Automated auditing reduced the difference between real and synthetic data (Cohen's effect size d between 0.59 and 1.60 before auditing, and between 0.18 and 0.67 after auditing). Downstream models trained on audited data matched or even exceeded real-data performance. We found no evidence of privacy risks, with membership inference performance indistinguishable from random guessing (F1-score=0.51).

</details>


### [142] [ProtAlign: Contrastive learning paradigm for Sequence and structure alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06722)
*Aditya Ranganath,Hasin Us Sami,Kowshik Thopalli,Bhavya Kailkhura,Wesam Sakla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: A sequence-structure contrastive alignment framework that learns a unified embedding space for protein sequences and structures using contrastive learning, enabling cross-modal retrieval and improving downstream tasks like function annotation and stability estimation.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Protein language models typically only consider sequence-text alignment without incorporating structural information. Traditional methods treat sequence and structure separately, which limits the ability to exploit the alignment between protein structure and sequence embeddings.

Method: The paper introduces a sequence-structure contrastive alignment framework that learns a shared embedding space where proteins are represented consistently across modalities. The model is trained on large-scale pairs of sequences and experimentally resolved or predicted structures, maximizing agreement between matched sequence-structure pairs while pushing apart unrelated pairs.

Result: The framework enables cross-modal retrieval (e.g., finding structural neighbors given a sequence), improves downstream prediction tasks including function annotation and stability estimation, and provides interpretable links between sequence variation and structural organization.

Conclusion: Contrastive learning can serve as a powerful bridge between protein sequences and structures, offering a unified representation for understanding and engineering proteins.

Abstract: Protein language models often take into consideration the alignment between a protein sequence and its textual description. However, they do not take structural information into consideration. Traditional methods treat sequence and structure separately, limiting the ability to exploit the alignment between the structure and protein sequence embeddings. In this paper, we introduce a sequence structure contrastive alignment framework, which learns a shared embedding space where proteins are represented consistently across modalities. By training on large-scale pairs of sequences and experimentally resolved or predicted structures, the model maximizes agreement between matched sequence structure pairs while pushing apart unrelated pairs. This alignment enables cross-modal retrieval (e.g., finding structural neighbors given a sequence), improves downstream prediction tasks such as function annotation and stability estimation, and provides interpretable links between sequence variation and structural organization. Our results demonstrate that contrastive learning can serve as a powerful bridge between protein sequences and structures, offering a unified representation for understanding and engineering proteins.

</details>


### [143] [Bi Directional Feedback Fusion for Activity Aware Forecasting of Indoor CO2 and PM2.5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06724)
*Harshala Gammulle,Lidia Morawska,Sridha Sridharan,Clinton Fookes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双流双向反馈融合框架，用于室内空气质量（IAQ）预测，重点预测CO2和PM2.5浓度。该框架结合了上下文感知调制机制、双时间尺度 temporal 模块和复合损失函数，能够同时建模室内环境演变和人类活动衍生的嵌入表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据驱动模型主要依赖历史传感器数据，难以预测行为诱发的排放峰值或快速浓度变化。室内污染物的预测面临环境因素复杂交互和高度动态的occupant行为的挑战。

Method: 提出双流双向反馈融合框架，联合建模室内环境演变和人类活动衍生的动作嵌入。架构包含：1) 上下文感知调制机制，基于共享的演进融合状态自适应缩放和移动每个流；2) 双时间尺度temporal模块，分别捕捉CO2累积模式和PM2.5短期波动；3) 复合损失函数，结合加权MSE、峰值感知惩罚和不确定性正则化。

Result: 在真实IAQ数据集上验证表明，该方法显著优于最先进的预测基线，同时提供可解释的不确定性估计。

Conclusion: 该框架能够有效解决室内空气质量预测中的行为诱发排放峰值和快速浓度变化问题，为智能建筑和健康监测系统提供了实用的部署方案。

Abstract: Indoor air quality (IAQ) forecasting plays a critical role in safeguarding occupant health, ensuring thermal comfort, and supporting intelligent building control. However, predicting future concentrations of key pollutants such as carbon dioxide (CO2) and fine particulate matter (PM2.5) remains challenging due to the complex interplay between environmental factors and highly dynamic occupant behaviours. Traditional data driven models primarily rely on historical sensor trajectories and often fail to anticipate behaviour induced emission spikes or rapid concentration shifts. To address these limitations, we present a dual stream bi directional feedback fusion framework that jointly models indoor environmental evolution and action derived embeddings representing human activities. The proposed architecture integrates a context aware modulation mechanism that adaptively scales and shifts each stream based on a shared, evolving fusion state, enabling the model to selectively emphasise behavioural cues or long term environmental trends. Furthermore, we introduce dual timescale temporal modules that independently capture gradual CO2 accumulation patterns and short term PM2.5 fluctuations. A composite loss function combining weighted mean squared error, spike aware penalties, and uncertainty regularisation facilitates robust learning under volatile indoor conditions. Extensive validation on real-world IAQ datasets demonstrates that our approach significantly outperforms state of the art forecasting baselines while providing interpretable uncertainty estimates essential for practical deployment in smart buildings and health-aware monitoring systems.

</details>


### [144] [Regression Models Meet Foundation Models: A Hybrid-AI Approach to Practical Electricity Price Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06726)
*Yunzhong Qiu,Binzhu Li,Hao Wei,Shenglin Weng,Chen Wang,Zhongyi Pei,Mingsheng Long,Jianmin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对电价预测中TSFM与回归模型各自的局限性，提出FutureBoosting范式：通过冻结TSFM生成预测特征增强回归模型输入。实验表明MAE降低超30%，实现了兼具时间依赖性捕捉和特征交互能力的电价预测框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电价市场价格具有极端波动性、非线性和非平稳性，准确预测面临重大挑战。现有时间序列基础模型(TSFM)虽能有效捕捉时间依赖性，但通常未充分利用对价格预测至关重要的跨变量相关性和非周期性模式；而回归模型虽擅长捕捉特征交互，但受限于未来可用输入，忽略了预测时不可用的历史驱动因素。

Method: 提出FutureBoosting范式：冻结的TSFM生成预测特征作为回归模型的增强输入。具体实现为轻量级、即插即用的电价预测框架。

Result: 在真实电力市场数据上，FutureBoosting consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TSFMs and regression baselines，MAE降低超过30%。消融实验和可解释AI(XAI)技术验证了预测特征的贡献并阐明了模型决策过程。

Conclusion: FutureBoosting通过将TSFM生成的预测特征注入下游回归模型，有效解决了电价预测中时间依赖性与特征交互难以兼顾的问题。实验表明该框架在真实电力市场数据上MAE降低超过30%，验证了所提范式的有效性。该方法为回归模型增强提供了通用框架，具有较强的实用性和可解释性。

Abstract: Electricity market prices exhibit extreme volatility, nonlinearity, and non-stationarity, making accurate forecasting a significant challenge. While cutting-edge time series foundation models (TSFMs) effectively capture temporal dependencies, they typically underutilize cross-variate correlations and non-periodic patterns that are essential for price forecasting. Conversely, regression models excel at capturing feature interactions but are limited to future-available inputs, ignoring crucial historical drivers that are unavailable at forecast time. To bridge this gap, we propose FutureBoosting, a novel paradigm that enhances regression-based forecasts by integrating forecasted features generated from a frozen TSFM. This approach leverages the TSFM's ability to model historical patterns and injects these insights as enriched inputs into a downstream regression model. We instantiate this paradigm into a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for electricity price forecasting. Extensive evaluations on real-world electricity market data demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TSFMs and regression baselines, achieving reductions in Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of more than 30% at most. Through ablation studies and explainable AI (XAI) techniques, we validate the contribution of forecasted features and elucidate the model's decision-making process. FutureBoosting establishes a robust, interpretable, and effective solution for practical market participation, offering a general framework for enhancing regression models with temporal context.

</details>


### [145] [Safe Transformer: An Explicit Safety Bit For Interpretable And Controllable Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06727)
*Jingyuan Feng,Andrew Gambardella,Gouki Minegishi,Takeshi Kojima,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Safe Transformer通过在Transformer层之间插入带有安全比特的信息瓶颈来实现可解释、可控制的安全对齐。安全比特可直接读取安全决策，并可手动覆盖。仅需轻量级微调，在红队基准测试中实现接近零的攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前安全对齐方法将安全行为隐式编码在模型参数中，导致根本性的不透明性：无法轻易检查模型拒绝请求的原因，也无法在其安全判断失败时进行干预。

Method: 提出Safe Transformer方法，通过在预训练语言模型的Transformer层之间插入包含显式安全比特的离散信息瓶颈。通过对比训练，模型学习解耦表示：安全比特s控制行为模式(s=1生成有用回复，s=0生成拒绝)，额外的无监督比特u编码语义内容以保留生成能力。

Result: 在红队基准测试中，Safe Transformer实现了接近零的攻击成功率，显著优于基线模型和安全微调基线方法。

Conclusion: 该设计实现了可解释性(安全决策可直接读取)和可控制性(安全比特可手动覆盖)，仅需轻量级微调而无需从头预训练。

Abstract: Current safety alignment methods encode safe behavior implicitly within model parameters, creating a fundamental opacity: we cannot easily inspect why a model refuses a request, nor intervene when its safety judgments fail. We propose Safe Transformer, a modular approach that augments pre-trained language models by inserting a discrete information bottleneck containing an explicit safety bit between transformer layers. The safety bit serves as both an interpretable signal of the model's safety classification and a controllable switch: through contrastive training, the model learns disentangled representations where the safety bit governs the behavioral mode - producing helpful responses when $s=1$ and refusals when $s=0$ - while additional unsupervised bits $u$ encode semantic content for generation. Additional unsupervised bits in the information bottleneck allow semantic information to flow through, preserving the model's generation capabilities. This design achieves both interpretability (the safety decision is directly readable) and controllability (the safety bit can be manually overridden), requiring only lightweight fine-tuning without pre-training from scratch. In red-team benchmarks, Safe Transformer achieves near-zero Attack Success Rate, substantially outperforming base models and safety fine-tuning baselines.

</details>


### [146] [Orion: Characterizing and Programming Apple's Neural Engine for LLM Training and Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06728)
*Ramchand Kumaresan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Orion 是首个直接编程 Apple Neural Engine（ANE）以支持 LLM 推理与端侧训练的开放端到端系统：通过私有 _ANEClient/_ANECompiler API 绕过 CoreML，包含图 IR 编译器（27 op、5 个优化 pass）、原生 Objective-C 运行时（IOSurface 零拷贝 I/O、程序缓存）以及核心的「增量编译（delta compilation）」技术——通过卸载已编译程序、磁盘修补权重文件、重新加载来绕开 ANECCompile()，将每步重编译从 4200 ms 降到 494 ms（8.5×），整体训练加速 3.8×。M4 Max 上 GPT-2 124M 推理 170+ tok/s，Stories110M 在 TinyStories 上 1000 步训练 22 分钟、零 NaN，并支持 LoRA 适配器以 IOSurface 输入热插拔。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Apple 二十多亿台设备搭载 ANE（每颗 Apple Silicon 自 A11 起配备，M4 代达 38 TOPS INT8），但对 LLM 负载基本闲置：CoreML 作为黑盒调度器，无法强制 ANE 执行、无法查看 ANE 程序、不支持端侧训练，也不暴露 MIL 指令集与编译/求值 API（位于私有框架 AppleNeuralEngine.framework）。已有工作 maderix 逆向出私有 API 调用序列并做了硬件表征（推翻了 38 TOPS 规格、实测 fp16 ~19 TFLOPS、32 MB SRAM 悬崖、~0.095 ms 派发开销、~119 次编译上限），ANEgpt 实现了 110M 模型的 Transformer 前后向但续训即 NaN、缺编译器且用 Python 编排，均未构成完整系统。此外 ANE 为 compile-then-dispatch 模型，权重在编译期被烘焙（baked），导致每次梯度更新都需要全量重编译，成为训练的根本瓶颈。

Method: 1) 约束表征：在 maderix 硬件表征基础上扩展出 20 条 ANE 编程约束目录（14 条为本文新发现），分为 MIL IR 限制（concat 被拒、gelu 非法需 tanh 近似、matmul 转置需具名常量、conv 不支持 bias、32K 通道 conv 被拒、SDPA 因果掩码被静默忽略）、内存与 I/O 约束（多输入/输出 surface 需统一字节分配大小、按参数名字母序绑定、过量分配时按 packed [1,C,1,S] 从字节 0 读取、~49 KB 最小 surface、BLOBFILE 偏移为 64 字节、MIL 须为 NSData*、权重字典须为 @{}）、编译限制（~119 次/进程、权重编译期烘焙、exec() 重启 ~50 ms）、性能特征（1×1 conv 比 matmul 快 ~3×）。2) 编译器：27 操作的图 IR 经 5 个优化 pass（死代码消除、恒等消除、cast 融合、SRAM 标注、约束校验）以不动点循环（≤20 次迭代）下降为 ANE 原生 MIL（BLOBFILE 权重引用），13 个已验证前端（GPT-2 推理 5 个 + Stories110M 训练 8 个）及 LoRA 融合变体，均通过自动 diff 与手写 MIL 验证结构等价。3) 运行时：复合键程序缓存（模型名/层/序列长度/权重版本）、IOSurface 零拷贝张量 I/O 与 [seq,d]↔[1,d,1,seq] 转置、delta 编译（unloadWithQoS → 写权重文件 → loadWithQoS，依赖 MIL 文本不变导致 hexStringIdentifier 不变、共享 tmpDir 需转移所有权）。4) CPU/ANE 分工：Transformer 前后向与 dx 在 ANE，采样、Adam、∇W 累加（cblas_sgemm+GCD）、NLL loss、分类器反向、embedding 查表在 CPU。5) 数值稳定性：修复三个 NaN 诱因——延迟编译（checkpoint 加载后再编译）、fp16 激活钳位到 ±65504、梯度/BLOBFILE 净化（NaN→0、±Inf→±65504）并加入加载后校验。6) LoRA-as-Input：基座权重烘焙为 BLOBFILE，A/B 矩阵作为 IOSurface 输入（两个前端：lora_linear、lora_attention，8 个适配器输入），实现零重编译热切换。系统为纯 Objective-C，Python 仅用于一次性权重转换。

Result: M4 Max（16 ANE 核、64 GB 统一内存、macOS 15）：推理 GPT-2 124M 达 170 tok/s（decode，p50 5.76 ms/tok），prefill 缓存后 165 tok/s、首次调用含 ~1015 ms 编译，CPU decode 283 tok/s（ANE 每次派发 ~2.3 ms IOSurface 往返开销占优）；与 CPU fp32 基线 top-1 argmax 一致率 100%（最大 logit 误差 0.073），对提示"The meaning of life is"生成完全相同的 64 token 续写。训练：v1.0 全量重编译 5108 ms/步（编译占 83.9%），v2.0 增量重载 1345 ms/步（重载占 36.8%），重编译 4200→494 ms（8.5×），整体 3.8× 加速，1000 步 85 分钟→22.4 分钟，计算部分 908→849 ms，吞吐 0.612→0.656 TFLOPS，两版本均 0/1000 NaN；稳定性压测 5 条独立续训链共 25 步（每步新进程）零 NaN/Inf、损失单调下降（13.975±0.003→13.913±0.007）、exec() 重启成功率 25/25；算子层面分类器前向 10.2×、32K 词表 softmax 33.8×、RMSNorm 反向 ~1× 加速；框架对比表显示 Orion 是唯一直接面向 ANE 且同时支持训练与 delta 权重更新的系统（对比 MLX/llama.cpp/MLC-LLM/CoreML）。

Conclusion: 核心结论是：ANE 编译期烘焙权重这一被认为不可逾越的训练瓶颈，可通过「卸载—改写权重文件—重载」的增量编译绕开，使 1000 步训练从 ~85 分钟降至 22 分钟且零 NaN；ANE 可作为端侧 LLM 训练与推理的可行目标，但当前 GPU/MLX 绝对吞吐仍更高，ANE 的独特价值在于零空闲功耗、专用硅占用与特定算子（如大词表 softmax 33.8×）加速。约束目录与方法学可推广至高通 Hexagon、三星 NPU、Google TPU Edge 等其他厂商 NPU。局限：依赖可能随时变更的私有 API；delta 编译仍占 36.8% 步时（受 BLOBFILE 磁盘 I/O 支配，未来可尝试内存内权重热补丁）；仅在 M4 Max 验证；训练仅验证机械稳定性而未做下游任务评估；尚不支持 INT8/INT4 量化、无学习率调度、LoRA 尚未接入完整推理流水线。系统以 MIT 许可开源（github.com/mechramc/Orion）。

Abstract: Over two billion Apple devices ship with a Neural Processing Unit (NPU) - the Apple Neural Engine (ANE) - yet this accelerator remains largely unused for large language model workloads. CoreML, Apple's public ML framework, imposes opaque abstractions that prevent direct ANE programming and do not support on-device training. We present Orion, to our knowledge the first open end-to-end system that combines direct ANE execution, a compiler pipeline, and stable multi-step training with checkpoint resume in a single native runtime, bypassing CoreML entirely via Apple's private _ANEClient and _ANECompiler APIs.
  Building on prior characterization work by maderix, we extend public knowledge of ANE constraints to a catalog of 20 restrictions on MIL IR programs, memory layout, compilation limits, and numerical behavior, including 14 previously undocumented constraints discovered during Orion development. Orion includes a compiler that lowers a graph IR through five optimization passes to ANE-native MIL and a runtime that manages IOSurface-backed zero-copy tensor I/O, program caching, and delta compilation for weight updates.
  Because the ANE bakes weights at compile time, naive training normally requires full recompilation per step (~4.2 s). We show that compiled programs can instead be updated by unloading, patching weight files, and reloading, bypassing ANECCompile() and reducing recompilation from 4,200 ms to 494 ms per step (8.5x), yielding a 3.8x training speedup. On an M4 Max, Orion achieves 170+ tokens/s for GPT-2 124M inference and demonstrates stable training of a 110M-parameter transformer on TinyStories for 1,000 steps in 22 minutes with zero NaN occurrences. We also present LoRA adapter-as-input, enabling hot-swap of adapters via IOSurface inputs without recompilation.

</details>


### [147] [Don't Freeze, Don't Crash: Extending the Safe Operating Range of Neural Navigation in Dense Crowds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06729)
*Jiefu Zhang,Yang Xu,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的人群导航方法，通过密度不变观测编码和物理信息近体奖励塑形，实现对训练分布外人群密度的零样本泛化。训练于11-16人环境，评估扩展至21人（密度提升1.3倍），成功率达99%以上，碰撞-free成功率达86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的人群导航方法在遇到训练分布外的人群密度时容易失效，原因是密度敏感的观测归一化和社交成本缩放；解析方法虽然安全但在密集交互中会"冻结"。因此需要一种能在可变密度环境中安全导航且不产生冻结的通用方法。

Method: 提出三种核心技术：(1)密度不变观测编码：使用距离排序的K个最近行人加上有界的人群摘要，保持输入统计特性随人群规模增长保持稳定；(2)密度随机化训练：在训练阶段引入密度变化；(3)物理信息近体奖励塑形与密度自适应缩放。

Result: 在3m×3m竞技场中训练（11-16人），评估扩展至21人（密度提升1.3倍）。策略在随机人群中达到>99%的目标到达率和86%的无碰撞成功率。与分析方法相比显著减少冻结现象，与基于学习的基准方法相比提升>60分的无碰撞 margin。

Conclusion: 所提方法成功实现了零样本密度泛化，在超出训练密度的情况下仍能保持安全导航，有效解决了学习型方法在分布外密度下的失效问题和解析方法的冻结问题。

Abstract: Navigating safely through dense crowds requires collision avoidance that generalizes beyond the densities seen during training. Learning-based crowd navigation can break under out-of-distribution crowd sizes due to density-sensitive observation normalization and social-cost scaling, while analytical solvers often remain safe but freeze in tight interactions. We propose a reinforcement learning approach for dense, variable-density navigation that attains zero-shot density generalization using a density-invariant observation encoding with density-randomized training and physics-informed proxemic reward shaping with density-adaptive scaling. The encoding represents the distance-sorted $K$ nearest pedestrians plus bounded crowd summaries, keeping input statistics stable as crowd size grows. Trained with $N\!\in\![11,16]$ pedestrians in a $3\mathrm{m}\times3\mathrm{m}$ arena and evaluated up to $N\!=\!21$ pedestrians ($1.3\times$ denser), our policy reaches the goal in $>99\%$ of episodes and achieves $86\%$ collision-free success in random crowds, with markedly less freezing than analytical methods and a $>\!60$-point collision-free margin over learning-based benchmark methods. Codes are available at \href{https://github.com/jznmsl/PSS-Social}{https://github.com/jznmsl/PSS-Social}.

</details>


### [148] [Rank-Factorized Implicit Neural Bias: Scaling Super-Resolution Transformer with FlashAttention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06738)
*Dongheon Lee,Seokju Yun,Jaegyun Im,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RIB方法替代SR Transformer中的相对位置偏置，通过低秩隐式神经表示和通道级联技术启用FlashAttention，将窗口尺寸扩展至96×96，在Urban100×2上实现35.63 dB PSNR，效率提升2-3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SR Transformer严重依赖相对位置偏置(RPB)，导致无法利用FlashAttention等硬件高效注意力内核，造成训练和推理的高计算负担，限制了通过增大训练patch尺寸或自注意力窗口来扩展SR Transformer的能力。

Method: 提出RIB（秩分解隐式神经偏置）方法：(1)使用低秩隐式神经表示近似位置偏置；(2)将位置偏置与像素内容token按通道级联，将注意力分数计算中的逐元素偏置加法转换为点积操作；(3)引入卷积局部注意力和循环窗口策略以充分利用RIB和FlashAttention的优势。将窗口尺寸扩大至96×96，并同时扩大训练patch尺寸和数据集规模。

Result: 在Urban100×2数据集上达到35.63 dB PSNR，训练时间缩短2.1倍，推理时间缩短2.9倍。

Conclusion: RIB通过低秩隐式神经表示替代相对位置偏置，使SR Transformer能够利用FlashAttention，显著提升效率。实验表明，该方法在Urban100×2数据集上达到35.63 dB PSNR，同时将训练和推理时间分别缩短2.1倍和2.9倍，为SR Transformer的可扩展性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recent Super-Resolution~(SR) methods mainly adopt Transformers for their strong long-range modeling capability and exceptional representational capacity. However, most SR Transformers rely heavily on relative positional bias~(RPB), which prevents them from leveraging hardware-efficient attention kernels such as FlashAttention. This limitation imposes a prohibitive computational burden during both training and inference, severely restricting attempts to scale SR Transformers by enlarging the training patch size or the self-attention window. Consequently, unlike other domains that actively exploit the inherent scalability of Transformers, SR Transformers remain heavily focused on effectively utilizing limited receptive fields. In this paper, we propose Rank-factorized Implicit Neural Bias~(RIB), an alternative to RPB that enables FlashAttention in SR Transformers. Specifically, RIB approximates positional bias using low-rank implicit neural representations and concatenates them with pixel content tokens in a channel-wise manner, turning the element-wise bias addition in attention score computation into a dot-product operation. Further, we introduce a convolutional local attention and a cyclic window strategy to fully leverage the advantages of long-range interactions enabled by RIB and FlashAttention. We enlarge the window size up to \textbf{96$\times$96} while jointly scaling the training patch size and the dataset size, maximizing the benefits of Transformers in the SR task. As a result, our network achieves \textbf{35.63\,dB PSNR} on Urban100$\times$2, while reducing training and inference time by \textbf{2.1$\times$} and \textbf{2.9$\times$}, respectively, compared to the RPB-based SR Transformer~(PFT).

</details>


### [149] [Heterogeneous Decentralized Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06741)
*Zhiying Jiang,Raihan Seraj,Marcos Villagra,Bidhan Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种高效的分散式扩散模型训练框架，支持异构训练目标（DDPM和Flow Matching混合），通过预训练检查点转换和高效架构，将计算需求从1176 GPU天降至72 GPU天（16倍），数据需求从1.58亿降至1100万（14倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练前沿规模的扩散模型需要大量计算资源，集中在紧密耦合的集群中，限制了资源受限机构的参与。现有去中心化扩散模型（DDM）需要1176 GPU天且所有专家使用同质训练目标。

Method: 提出三个贡献：（1）异构去中心化训练范式，允许专家使用不同目标（DDPM和Flow Matching），推理时通过确定性调度感知转换到统一速度空间；（2）从ImageNet-DDPM到Flow Matching的预训练检查点转换，无需目标特定预训练即可加速收敛；（3）采用PixArt-alpha的高效AdaLN-Single架构。

Result: 在LAION-Aesthetics上，相较于先前DDM工作，计算量从1176降至72 GPU天（16倍），数据量从1.58亿降至1100万（14倍）。在一致的推理设置下，异构2DDPM:6FM配置实现更好的FID（11.88 vs 12.45）和更高的内提示多样性（LPIPS 0.631 vs 0.617）。

Conclusion: 通过消除同步需求并支持混合DDPM/FM目标，该框架降低了去中心化生成模型训练的基础设施要求，使资源受限机构也能参与前沿扩散模型训练。

Abstract: Training frontier-scale diffusion models often requires substantial computational resources concentrated in tightly coupled clusters, limiting participation to well-resourced institutions. While Decentralized Diffusion Models (DDM) enable training multiple experts in isolation, existing approaches require 1176 GPU-days and homogeneous training objectives across all experts. We present an efficient framework that reduces resource requirements while supporting heterogeneous training objectives. Our approach combines three contributions: (1) a heterogeneous decentralized training paradigm that allows experts to use different objectives (DDPM and Flow Matching), unified at inference time via a deterministic schedule-aware conversion into a common velocity space without retraining; (2) pretrained checkpoint conversion from ImageNet-DDPM to Flow Matching objectives, accelerating convergence and enabling initialization without objective-specific pretraining; and (3) PixArt-alpha's efficient AdaLN-Single architecture, reducing parameters while maintaining quality. Experiments on LAION-Aesthetics show that, relative to the training scale reported for prior DDM work, our approach reduces compute from 1176 to 72 GPU-days (16x) and data from 158M to 11M (14x). Under aligned inference settings, our heterogeneous 2DDPM:6FM configuration achieves better FID (11.88 vs. 12.45) and higher intra-prompt diversity (LPIPS 0.631 vs. 0.617) than the homogeneous 8FM baseline. By eliminating synchronization requirements and enabling mixed DDPM/FM objectives, our framework lowers infrastructure requirements for decentralized generative model training.

</details>


### [150] [Improved Constrained Generation by Bridging Pretrained Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06742)
*Xiaoxuan Liang,Saeid Naderiparizi,Yunpeng Liu,Berend Zwartsenberg,Frank Wood*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种约束生成框架，通过微调预训练生成模型使其在复杂可行域（如道路地图等结构化空间）内生成样本，同时保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中的约束很少是简单的线性不等式，而是类似道路地图的复杂结构化空间域，现有方法难以有效处理这类复杂约束。

Method: 微调预训练生成模型以强制执行约束，同时维持生成保真度。

Result: 该方法展现出与现有微调和无需训练约束基线方法不同的特性，揭示了约束满足与采样质量之间的新权衡。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够在复杂可行区域内直接生成样本并保持现实性，为约束生成建模提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Constrained generative modeling is fundamental to applications such as robotic control and autonomous driving, where models must respect physical laws and safety-critical constraints. In real-world settings, these constraints rarely take the form of simple linear inequalities, but instead complex feasible regions that resemble road maps or other structured spatial domains. We propose a constrained generation framework that generates samples directly within such feasible regions while preserving realism. Our method fine-tunes a pretrained generative model to enforce constraints while maintaining generative fidelity. Experimentally, our method exhibits characteristics distinct from existing fine-tuning and training-free constrained baselines, revealing a new compromise between constraint satisfaction and sampling quality.

</details>


### [151] [Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06743)
*Jianyuan Zhong,Kaibo Wang,Ding Ding,Zijin Feng,Haoli Bai,Yang Xiang,Jiacheng Sun,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出：将 GRPO 直接迁移到离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）时，由于重要性比只能用 ELBO/均值场等代理估计且噪声极大，标准 GRPO 的"条件裁剪 + 固定组大小归一化"会形成"噪声→梯度尖峰→策略漂移→方差进一步放大"的自增强不稳定环，导致约 300 步后奖励崩塌。作者提出 StableDRL：用无条件裁剪（无论优势符号一律把 ρ̂ 限制在 [1−ε,1+ε]）抑制离群尖峰，用自归一化（以裁剪后权重之和替代组大小 G 归一化）把更新约束在逐样本梯度的凸包内，并配合 log-space clip-then-softmax 保证数值稳定；另以"阶梯注意力"（staircase attention）实现 O(1) 无泄漏的似然代理估计，将方法推广到块扩散模型。实验表明 StableDRL 可在全参数微调下稳定训练 1000+ 步，并在 LLaDA-8B（GSM8K 84.2、MATH500 41.8、Countdown 83.5、Sudoku 91.5 平均 pass@1）与 SDAR-8B（AIME24 16.7，静态采样）上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 已成为自回归 LLM 强化学习后训练的标准方法，但其两个核心组件都建立在"可精确计算序列概率"这一自回归特有假设上：(1) 重要性比 ρ = π_θ(x)/π_old(x) 需要精确序列似然，而 dLLM 的似然需在 n! 条掩码轨迹上边缘化，不可解，只能用 ELBO 多步蒙特卡洛或均值场近似估计（M≤5），且 MC 掩码模式（"easy"/"hard"）的差异会让 ρ̂ 呈重尾分布，单条 rollout 的估计比值可炸到 10^5；(2) GRPO 的 min-clip 是条件裁剪——在 A<0 且 ρ̂>1+ε 时会走"未裁剪"分支，本意是让策略快速回到信任域，但在 dLLM 中这条分支会被与模型无关的估计噪声意外触发，形成"陷阱门"式的无界步长乘子，产生梯度尖峰。同时 GRPO 用固定组大小 G 归一化，在高方差比值下会使梯度幅值在上下界之间剧烈震荡，污染 AdamW 的动量历史。作者进一步给出理论与实验证据，说明这两点共同构成一个自增强的"不稳定环"：估计噪声→梯度尖峰→策略漂移（ΔL 增大）→未来 ρ̂ 方差进一步放大→更多尖峰，直至奖励崩塌，且在梯度范数超过临界阈值后发散概率不可逆地上升。已有工作（D1、WD1、UniGRPO、ESPO、SPG）多聚焦于"如何更好地估计比值"，或在不稳定时退化为 LoRA/早停，尚未从 GRPO 目标函数形式本身解决与噪声比值的适配问题。

Method: StableDRL 是面向 dLLM 的 GRPO 改造，包含两个机制与两个工程扩展：(1) 无条件裁剪：不再按优势符号分支，直接将 ρ̂ 硬性限制在 [1−ε, 1+ε]，从结构上杜绝"负优势+大噪声比值"绕过裁剪的可能，使梯度范数确定性有界；(2) 自归一化：用 Σ_i clip_ε(ρ̂_i) 取代固定组大小 G 作分母，更新成为逐样本梯度 g_j = A_j ∇logπ_θ 的凸组合，其范数严格 ≤ max_j‖g_j‖ ≤ B，从而把随机组尺度因子 1/G·Σw 显式除掉，解除更新幅度与组级权重涨落的耦合。数值实现上不直接计算 exp(ΔlogL)，而是在 log 空间先做 clip 至 [log(1−ε), log(1+ε)]，再用 LSE 稳定 softmax 得到归一化系数（clip-then-softmax），避免混合精度下溢出/下溢。由于 dLLM 缺乏可解析的 ∇logπ_θ，梯度方向取自 SPG 等稳定得分代理：全注意力 dLLM 用与推理去噪调度一致的分块掩码采样，块扩散则随机位置掩码。理论部分：Lemma 3.1 给出 GRPO 更新范数超过任意阈值 H 的概率下界 P_i(H)=½F̄(log u_H − D_i)，在共同右尾包络条件下该下界关于漂移状态 D_i 非减；Theorem 3.2 证明尖峰驱动的更新会抬高 D_i，从而 P_{i+1}(H) ≥ P_i(H)，构成自增强不稳定环；Lemma 3.3 与 Theorem 3.4 指出仅加无条件裁剪会进入"边界饱和"（命中上界）的高频震荡模式，仍随 D_i 单调恶化；Theorem 3.5 证明自归一化的凸包性质与确定性范数界。块扩散扩展：用双流（clean context 流 + corrupted target 流）输入和 2n×2n 复合注意力掩码 [M_causal, 0; M_stair, M_intra]，其中 M_stair 为严格块下三角（只允许目标块 k 关注 k 之前的干净历史，机械屏蔽当前块真值），M_intra 为块对角（支持块内并行独立去噪），从而在单个计算图内 O(1) 完成无泄漏的 ELBO 估计（对比朴素迭代的 O(K) 与双向注意力的信息泄漏）。

Result: 机制验证：在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 全参数 RL 中，ESPO 代表的标准 GRPO 出现无界漂移与递增的尖峰阈值，约 300 步奖励崩塌；仅加无条件裁剪虽限制漂移但梯度频繁撞击裁剪上界、产生高频震荡并同样崩塌；StableDRL 保持低而稳定的尖峰率且与漂移解耦，奖励单调上升。主结果（LLaDA-8B-Instruct，pass@1，128/256/512 长度）：GSM8K 平均 84.2%（ESPO 82.0、SPG 83.0），MATH500 平均 41.8%（+5.2 over SPG@256），Countdown 平均 83.5%（256 长度较 SPG +13.7%），Sudoku 平均 91.5%，四项平均均居首位；且仅以 256 长度训练即在 128–512 长度上保持一致性与长度泛化。块扩散（SDAR-8B-Chat）：静态采样 MATH500 79.2 / GSM8K 92.4 / AIME24 16.7，动态采样 77.8 / 92.1 / 13.3，AIME24 上超过自回归 Qwen3-8B（10.0%）与 Trado（13.3%），且动态采样下不显著退化。消融：去掉无条件裁剪则噪声离群主导凸组合（α→1）导致快速崩溃；去掉自归一化则组尺度随机性引起幅度震荡、扭曲 AdamW 动量并最终崩塌；两者结合才稳定单调。鲁棒性压力测试（人为放大 ρ̂ 方差的"Exploding Weight"协议，70% 样本用 easy/hard 非对称掩码）：StableDRL 在正常与爆炸两种设定下均单调稳定、梯度分布紧致低方差；ESPO 在爆炸权重下立即灾难性崩塌（梯度 log 范数 >3 的重尾）；SPG 在两种设定下都崩塌，因其复用 rollout 隐式设 ρ=1、累积离策略偏置。诊断图（log10 ρ vs log10 梯度范数）显示 ESPO 呈"烟囱"形态（少数 ρ>10^6 的离群点把梯度推到 >10^4），SPG 呈更新范数与漂移强正相关，StableDRL 梯度范数稳定低于 10^1.8。信任域敏感性：ε∈{1,5} 稳定（ε=5 偏差-方差折中更优、收敛更快），ε∈{100,1000} 时"陷阱门"失效重新出现并导致突发崩溃，故默认 ε=5。

Conclusion: 本文的结论是：dLLM 上 RL 不稳定的根源不是"重要性比估计不够准"，而是 GRPO 的目标函数形式（条件裁剪 + 固定组归一化）与"被噪声污染的比值"根本不兼容；只要在比值估计层面接入噪声，条件裁剪就会退化为无界步长乘子，固定归一化会放大组级涨落，二者耦合形成不可逆的自增强崩塌环。StableDRL 通过无条件裁剪与自归一化在目标函数层面直接消除这两种失效模式，在理论与实验上均得到验证：它是首个能在全注意力与块扩散 dLLM 上稳定进行 1000+ 步全参数 RL 训练的方法，并借此释放了 dLLM 的推理潜力，取得新的 SOTA。方法的价值在于"结构性"约束（凸包 + 硬界）而非更精细的概率估计，因此可与更好的似然代理正交叠加。局限与可延伸方向：理论上依赖 C1–C5（有界逐样本梯度、统一右尾包络、条件独立、残余权重矩控制、非平凡漂移极值梯度等）较强理想化假设；似然代理本身的偏差与方差仍未根治，自归一化在极端离群时会把有效样本量压到近 1（凸组合退化）；效果对 ε 敏感（过大即失效）；验证限于 8B 级模型与有限基准，且块扩散的阶梯注意力需要双流输入带来额外计算与内存开销；未来可探索自适应 ε、逐样本自适应归一化、以及把凸包约束推广到更长 horizon 与更复杂的多轮推理任务。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is highly effective for post-training autoregressive (AR) language models, yet its direct application to diffusion large language models (dLLMs) often triggers reward collapse. We identify two sources of incompatibility. First, GRPO relies on importance ratios defined by sequence probabilities, which are intractable in dLLMs and must be estimated (e.g., via ELBO-based or mean-field likelihood proxies), yielding inherently noisy ratios. Second, standard GRPO's formulation is not designed for estimated ratios: its conditional clipping can be anomalously bypassed by model-agnostic estimation noise, producing gradient spikes, while its fixed group-size normalization amplifies gradient-magnitude fluctuations under high-variance ratio estimates. We show these effects form a self-reinforcing instability loop that drives policy drift and further increases ratio variance. To break this loop, we propose StableDRL, a reformulation of GRPO tailored for dLLMs that uses (i) unconditional clipping to suppress outlier-induced spikes and (ii) self-normalization to constrain updates within the convex hull of per-sample gradients. We further extend StableDRL to block-wise diffusion models via a staircase attention mechanism.

</details>


### [152] [Enhancing Instruction Following of LLMs via Activation Steering with Dynamic Rejection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06745)
*Minjae Kang,Jaehyung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DIRECTER是一种新型激活转向方法，通过动态调制转向强度来避免过度转向问题。该方法利用似然引导的解码循环自适应调整每一步的转向强度，并通过注意力敏感度分析识别关键层。实验表明该方法可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下提升指令跟随准确率高达6.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管指令调整取得了进展，大语言模型（LLMs）仍然经常无法遵循复杂的用户指令。激活转向技术虽然可以通过操纵模型内部来缓解这一问题，但存在过度转向（oversteering）的风险，即对指令的过度强调会降低任务准确性和整体文本质量。

Method: 提出DIRECTER（动态拒绝转向）方法，通过缩放KV缓存动态调制转向强度，无需额外数据集。方法包含：（1）将转向与似然引导的解码循环耦合，通过将转向后的输出分布与原始分布进行比较来自适应调整每一步的转向强度；（2）如果转向后的输出被视为不可信，则逐步减弱转向强度；（3）使用轻量级的一次性注意力敏感度分析对层进行排名，确定对模型表示影响最大的层。

Result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，DIRECTER显著增强了指令跟随能力，准确率比基线方法提升高达6.5%，且没有在生成质量或任务保真度方面产生常见的权衡。

Conclusion: 提出的动态、似然引导控制机制作为缓解过度转向的通用机制展现出潜力，可与现有基线方法兼容。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), despite advances in instruction tuning, often fail to follow complex user instructions. Activation steering techniques aim to mitigate this by manipulating model internals, but have a potential risk of oversteering, where excessive emphasis on the instruction degrades task accuracy and overall text quality. To address this, we introduce DIRECTER (Dynamic rejection steering), a novel steering method that dynamically modulates steering strength by scaling the KV cache without extra dataset. DIRECTER couples steering with a plausibility-guided decoding loop, which adaptively adjusts steering strength at each step by comparing the steered output distribution to the original. If the steered output is deemed implausible, steering strength is progressively weakened. This strength modulation is guided by a lightweight, one-time attention sensitivity analysis that ranks layers by their influence on model representations. Extensive evaluations show that DIRECTER significantly enhances instruction-following capabilities across diverse benchmarks, improving accuracy by up to 6.5% over baselines without the common trade-offs in generation quality or task fidelity. The proposed dynamic, plausibility-guided control during activation steering further demonstrates its potential as a general mechanism for mitigating oversteering that is compatible with existing baselines.

</details>


### [153] [Property-driven Protein Inverse Folding With Multi-Objective Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06748)
*Xiaoyang Hou,Junqi Liu,Chence Shi,Xin Liu,Zhi Yang,Jian Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProtAlign框架，通过多目标偏好对齐微调预训练逆折叠模型，在保持结构保真度的同时满足多种可开发性目标。应用于ProteinMPNN得到的MoMPNN模型在CATH 4.3晶体结构、从头生成骨架和实际binder设计场景中均展现出提升的可开发性而不影响设计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质序列设计需平衡设计能力（恢复目标骨架）与多种可开发性（溶解性、热稳定性、表达量）。现有方法通过后验突变、推理时偏置或针对特定属性重新训练，存在目标依赖性、需要领域专家知识或仔细调参的局限性。

Method: ProtAlign采用半在线直接偏好优化（DPO）策略配合灵活偏好边际来缓解竞争目标间的冲突，使用in silico属性预测器构建偏好对。针对广泛使用的ProteinMPNN骨架进行微调。

Result: MoMPNN在多个任务中提升了可开发性同时保持设计能力：CATH 4.3晶体结构、从头生成骨架、真实世界binder设计场景。

Conclusion: ProtAlign是一个适用于实际蛋白质序列设计的框架，能够在保持结构保真度的同时满足多种可开发性目标，为蛋白质工程提供了有效的多目标优化解决方案。

Abstract: Protein sequence design must balance designability, defined as the ability to recover a target backbone, with multiple, often competing, developability properties such as solubility, thermostability, and expression. Existing approaches address these properties through post hoc mutation, inference-time biasing, or retraining on property-specific subsets, yet they are target dependent and demand substantial domain expertise or careful hyperparameter tuning. In this paper, we introduce ProtAlign, a multi-objective preference alignment framework that fine-tunes pretrained inverse folding models to satisfy diverse developability objectives while preserving structural fidelity. ProtAlign employs a semi-online Direct Preference Optimization strategy with a flexible preference margin to mitigate conflicts among competing objectives and constructs preference pairs using in silico property predictors. Applied to the widely used ProteinMPNN backbone, the resulting model MoMPNN enhances developability without compromising designability across tasks including sequence design for CATH 4.3 crystal structures, de novo generated backbones, and real-world binder design scenarios, making it an appealing framework for practical protein sequence design.

</details>


### [154] [Latent Autoencoder Ensemble Kalman Filter for Data assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06752)
*Xin T. Tong,Yanyan Wang,Liang Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LAE-EnKF方法，通过在学习的潜空间中使用线性稳定动力学进行数据同化，解决了传统EnKF在强非线性系统中的性能退化问题。该方法学习编码器-解码器及稳定线性潜算子，形成兼容卡尔曼滤波的线性状态空间模型，兼具理论误差界保证和数值实验验证的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集合卡尔曼滤波(EnKF)广泛应用于高维系统数据同化，但其性能在强非线性动力学中经常恶化，原因是卡尔曼更新与底层系统行为之间存在结构不匹配。

Method: 提出潜自动编码器集合卡尔曼滤波(LAE-EnKF)，通过在学习到的潜空间中进行数据同化来解决问题。该方法学习非线性编码器-解码器 together with 稳定的线性潜演化算子和一致的潜观测映射，在潜坐标中产生闭环线性状态空间模型。这使得预测和分析步骤都能在潜空间中完全执行。与依赖无约束非线性潜dynamics的现有方法不同，该方法强调结构一致性、稳定性和可解释性。

Result: 在代表性非线性和混沌系统上的数值实验表明，LAE-EnKF比标准EnKF和相关潜空间方法产生更准确和稳定的同化，同时保持相当计算成本和数据驱动特性。

Conclusion: 该方法强调结构一致性、稳定性和可解释性。提供了在低维流形上学习线性 dynamics 的理论分析，并建立了潜在模型的泛化误差界。数值实验表明，LAE-EnKF在保持相当计算成本和数据驱动特性的同时，在准确性和稳定性方面优于现有方法。

Abstract: The ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF) is widely used for data assimilation in high-dimensional systems, but its performance often deteriorates for strongly nonlinear dynamics due to the structural mismatch between the Kalman update and the underlying system behavior. In this work, we propose a latent autoencoder ensemble Kalman filter (LAE-EnKF) that addresses this limitation by reformulating the assimilation problem in a learned latent space with linear and stable dynamics. The proposed method learns a nonlinear encoder--decoder together with a stable linear latent evolution operator and a consistent latent observation mapping, yielding a closed linear state-space model in the latent coordinates. This construction restores compatibility with the Kalman filtering framework and allows both forecast and analysis steps to be carried out entirely in the latent space. Compared with existing autoencoder-based and latent assimilation approaches that rely on unconstrained nonlinear latent dynamics, the proposed formulation emphasizes structural consistency, stability, and interpretability. We provide a theoretical analysis of learning linear dynamics on low-dimensional manifolds and establish generalization error bounds for the proposed latent model. Numerical experiments on representative nonlinear and chaotic systems demonstrate that the LAE-EnKF yields more accurate and stable assimilation than the standard EnKF and related latent-space methods, while maintaining comparable computational cost and data-driven.

</details>


### [155] [Implementation of Quantum Implicit Neural Representation in Deterministic and Probabilistic Autoencoders for Image Reconstruction/Generation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06755)
*Saadet Müzehher Eren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出量子隐式神经表示（QINR）作为解码器的混合量子-经典自编码器（QINR-AE）与变分自编码器（QINR-VAE），用于 28×28 图像的重建与生成。经典 CNN 编码器压缩输入为 8 维隐向量，6 量子比特数据重上传（data reuploading）电路配以可学习角度缩放的参数量子层（含 CZ 纠缠）作为解码器，将隐向量映射为像素级 logits。重建损失用 BCEWithLogits，VAE 额外加 KL 正则并采用 β/capacity 调度防止后验坍塌。在 MNIST、E-MNIST、Fashion-MNIST 上以每类 500 样本逐类训练，QINR-VAE 生成图像比 PQWGAN、Quantum AnoGAN、QINR-QGAN 更清晰、更多样（模式坍塌更少），FID 更低；QINR-AE 重建边界锐利、指标良好。作者明确不主张量子优势，仅将 QINR 解码器定位为紧凑的谱特征生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有量子生成模型（QAE、QVAE、QGAN、PQWGAN、Quantum AnoGAN、QINR-QGAN、OQIDDM）虽将参数化量子电路引入生成任务，但普遍存在两类问题：一是 GAN 类基于对抗训练，生成器易陷入模式坍塌（mode collapse），只能产出极少且高度相似的样本，类内多样性低；二是 QINR 目前主要用作 GAN 生成器（QINR-QGAN）或扩散模型的去噪后验（OQIDDM），其在自编码器/变分自编码器框架中作为解码器的潜力尚未被系统研究（Ma et al. 明确建议未来将 QINR 用于 AE）。同时经典深度模型虽有效，但研究者希望评估量子电路能否提供更丰富的谱特性与更高表达效率。据此，作者提出 QINR-AE 与 QINR-VAE：利用数据重上传电路的傅里叶型谱特性，把低维隐向量解码成富含周期与高频特征的图像，从而在极少训练数据下同时获得清晰度与多样性，并检验其能否缓解 QGAN 系的模式坍塌问题。

Method: 架构为量子-经典混合：编码器为四层 3×3/stride 2 卷积 + BatchNorm + LeakyReLU 的 CNN（MNIST 通道 1→32→64→128→256，展平 1024），展平后接全连接；AE 输出确定性隐向量 z（d_z=8），VAE 输出 μ 与 log σ²，经重参数化 z=μ+ε⊙exp(0.5 logσ²) 采样。解码器含两个线性块（中间夹 BatchNorm）与可学习压缩：v=BatchNorm(W1 z+b1)，h=W2 v+b2 映射为 6 个量子比特的角度。量子部分为数据重上传电路：L=2 个编码层（S^(ℓ)(h)=⊗ R_Z(ξ_i^ℓ h_i)，含每比特每层可学习缩放 ξ）与 L+1=3 个参数层（每层 Rot(α,β,γ)⊗ 与 CZ 纠缠，两个配对簇 E1、E2），测量默认 Pauli-Z 期望值得到 6 维特征，再经 128→512→784（AE 为 256→512→784）线性层输出像素 logits。损失：AE/VAE 均用 BCEWithLogits 作为重建损失（输入归一化到 [-1,1]，目标 (x+1)/2）；VAE 额外用 KL(q_φ(z|x)‖N(0,I))，简单数据集用 L=L_rec+β(t)L_KL（β warm-up，MNIST β=1, n_β=5），复杂数据集用容量控制 L=L_rec+γ|L_KL−C(t)|（E-MNIST: C_max=10, γ=20, freebits=0.25；Fashion-MNIST: C_max=12, γ=10, freebits=0.5）。优化采用 Adam 双参数组（经典层 lr_cls=0.002，量子层 lr_q=0.0002/0.0005）、全局 L2 梯度裁剪；VAE 训练 45 epoch，AE 25 epoch，batch 32。实验为 6 比特无噪声模拟（PennyLane + PyTorch，TRUBA 集群 CPU 2 核、2–4GB RAM、≤12 小时，无 GPU），逐类训练，每类仅取官方训练集前 500 个样本；对照 PQWGAN、Quantum AnoGAN、QINR-QGAN，评价指标为 FID（Inception-V3 特征）、SSIM、PSNR、余弦相似度。附录含 CelebA（78×64，L=3,K=3，MSE 损失）、非逐类训练下可学习全局角度缩放 s=e^ρ 与多重读出（⟨X⟩,⟨Y⟩,⟨Z⟩,⟨Z_i Z_{i+1}⟩）、以及与参数量匹配线性解码器的受控消融。

Result: 定性：PQWGAN 背景噪声多、图像模糊；Quantum AnoGAN 与 QINR-QGAN 更干净但类内几乎无差异（明显模式坍塌）；QINR-VAE 生成图像更锐利、类内多样性更高，能区分书写风格（如带/不带横杠的 7、宽窄不同的 0），Fashion-MNIST 上能分辨短袖/无袖与灰度过渡；QINR-AE 重建的 MNIST/E-MNIST/Fashion-MNIST 图像结构完整、边界清晰。定量：QINR-VAE 的 FID 在 MNIST 为 110–144、E-MNIST 为 106–182、Fashion-MNIST 为 86–214，均显著低于 PQWGAN（约 254–433）、Quantum AnoGAN 与 QINR-QGAN（约 139–318）；重建类 SSIM 上 QINR-VAE/QINR-AE 明显优于三种 QGAN（如 MNIST 数字约 0.51–0.86 对 0.18–0.47），PSNR 亦更高（约 13–19 dB 对 10–15 dB）。损失曲线稳定收敛并进入平台，E-MNIST 因容量控制 KL 波动但幅度递减、整体下降。数据量从每类 500 增至 5000 时指标明显改善（Fashion-MNIST T-shirt FID 147.82→107.77，SSIM/PSNR 同步上升）。附录：CelebA 输出规整但偏灰淡；多重读出优于单一 ⟨Z⟩ 读出（多项指标提升）；消融显示经典线性解码器 FID 更低（多样性更高、图像不连续），而 QINR 解码器视觉完整性与连续性更好，即以多样性换视觉质量。量子参数量对比：QINR-AE/VAE 仅 120 个量子参数，少于 PQWGAN（MNIST/E-MNIST 2016、Fashion-MNIST 3600）与 Quantum AnoGAN（1008），多于 QINR-QGAN（72）。

Conclusion: 在该受限实验设定下（6 比特、无噪声模拟、逐类 500 样本、8 维隐变量、120 量子参数），QINR-AE/VAE 能稳定收敛并以较少参数完成清晰图像重建与生成；QINR-VAE 相比 PQWGAN、Quantum AnoGAN、QINR-QGAN 表现出更少模式坍塌证据与更高的类内多样性，同时 FID 更优，故可作为 QML 图像生成的可行候选。附录结果支持 QINR 可扩展至 MNIST 家族之外（CelebA），并说明多重读出与可学习全局角度缩放有助优化。局限与展望：作者明确不主张相对优化经典解码器的量子优势，将 QINR 定位为紧凑的非线性谱特征生成器；尚未做 barren plateau 标度分析，未在含噪硬件或真实量子设备上验证，指标绝对值仍不理想，CelebA 输出偏灰淡，多样性与锐度有改进空间；未来工作包括更多数据集、与优化卷积解码器的系统对比、更深/更多比特下的梯度标度研究、真实噪声与量子硬件执行。

Abstract: We propose a quantum implicit neural representation (QINR)-based autoencoder (AE) and variational autoencoder (VAE) for image reconstruction and generation tasks. Our purpose is to demonstrate that the QINR in VAEs and AEs can transform information from the latent space into highly rich, periodic, and high-frequency features. Additionally, we aim to show that the QINR-VAE can be more stable than various quantum generative adversarial network (QGAN) models in image generation because it can address the low diversity problem. Our quantum-classical hybrid models consist of a classical convolutional neural network (CNN) encoder and a quantum-based QINR decoder. We train the QINR-AE/VAE with binary cross-entropy with logits (BCEWithLogits) as the reconstruction loss. For the QINR-VAE, we additionally employ Kullback-Leibler divergence for latent regularization with beta/capacity scheduling to prevent posterior collapse. We introduce learnable angle-scaling in data reuploading to address optimization challenges. We test our models on the MNIST, E-MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST datasets to reconstruct and generate images. Our results demonstrate that the QINR structure in VAE can produce a wider variety of images with a small amount of data than various generative models that have been studied. We observe that the generated and reconstructed images from the QINR-VAE/AE are clear with sharp boundaries and details. Overall, we find that the addition of QINR-based quantum layers into the AE/VAE frameworks enhances the performance of reconstruction and generation with a constrained set of parameters.

</details>


### [156] [Learning Unbiased Cluster Descriptors for Interpretable Imbalanced Concept Drift Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06757)
*Yiqun Zhang,Zhanpei Huang,Mingjie Zhao,Chuyao Zhang,Yang Lu,Yuzhu Ji,Fangqing Gu,An Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对非平衡概念的流数据概念漂移检测问题，提出了ICD3方法，通过多分布粒度搜索检测不平衡概念，并为每个概念训练单独的一类分类器独立监测漂移，从而避免大簇对小簇的掩盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的概念漂移数据通常是非平衡的，大簇的统计特征会掩盖小簇分布的漂移（即"掩码效应"），而现有方法仅在平衡概念假设下检测整体漂移，无法回答小概念的位置及其漂移检测问题。

Method: 提出ICD3方法，包含两个核心步骤：1）采用多分布粒度搜索（multi-distribution-granular search）有效捕获大小概念的分布；2）为每个已识别概念训练一个一类分类器（One-Cluster Classifier, OCC），独立监测其在后续数据块中的潜在漂移。

Result: ICD3能够准确定位漂移的概念，对概念不平衡比例的变化具有鲁棒性，在多个基准数据集上的综合消融实验表明其性能优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: ICD3通过独立检测每个概念的漂移，避免了大簇的主导效应，实现了高度可解释的漂移定位，为非平衡流数据中的概念漂移检测提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Unlabeled streaming data are usually collected to describe dynamic systems, where concept drift detection is a vital prerequisite to understanding the evolution of systems. However, the drifting concepts are usually imbalanced in most real cases, which brings great challenges to drift detection. That is, the dominant statistics of large clusters can easily mask the drifting of small cluster distributions (also called small concepts), which is known as the `masking effect'. Considering that most existing approaches only detect the overall existence of drift under the assumption of balanced concepts, two critical problems arise: 1) where the small concept is, and 2) how to detect its drift. To address the challenging concept drift detection for imbalanced data, we propose Imbalanced Cluster Descriptor-based Drift Detection (ICD3) approach that is unbiased to the imbalanced concepts. This approach first detects imbalanced concepts by employing a newly designed multi-distribution-granular search, which ensures that the distribution of both small and large concepts is effectively captured. Subsequently, it trains a One-Cluster Classifier (OCC) for each identified concept to carefully monitor their potential drifts in the upcoming data chunks. Since the detection is independently performed for each concept, the dominance of large clusters is thus circumvented. ICD3 demonstrates highly interpretability by specifically locating the drifted concepts, and is robust to the changing of the imbalance ratio of concepts. Comprehensive experiments with multi-aspect ablation studies conducted on various benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of ICD3 against the state-of-the-art counterparts.

</details>


### [157] [Enhancing SHAP Explainability for Diagnostic and Prognostic ML Models in Alzheimer Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06758)
*Pablo Guillén,Enrique Frias-Martinez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多层次可解释性框架，用于评估SHAP解释在阿尔茨海默病诊断和预后模型中的稳健性和可迁移性。通过在NACC数据集上训练4个诊断和4个预后模型，研究验证了SHAP解释的一致性、稳定性和跨任务可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病诊断和预后虽广泛使用机器学习模型，但临床应用受限。原因包括：1) 需要技术专业知识；2) 缺乏可信且一致性的模型解释。现有SHAP研究仅关注孤立任务，缺乏关于解释在不同疾病阶段、模型架构或预测目标下稳健性的证据。

Method: 1) 提出多层次可解释性框架，测量解释的连贯性、稳定性和一致性；2) 整合三方面评估：模型内一致性指标（特征重要性与SHAP之间）、跨AD边界的SHAP稳定性、诊断与预后间的SHAP跨任务一致性；3) 使用AutoML在NACC数据集上优化分类器，训练4个诊断和4个预后模型覆盖标准AD进展阶段；4) 使用相关性指标、top-k特征重叠、SHAP符号一致性、领域级贡献比评估稳定性。

Result: 认知和功能标记在诊断和预后模型的SHAP解释中均占主导地位。诊断和预后模型间SHAP一致性很高，达到100%符号稳定性，解释幅度变化极小。领域级贡献保持稳定，遗传特征仅在预后中略有增加。

Conclusion: SHAP解释可以通过定量方法验证其稳健性和可迁移性，为临床医生提供更可靠的机器学习预测解释，推动ML模型在AD临床诊断中的实际应用。
