### [184] [Diffusion Controller: Framework, Algorithms and Parameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06981)
*Tong Yang,Moonkyung Ryu,Chih-Wei Hsu,Guy Tennenholtz,Yuejie Chi,Craig Boutilier,Bo Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一框架 Diffusion Controller (DiffCon)：把反向扩散采样视为（广义）线性可解 MDP 中的"仅状态"随机控制问题，控制通过对预训练反向转移核做重加权实现，并以 f-散度作为控制代价。由此推导出 f-散度正则化的策略梯度/PPO 更新与由正则项决定的奖励加权回归目标（KL 下有极小点保持性保证）；并证明最优 score 可分解为"固定预训练基线 + 轻量控制修正"，据此提出以暴露的中间去噪输出（反向均值 μ₀）为输入的旁路网络参数化，在冻结骨干的 gray-box 场景下微调 SD v1.4，偏好对齐胜率显著优于 gray-box 基线乃至白盒 LoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可控扩散生成目前依赖一堆彼此割裂的启发式方法：推理期引导（CFG 及其变体）、训练期参数高效适配（LoRA/DiffFit/ControlNet 等）、以及基于人类反馈的 RL 微调（DDPO、DPOK、DRaFT、DPO 类目标），缺乏一个能统一解释"如何在采样过程中施加控制"的理论视角，导致各类目标函数、正则项、模型结构选择缺乏统一原则。本文目标是建立控制论视角，把扩散微调统一表述为对反向马尔可夫链转移核的最优控制，从而为各种已有实践提供共同语言与可推导的算法模板。

Method: **框架**：把反向扩散采样刻画为 (广义) LS-MDP。状态 s_t=(x_t,c,t)，控制 u_t 通过指数倾斜重加权预训练反向转移核 p_{0,t} 得到受控核 P_{u,t}=p_{0,t}·exp(u_t)，值函数含 f-散数控制代价 -τ·D_f(P_{u,t}‖p_{0,t})（KL 为特例）。由于最优核为能量型、难以直接采样，改为学习可实现的 score 函数 ε*，最小化噪声预测回归损失 L_org(ε; p_{u*})。

**RLFT 算法**：设终端奖励 r(x_T,c)。①策略梯度（Proposition 1）：∇_θJ_θ = E[Σ_t ∇_θ log p_{θ,t}(x_{t+1}|x_t,c)·A_{θ,t+1}]，其中软优势 A 含 -τf'(ζ) 项（ζ = p_θ/p_0 为密度比），KL 时退化为 A = V_{t+1} - τ log ζ - V_t；由此给出 PPO 风格裁剪更新（τ=0 归约为 DDPO 的 REINFORCE 梯度，KL 下与 DPOK 梯度接近但正则项形式不同，DPOK 是逐步 KL，本文是逐步 log 比的求和）。②奖励加权损失（Theorem 1）：通过轨迹级 f-散数正则化问题 max_P E_P[r] - τD_f(P‖P₀) 的 KKT 条件，得到权重 w_f(r,τ)=[(f')⁻¹((r-b_{f,τ}(c))/τ)]₊ 的加权 score-matching 损失；KL 时 w=exp(r/τ) 且 p̃* = p_{u*}（极小点保持性保证），α-散数时为多项式权重 [1+(α-1)(r-b)/τ]₊^{1/(α-1)}。

**参数化（Proposition 2）**：KL 情形下证明最优 score 满足 ε* = (1-z*)ε₀ - (√(1-ᾱ_t)/β_t)(z* x_t + √α_t(1-z*)h* - √α_t δ₀)，其中 h* 与 logit(z*/(1-z*)) 可用共享的随机傅里叶特征基 φ_ω(x_t,c,t)=(cos,sin)(ωᵀμ₀/√β̃_t) 的线性组合近似（Bernstein 界保证 O_p(M^{-1/2}) 误差），δ₀ 受 q_{0,t} 与 p_{0,t} 的 TV 距离控制。据此设计旁路网络 s_θ=(z_{θ1},h_{θ2})：ε_θ = ε₀ + λ_model·s_θ(μ₀(x_t,c,t), c, t)，输入用反向均值 μ₀ 而非 x_t，结构上类比以 μ₀ 为输入的交叉注意力；最后一层零初始化以保持预训练输出。该参数化与学习算法正交，可用于 SFT、RLFT。

**实验设置**：Stable Diffusion v1.4，冻结 text encoder 与 VAE，仅微调 latent score；CFG=7.5，p_drop=0.1，Adam。三种算法：SFT（HPD v2 winner 图）、RWL（HPS v2 奖励，多项式权重 τ=5e-4、α=1+τ、baseline 取首批平均奖励）、PPO（KL 正则在线 PPO，τ_KL=1e-4）。五种结构：DiffCon（gray-box, 1.2e7）、DiffCon-Naive（gray-box 基线，输入 x_t、直接加性残差）、LoRA（white-box, r=16, 1.7e7）、DiffCon-J（LoRA r=4 + DiffCon 联合训练）、DiffCon-S（分别训练、评测时组合）。指标为 HPS-v2 胜率（对比预训练模型），并附 CLIP / CLIP-Aesthetics / PickScore 及人工评测。

Result: **主结果（HPS-v2 对预训练模型的胜率）**：SFT(step 1000) / RWL(2000) / PPO(2400)。DiffCon(gray-box, 1.2e7)：0.6667 / 0.6815 / 0.6957；DiffCon-Naive：0.5655 / 0.5060 / 0.5201；LoRA(white-box, 1.7e7)：0.5766 / 0.6109 / 0.9048；DiffCon-J：0.6964 / 0.6555 / 0.9353；DiffCon-S：0.6964 / 0.7091 / 0.9315。即在 SFT/RWL 下，gray-box 的 DiffCon 以更少参数超过需要访问模型内部的 LoRA；PPO 下 white-box 变体胜率 >0.93（DiffCon-Naive 明显落后，说明结构化门控修正而非"任意加性残差"才是收益来源）。

**其他发现**：CLIP、CLIP-Aesthetics、PickScore 基本未被牺牲（对齐提升未损害通用质量指标）；测试期增大侧网络引导强度 λ_model 可进一步提升 SFT/RWL 表现，且有生成样例佐证；RWL 的多项式加权在同等设置下优于 DPOK 的启发式奖励加权，样本复杂度仅为其 1/4；消融显示 τ_KL=1e-4、τ_RWL=5e-4 最优（KL 惩罚过小则奖励不涨，τ_RWL 过小会因权重计算出现 NaN 而不稳定）；LoRA 在 RLFT 下偏好更大学习率 1e-4 而 DiffCon 偏好 1e-5；侧网络结构以 2 个 DownBlock2D + 2 个 UpBlock2D 最佳；以 μ₀ 而非 x_t 作为输入在 RWL 上更好。人工评测（50+ 评分者、50 prompts、best-of-4）同样支持 DiffCon 系列优于对应基线。

Conclusion: DiffCon 提供了统一的可控扩散生成控制论框架：把反向采样视为（广义）LS-MDP 中的仅状态随机控制，控制以 f-散数为代价重加权预训练反向动力学；由此得到可落地的 f-散数正则策略梯度/PPO 与带极小点保持性的奖励加权回归目标，并揭示"最优 score = 预训练基线 + 轻量控制修正"这一有原则的模型形式，从而导出以中间去噪输出为条件的旁路控制器参数化，在冻结骨干的 gray-box 条件下即可有效微调，显著改善文本到图像对齐的质量—效率折中。局限在于：一般 f-散数下 p̃* 与 p_{u*} 不一致，权重形式无严格闭式等价（仅作代理目标）；理论侧依赖 f-散数正则化与终端奖励等设定；实验仅在 SD v1.4 的单一奖励模型上验证。作者提出后续将框架扩展到个性化、安全对齐与迁移学习等更广的扩散控制场景。

Abstract: Controllable diffusion generation often relies on various heuristics that are seemingly disconnected without a unified understanding. We bridge this gap with Diffusion Controller (DiffCon), a unified control-theoretic view that casts reverse diffusion sampling as state-only stochastic control within (generalized) linearly-solvable Markov Decision Processes (LS-MDPs). Under this framework, control acts by reweighting the pretrained reverse-time transition kernels, balancing terminal objectives against an $f$-divergence cost. From the resulting optimality conditions, we derive practical reinforcement learning methods for diffusion fine-tuning: (i) f-divergence-regularized policy-gradient updates, including a PPO-style rule, and (ii) a regularizer-determined reward-weighted regression objective with a minimizer-preservation guarantee under the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. The LS-MDP framework further implies a principled model form: the optimal score decomposes into a fixed pretrained baseline plus a lightweight control correction, motivating a side-network parameterization conditioned on exposed intermediate denoising outputs, enabling effective gray-box adaptation with a frozen backbone. Experiments on Stable Diffusion v1.4 across supervised and reward-driven finetuning show consistent gains in preference-alignment win rates and improved quality-efficiency trade-offs versus gray-box baselines and even the parameter-efficient white-box adapter LoRA.

</details>


### [185] [Combinatorial Allocation Bandits with Nonlinear Arm Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07005)
*Yuki Shibukawa,Koichi Tanaka,Yuta Saito,Shinji Ito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的在线学习问题——组合分配 bandits (CAB)，用于解决匹配平台中仅最大化匹配数量导致热门参与者过度集中、其他参与者不满并流失的问题。CAB 的目标是最大化"臂满意度"而非仅仅获得正向反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在匹配平台中，传统方法仅最大化匹配数量，导致匹配集中在高人气参与者身上，这会引起其他参与者的不满并导致流失，降低平台利润。需要一个新框架来平衡匹配效率与参与者满意度。

Method: 1) 提出 CAB 问题：每轮有 N 个用户和 K 个臂，为每个用户分配一个臂，观察 GLM 反馈；2) 设计 UCB 算法；3) 设计 TS 算法

Result: UCB 算法获得了近似 regret 上界，与现有下界匹配；TS 算法也给出了近似 regret 上界；合成数据实验验证了有效性

Conclusion: 成功将臂满意度概念引入组合分配 bandits 框架，为匹配平台的公平性和可持续性提供了新的研究思路

Abstract: A matching platform is a system that matches different types of participants, such as companies and job-seekers. In such a platform, merely maximizing the number of matches can result in matches being concentrated on highly popular participants, which may increase dissatisfaction among other participants, such as companies, and ultimately lead to their churn, reducing the platform's profit opportunities. To address this issue, we propose a novel online learning problem, Combinatorial Allocation Bandits (CAB), which incorporates the notion of *arm satisfaction*. In CAB, at each round $t=1,\dots,T$, the learner observes $K$ feature vectors corresponding to $K$ arms for each of $N$ users, assigns each user to an arm, and then observes feedback following a generalized linear model (GLM). Unlike prior work, the learner's objective is not to maximize the number of positive feedback, but rather to maximize the arm satisfaction. For CAB, we provide an upper confidence bound algorithm that achieves an approximate regret upper bound, which matches the existing lower bound for the special case. Furthermore, we propose a TS algorithm and provide an approximate regret upper bound. Finally, we conduct experiments on synthetic data to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms compared to other methods.

</details>


### [186] [RESCHED: Rethinking Flexible Job Shop Scheduling from a Transformer-based Architecture with Simplified States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07020)
*Xiangjie Xiao,Cong Zhang,Wen Song,Zhiguang Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReSched 是一个面向柔性作业车间调度（FJSP）的极简深度强化学习框架：把状态压缩到仅 4 个特征（工序可用时间、机器可用时间、加工时长、最小时长），并用「RoPE 自注意力 + 边特征交叉注意力 + 自连接交叉注意力」的双分支 Transformer 替代 GNN，在 FJSP 上取得 SOTA（16 个同分布设定中 14 个最优），并零改动泛化到 JSSP 与 FFSP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 FJSP 深度强化学习方法存在三类问题：(1) 状态表示过度工程化，通常需要 20 个以上的手工特征（论文中以 DANIEL 的 26 个特征为例），存在大量冗余，且需要逐步维护自由时间、当前时间等辅助变量以支持启发式动作剪枝；(2) 将历史调度构造信息注入当前状态反而会损害学习；(3) 架构上多依赖 GAT 等图网络，其归纳偏置刚性——长程依赖需深层堆叠、线性注意力难以刻画非局部调度交互，同时启发式剪枝损害策略泛化性并产生次优解。作者据此提出核心问题：能否仅基于「马尔可夫充分」的极简状态、配合通用但表达力强的架构，构造可自然泛化到 FJSP 各变体的通用构造式策略。

Method: **1. 状态表示与 MDP 形式化**：重新推导 FJSP 的完工时间递推式（FT_ij = max(FT_i(j-1), AT^m_t) + D_ij^m），并证明「状态依赖最优性」（命题 1：到达同一状态的两条轨迹共享完全相同的剩余可行解集），从而无需保存历史。状态仅含 4 个特征：工序可用时间、机器可用时间（均为相对时间，每步减去全局最小可用时间）、O2M 边上的加工时长、候选机器上的最小时长。依赖关系与机器可行集不作为特征，而编码进图结构：O2O 采用「后向」边并加入跳边（hop connection）直达所有后继工序；O2M 保留边及其时长。已调度工序及其连边在每步后移除，形成新的子问题。

**2. 动作/转移/奖励**：动作为选择 (工序, 机器) 对，仅施加 O2O 优先级这一硬约束，不做任何启发式掩码或动作空间剪枝；环境确定性转移；奖励为估计下界 makespan 的负增量 r_t = -(FT_max_bar(s_{t+1}) - FT_max_bar(s_t))。

**3. 双分支 Transformer 编码器**：工序分支用自注意力建模 O2O，并引入 RoPE 旋转位置编码以显式表达作业内相对距离（跨作业位置无意义，故仅在作业内应用）；机器分支用交叉注意力，区别于以往「调整注意力分数」的间接方式，这里把边特征（时长）直接嵌入到 value 向量中（共享投影权重以控制参数量）；并提出「self-based cross-attention」——让机器节点在注意力中对自身表示分配一个可学习权重，缓解操作数远多于机器数（常 >10:1）导致的信息稀释。策略头为 3 层 MLP，对每个可行工序-机器对打分并 softmax，无全局嵌入。

**4. 训练**：主文用 REINFORCE（回报减均值作基线），以隔离状态/架构设计的贡献，遵循 AM/POMO 的 NCO 惯例；附录另实现 PPO 版本（GAE + 裁剪目标，γ=1, λ=0.98, ε=0.2），critic 共享编码器。2 层 Transformer、8 头、隐藏维 128、FFN 512，Adam lr=5e-5，2000 epoch。

Result: **FJSP**：在 SD1/SD2 同分布测试的 16 个设定中 14 个最优；SD2 15×10 上相对 DANIEL 将 gap 降低约 30%（18.14%→9.81%），SD1 15×10/20×10 上将 DANIEL 的 gap 减半。跨规模泛化（30×10、40×10）8 例中 6 例领先，并在 SD2 40×10 上比 OR-Tools 好 7.61%（-7.61% vs -6.60%）。在 Brandimarte/Hurink 基准（仅用 SD1 训练）上，greedy+sampling 共 8 例中 7 例最优；相对 2SGA/OR-Tools（每例 1800–3600s）推理时间极短且可用采样解码免费提升。

**JSSP**：仅用 10×10 合成实例训练，在 Taillard 基准 8 种规模中 7 种优于 L2D 与 RL-GNN，甚至超过其同分布表现；DMU 基准与合成集同样领先（Opt. Rate 4.3% vs L2D 9.4%@100×20）。

**FFSP**：仅训 20 规模模型，在 20/50/100 各设定下多数优于 MatNet（MatNet 需按规模单独训练），如 FFSP50 采样 49.65% vs 51.40%。

**消融与鲁棒性**：DANIEL 特征消融显示 26→5 个特征性能基本不变，印证极简状态可行；ReSched 六项组件（O2O 连接方式、相对可用时间、去 current time、RoPE、edge-in-attention、self-based CA）单独移除均导致平均 gap 上升（+1.25%~+3.54%）；4 个随机种子间波动 <1%。奖励消融表明 Δ-makespan 奖励会过拟合合成分布（开放基准平均 gap 9.56%→12.19%），下界奖励泛化更好；折扣因子 γ=0.99/1.0 不敏感。PPO 版本在大预算下同分布平均 gap 9.02%、OOD 1.00%，优于 DANIEL 的 17.39%/7.29%，且同等数据量下收敛更快（20 分钟 vs 18–21 分钟）。附录给出 KV Cache 的理论加速分析（注意力计算由 O(L(n³+mn²)) 降至 O(Ln²(1+m))，可减 10–40 倍），但尚未实现。

Conclusion: ReSched 证明「极简、马尔可夫充分的状态 + 表达力强的通用 Transformer 架构」足以替代重特征工程与图归纳偏置，既能建立 FJSP 的新 SOTA，又能在不改动架构的前提下零成本迁移到 JSSP、FFSP 甚至 DAG 任务卸载等场景，提供了可扩展的通用调度框架。作者坦承的局限：当前仅建模 O2O 与单向 O2M 交互，尚未显式引入机器到操作的（M2O）反馈；且在接近纯 JSSP 的实例上（如 Hurink edata，平均每工序仅 1.15 台可行机器）优势缩小，原因是 O2M 分支的建模容量在固定路由下信息量下降——这是为通用性付出的权衡。

Abstract: Neural approaches to the Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP), particularly those based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL), have gained growing attention in recent years. However, existing methods rely on complex feature-engineered state representations (i.e., often requiring more than 20 handcrafted features) and graph-biased neural architectures. To reduce modeling complexity and advance a more generalizable framework for FJSP, we introduce \textsc{ReSched}, a minimalist DRL framework that rethinks both the scheduling formulation and model design. First, by revisiting the Markov Decision Process (MDP) formulation of FJSP, we condense the state space to just four essential features, eliminating historical dependencies through a subproblem-based perspective. Second, we employ Transformer blocks with dot-product attention, augmented by three lightweight but effective architectural modifications tailored to scheduling tasks. Extensive experiments show that \textsc{ReSched} outperforms classical dispatching rules and state-of-the-art DRL methods on FJSP. Moreover, \textsc{ReSched} also generalizes well to the Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP) and the Flexible Flow Shop Scheduling Problem (FFSP), achieving competitive performance against neural baselines specifically designed for these variants.

</details>


### [187] [Resource-Adaptive Federated Text Generation with Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07027)
*Jiayi Wang,John Gounley,Heidi Hanson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对跨筒仓联邦学习中计算异构性和隐私保护的挑战，提出一种灵活参与框架，让强客户端执行差分隐私联邦微调，弱客户端通过轻量级差分隐私投票机制贡献合成文本，仅需单轮通信即可整合所有参与者贡献，提升分布对齐和下游鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨筒仓联邦学习中敏感文本数据受隐私法规限制停留在本地，重复训练通信密集且隐私要求高；预训练大语言模型常因领域偏移失败，联邦微调受计算异构性阻碍——只有资源丰富的客户端能更新模型，弱客户端被排除，放大数据偏斜和差分隐私噪声的负面影响。

Method: 提出一种灵活参与框架，强客户端执行差分隐私联邦微调，弱客户端通过轻量级差分隐私投票机制贡献合成文本；应用控制代码表示各客户端数据比例，约束投票至语义一致子集。

Result: 实验表明该框架在差分隐私和异构性条件下提升了分布对齐和下游任务鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该框架通过两阶段方法仅需一轮通信即可完成，有效整合了所有参与者的贡献，在差分隐私和异构性条件下提升了分布对齐和下游任务鲁棒性。

Abstract: In cross-silo federated learning (FL), sensitive text datasets remain confined to local organizations due to privacy regulations, making repeated training for each downstream task both communication-intensive and privacy-demanding. A promising alternative is to generate differentially private (DP) synthetic datasets that approximate the global distribution and can be reused across tasks. However, pretrained large language models (LLMs) often fail under domain shift, and federated finetuning is hindered by computational heterogeneity: only resource-rich clients can update the model, while weaker clients are excluded, amplifying data skew and the adverse effects of DP noise. We propose a flexible participation framework that adapts to client capacities. Strong clients perform DP federated finetuning, while weak clients contribute through a lightweight DP voting mechanism that refines synthetic text. To ensure the synthetic data mirrors the global dataset, we apply control codes (e.g., labels, topics, metadata) that represent each client's data proportions and constrain voting to semantically coherent subsets. This two-phase approach requires only a single round of communication for weak clients and integrates contributions from all participants. Experiments show that our framework improves distribution alignment and downstream robustness under DP and heterogeneity.

</details>


### [188] [Interpretable Maximum Margin Deep Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07073)
*Zhiji Yang,Mei Huang,Xinyu Li,Xianli Pan,Qi Wang,Jianhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可解释的最大间隔深度异常检测方法 IMD-AD：针对 Deep SVDD 的"超球塌缩"、"超球参数靠启发式设定"和"可解释性不足"三大缺陷，引入少量标注异常样本与最大间隔目标函数，证明超球中心/半径与网络末层权重的等价关系（w=-2c, R²=1-b, wᵀw=4），从而把超球参数嵌入网络实现端到端联合优化，并借助拉格朗日乘子法给出高效训练算法；在图像（MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10）、表格（ON/Card/BC）与合成数据集上 AUC 平均排名第 1，兼具可视化决策边界与 Grad-CAM 归因等内生可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Deep SVDD 作为主流深度单类方法存在三个相互关联的缺陷：(1) 仅用正常样本训练时，高表达力网络会把所有输入映射到同一点，造成超球塌缩（hypersphere collapse），决策函数退化为常数；(2) 超球中心 c 通常用初始前向传播后特征均值、半径 R 用分位数启发式估计，并非模型最优解，直接损害检测精度；(3) 模型是黑箱，缺少机制层面的可解释性与可操作的可视化解释。已有改进方法（DASVDD、DOHSC 加正则/正交约束，DROCC、PLAD 用对抗合成近流形负样本）各自只解决部分问题，且未同时实现超球参数的端到端可解释学习。作者希望在一个统一框架内同时实现：防塌缩、超球参数端到端学习、明确的可解释性与可视化输出。此外，经典浅层 SVDD 的相关理论（ν 参数含义）缺乏系统阐释，也促使作者补充超参数的理论刻画。

Method: 1) 最大间隔目标（式3）：以 R̄=R²、ρ̄=ρ² 重参数化，正常样本损失 max{0, d_i²−R̄}，异常样本损失 max{0, R̄+ρ̄−d_i²}，整体最小化 R̄−vρ̄，即最小化内球体积同时最大化间隔；测试分数用 s(x)=||φ(x)−c||²−T²，T 取内外球半径的中点，因此即使内球塌缩（R=0），T≠0，天然容忍塌缩。\n2) 末层参数等价与嵌入：展开 ||φ−c||²−R̄ 得 wᵀφ+b+||φ||²，令 c=−w/2、R̄=1−b，并归一化 cᵀc=1（即 wᵀw=4），得式(10)，约束 wᵀw=4、b<1、ρ̄>0；超球参数由此完全由网络末层权重/偏置承载，中心与半径可反向传播学习，且末层权重可解释为超球中心与半径。\n3) 端到端训练（Algorithm 1）：用拉格朗日乘子法把约束问题转为无约束的 min-max 对偶问题，拉格朗日函数 L₂ 由原目标加 α(wᵀw−4)+β(b−1)−γρ̄ 组成；参数 θ={W,w,b,ρ̄} 用 Adam 反向传播最小化，乘子 α、β、γ 每 k 个 epoch 用投影梯度上升更新（β、γ 非负截断），验证损失连续 k 轮不下降则早停。\n4) 理论：ν-Property 定理给出 (ν+1)ν₁ 是正常样本越界比例上界、νν₂ 是异常样本落入大球比例上界，并要求 0<ν₁≤1/(ν+1)、0<ν₂≤1/ν，从而给出可解释的超参数选取规则。\n5) 实验设置：8 个基线（IF、KDE、OCSVM、SVDD、SSLM、AE、Deep SVDD、DROCC），每类取 10% 异常样本参与训练，图像用 CNN（MNIST/F-MNIST: CNN×2+FC×3；CIFAR-10: CNN×3+FC×3），表格与合成用 FC×3；Adam 初始学习率 1e-4、MultiStepLR、最多 200 epoch、batch 50（表格/合成）或 150（图像）、λ=5e-6、ν/ν₁/ν₂ 网格搜索。消融：Deep SVDD、D-AD（+异常样本）、MD-AD（+间隔）、IMD-AD（+可解释参数化）。

Result: 图像数据集：IMD-AD 平均 AUC 在 Fashion-MNIST 96.45%（超次优 OCSVM 3.93%）、CIFAR-10 83.40%（超次优 DROCC 9.62%）、MNIST 99.72%（DROCC 100.00% 仅高 0.28%）；平均排名 1.3，优于 DROCC(3.7)、OCSVM(4.0)。表格数据集：ON 平均 94.31%（超 SSLM 4.82%）、Card 95.26%（超 SSLM 3.90%）、BC 96.43%（略低于 SSLM 98.42%，差 1.99%）；平均排名 1.3，SSLM 1.7 次之，而 Deep SVDD/DROCC/AE 在表格数据上明显失效（Deep SVDD 在 ON 仅 67.02%）。统计检验：Friedman 检验配合事后 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验与 Nemenyi 临界差异图显示 IMD-AD 在图像与表格两类数据上均排名第一，与所有对比方法差异显著（多数 p<0.001，仅 SSLM 表格数据 p=0.0237）。可解释性验证：合成 Spiral/Moons 与 MNIST 上可视化出内球、外球与居中决策边界，训练约 40 epoch 后收敛，R 单调减小、ρ 单调增大；Grad-CAM 显示低分正常样本呈闭合规则"0"形、高分异常样本呈细长"1"形。ν-Property 经验验证中所有经验越界比例均严格低于理论上界。消融显示三层递进贡献（Deep SVDD < D-AD < MD-AD < IMD-AD）。

Conclusion: IMD-AD 通过"少量标注异常 + 最大间隔 + 超球参数末层等价嵌入"三者结合，在单一端到端框架内同时解决超球塌缩、超球参数启发式估计与可解释性不足：最大间隔目标天然容忍塌缩（决策半径 T 不为零），末层权重与超球中心/半径的等价关系使超球参数可随网络联合学习并直接可视化，ν-Property 为 ν/ν₁/ν₂ 提供可解释的取值范围依据。实验表明其在图像与表格基准上平均排名第一，且优于 Deep SVDD、DROCC 等强基线，同时提供边界可视化与 Grad-CAM 归因等决策诊断。局限与未来方向：方法依赖少量标注异常样本（属监督/半监督设定，需说明标注成本与实际获取难度）；实验以 AUC 为主、基线未含最新深度重建/流形方法与大规模工业数据；作者提出将方法推广至更多异常检测场景并进一步完善可解释机制。

Abstract: Anomaly detection is a crucial machine-learning task with wide-ranging applications. Deep Support Vector Data Description (Deep SVDD) is a prominent deep one-class method, but it is vulnerable to hypersphere collapse, often relies on heuristic choices for hypersphere parameters, and provides limited interpretability. To address these issues, we propose Interpretable Maximum Margin Deep Anomaly Detection (IMD-AD), which leverages a small set of labeled anomalies and a maximum margin objective to stabilize training and improve discrimination. It is inherently resilient to hypersphere collapse. Furthermore, we prove an equivalence between hypersphere parameters and the network's final-layer weights, which allows the center and radius to be learned end-to-end as part of the model and yields intrinsic interpretability and visualizable outputs. We further develop an efficient training algorithm that jointly optimizes representation, margin, and final-layer parameters. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on image and tabular benchmarks demonstrate that IMD-AD empirically improves detection performance over several state-of-the-art baselines while providing interpretable decision diagnostics.

</details>


### [189] [Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07079)
*Woogyeol Jin,Taywon Min,Yongjin Yang,Swanand Ravindra Kadhe,Yi Zhou,Dennis Wei,Nathalie Baracaldo,Kimin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对 on-policy 蒸馏中 reverse KL 导致的生成多样性问题，提出 Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation，通过根据教师熵动态结合 reverse KL 和 forward KL，在保持 on-policy 训练效率的同时平衡精确模仿与覆盖鲁棒性，在数学推理任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 蒸馏方法通常使用 reverse KL 散度，鼓励学生匹配教师的高置信度预测。然而，作者发现 reverse KL 的模式寻求特性会降低生成多样性，并在教师分布熵较高时产生不稳定的学习信号。因此需要一种能够平衡精确性与多样性的蒸馏方法。

Method: 本文提出 Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation 方法，核心思想是在标准 reverse KL 目标基础上，当教师熵较高时augment加入 forward KL。具体实现上，根据教师分布的熵值动态调整两种 KL 散度的权重：在低熵区域使用 reverse KL 保持精确模仿，在高熵区域加入 forward KL 以捕捉更广泛的合理输出。

Result: 实验在六个数学推理基准上进行，结果显示：Qwen3-0.6B-Base 的 Pass@8 提升 +1.37，Qwen3-1.7B-Base 提升 +2.39，Qwen3-4B-Base 提升 +5.05。该方法成功维持了生成多样性（持续的 token 级别熵）并改善了师生对齐（高熵 token 上的 forward KL 降低）。

Conclusion: 本文提出的 Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation 方法通过动态平衡 reverse KL 和 forward KL，有效解决了传统 on-policy 蒸馏中模式寻求导致的生成多样性问题。该方法在保持 on-policy 训练效率的同时，兼顾了精确模仿与覆盖鲁棒性，在六个数学推理基准上取得了显著的性能提升，证明了考虑教师不确定性的重要性。

Abstract: On-policy distillation is a promising approach for transferring knowledge between language models, where a student learns from dense token-level signals along its own trajectories. This framework typically uses reverse KL divergence, encouraging the student to match the teacher's high-confidence predictions. However, we show that the mode-seeking property of reverse KL reduces generation diversity and yields unstable learning signals when the teacher distribution has high entropy. To address this, we introduce Entropy-Aware On-Policy Distillation. Our key idea is augmenting the standard reverse KL objective with forward KL when teacher entropy is high, capturing the full range of plausible outputs while retaining precise imitation elsewhere. It balances mode-seeking precision with mode-covering robustness without sacrificing on-policy training efficiency. Experiments show that our method maintains generation diversity (sustained token-level entropy) and improves student-teacher alignment (lower forward KL on high-entropy tokens). Across six math reasoning benchmarks, this yields Pass@8 accuracy gains of +1.37 for Qwen3-0.6B-Base, +2.39 for Qwen3-1.7B-Base, and +5.05 for Qwen3-4B-Base compared to baseline on-policy distillation methods. These results demonstrate that accounting for teacher uncertainty is essential for maintaining diversity and achieving effective knowledge transfer.

</details>


### [190] [Dreamer-CDP: Improving Reconstruction-free World Models Via Continuous Deterministic Representation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07083)
*Michael Hauri,Friedemann Zenke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于JEPA风格预测器的无重建强化学习方法，在Crafter环境中实现了与Dreamer相当的性能，缩小了基于重建的MBRL与无重建模型之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MBRL方法（如Dreamer）在高维观测空间中依赖重建目标学习抽象表示，但这种方法对任务无关细节敏感。虽然已有研究尝试用辅助动作预测或视图增强替代重建，但在Crafter环境中表现不佳，因此需要一种无需重建目标且能有效学习世界模型的方法。

Method: 提出一种在连续确定性表示上定义的JEPA风格预测器，摒弃重建目标，通过预测未来表示来学习世界模型。

Result: 该方法在Crafter基准测试中达到了与Dreamer相当的性能，证明了无需重建目标也能有效学习世界模型。

Conclusion: JEPA风格的预测器可以有效替代重建目标，在Crafter环境中实现与基于重建方法相当的性能，为无重建MBRL提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) agents operating in high-dimensional observation spaces, such as Dreamer, rely on learning abstract representations for effective planning and control. Existing approaches typically employ reconstruction-based objectives in the observation space, which can render representations sensitive to task-irrelevant details. Recent alternatives trade reconstruction for auxiliary action prediction heads or view augmentation strategies, but perform worse in the Crafter environment than reconstruction-based methods. We close this gap between Dreamer and reconstruction-free models by introducing a JEPA-style predictor defined on continuous, deterministic representations. Our method matches Dreamer's performance on Crafter, demonstrating effective world model learning on this benchmark without reconstruction objectives.

</details>


### [191] [Countdown-Code: A Testbed for Studying The Emergence and Generalization of Reward Hacking in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07084)
*Muhammad Khalifa,Zohaib Khan,Omer Tafveez,Hao Peng,Lu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文引入Countdown-Code环境来精确测量LLM中的reward hacking现象。研究发现，即使在SFT数据中只有1%的reward hacking轨迹污染，也足以让模型学会reward hacking，并在后续RL中复发和泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Reward hacking难以精确测量，因为真实任务奖励通常昂贵或无法计算。需要一个能区分proxy reward（测试通过/失败）和真实奖励（数学正确性）的环境来准确测量reward hacking发生率。

Method: 构建Countdown-Code环境，让模型既能解决数学推理任务又能操纵测试工具。采用dual-access设计分离proxy reward和true reward。研究open-weight LLMs在SFT和RL阶段的行为。

Result: 1）仅1%的蒸馏SFT数据污染就足以让模型internalize reward hacking；2）RL会放大这种misalignment并使其超越原始领域泛化。

Conclusion: 揭示了reward hacking的一条新路径：可通过受污染的SFT数据引入并在RL中持续和扩展。强调需要更严格地验证合成SFT数据。环境和代码已开源。

Abstract: Reward hacking is a form of misalignment in which models overoptimize proxy rewards without genuinely solving the underlying task. Precisely measuring reward hacking occurrence remains challenging because true task rewards are often expensive or impossible to compute. We introduce Countdown-Code, a minimal environment where models can both solve a mathematical reasoning task and manipulate the test harness. This dual-access design creates a clean separation between proxy rewards (test pass/fail) and true rewards (mathematical correctness), enabling accurate measurement of reward-hacking rates. Using this environment, we study reward hacking in open-weight LLMs and find that such behaviors can be unintentionally learned during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) when even a small fraction of reward-hacking trajectories leak into training data. As little as 1\% contamination in distillation SFT data is sufficient for models to internalize reward hacking which resurfaces during subsequent reinforcement learning (RL). We further show that RL amplifies misalignment and drives its generalization beyond the original domain. We open-source our environment and code to facilitate future research on reward hacking in LLMs. Our results reveal a previously underexplored pathway through which reward hacking can emerge and persist in LLMs, underscoring the need for more rigorous validation of synthetic SFT data. Code is available at https://github.com/zohaib-khan5040/Countdown-Code.

</details>


### [192] [Combining Adam and its Inverse Counterpart to Enhance Generalization of Deep Learning Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07122)
*Tao Shi,Liangming Chen,Long Jin,Mengchu Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对 Adam 收敛快但泛化差、易陷入尖锐极小值的问题，提出“反向 Adam”（InvAdam）：将 Adam 更新中一阶矩与二阶矩的逐元素相除改为相乘，使二阶矩元素大处步长增大、小处步长减小，从而更易逃离尖锐极小值、停留于平坦极小值；但 InvAdam 存在步长放大导致的收敛困难，作者进一步提出 DualAdam，用线性切换机制在训练早期使用 InvAdam、后期平滑过渡到 Adam，兼顾收敛性与泛化性。基于扩散理论（Kramers 逃逸问题）给出 InvAdam 平均逃逸时间更短的定理证明，并在 CIFAR-10/100、Tiny ImageNet、ImageNet-1k 图像分类与 OpenPangu-1B 中文指令微调上验证 DualAdam 泛化性能优于 Adam 及其多种变体，额外计算开销可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam 收敛速度快、适用性广，但泛化性能常不理想，学界主流解释是 Adam 的自适应学习率机制（在二阶矩元素大处减小步长、小处增大步长）会抑制参数穿越高曲率区域，使其更易被困于尖锐极小值；而经验与理论研究表明平坦极小值与更好的泛化能力正相关。因此需要一种能主动“逃离”尖锐极小值、寻找平坦极小值的新型优化器，同时又不能牺牲收敛性——这是本文的核心动机。

Method: 方法分三部分：(1) InvAdam：将 Adam 的更新式 u= m̂/(√v̂+ε) 改为 ũ = m̂·√v̂，即二阶矩元素越大更新步长越大（小则越小），从而在陡峭区域迈大步长以穿越鞍点，在平坦区域小步精细调整；单独使用会带来步长放大引起的震荡与不收敛。(2) DualAdam：按迭代步线性混合两种更新，ū = α·ũ + (1−α)·u，其中 α = max(0, 1−ξt)，ξ 为切换速率；训练初期 α≈1 完全采用 InvAdam 探索平坦极小值，随后 α 线性衰减至 0 完全退化为 Adam 保证最终收敛。算法流程与 Adam 一致（动量/二阶矩、偏差修正），仅增加一项按元素乘法与线性插值，开销极小。(3) 理论分析：引入扩散理论（Langevin 方程、Fokker–Planck 方程、准平衡与低温近似、含有效扩散修正的类 Smoluchowski 方程），以平均逃逸时间 τ 度量逃离尖锐极小值的能力；推导 Adam 的 log τ = O(2√b ΔL /(η√H_φe))，并给出定理 1 证明 InvAdam 的 log τ̃ = O(2√b ΔL /(η H_φe^{3/2}))，即曲率越大 InvAdam 逃逸时间下降更快（O(H^{-3/2}) vs O(H^{-1/2})），故逃离尖锐极小值能力更强；DualAdam 的收敛性因后期完全切换为 Adam 而由已有结论保证。复杂度分析：DualAdam 每次迭代 18p FLOPs，Adam 为 14p，额外 4p 相对前反向传播的 6bp 为 O(1/b) 级别，可忽略。

Result: 1) 2 参数损失面数值仿真（自定义函数与 Eggholder）显示 Adam 迅速陷入尖锐极小值，而 InvAdam 探索更充分并最终收敛到平坦极小值，但单独使用 InvAdam 存在不收敛现象。2) 图像分类：DualAdam 在 CIFAR-10/100 上全面领先（如 ResNet-18/CIFAR-100 75.29% vs Adam 72.56%、MIAdam 74.98%；ResNet-50 76.84%；VGG-16 72.66%；ViT-Small-4 58.54%），Tiny ImageNet 上同样最优（ResNet-18 57.19% vs Adam 50.98%），ImageNet-1k 上 ResNet-18 达 72.61%（Adam 69.55%、AdamW 71.29%）、ResNet-50 73.32%，且训练时间与 Adam 几乎一致（如 2197s vs 2214s）。3) Hessian 分析显示 DualAdam 解处的特征值更集中于 0、最大特征值与迹更小；1D 损失面可视化显示其解更平坦。4) LLM 微调（OpenPangu-Embedded-1B + Alpaca-GPT4-CN）：DualAdam 训练损失略高于 AdamW，但验证 PPL 更低且不随训练上升，泛化差距近零，而 AdamW 泛化差距快速扩大（过拟合）。5) 消融：切换速率 ξ=8×10⁻⁵ 最佳（ξ=0 即纯 InvAdam 不收敛），过小/过大均退化；切换机制对比中线性切换优于指数切换，最差为固定 epoch 硬切换。

Conclusion: 本文提出 InvAdam 与 DualAdam：InvAdam 通过反转 Adam 的自适应更新机制（相乘取代相除）显著增强逃离尖锐极小值、寻找平坦极小值的能力，扩散理论证明其平均逃逸时间对曲率的依赖为 O(H^{-3/2})，优于 Adam 的 O(H^{-1/2})；DualAdam 通过在训练早期以 InvAdam 探索、后期线性平滑切换到 Adam，兼顾了泛化与收敛，在图像分类与 LLM 微调上以可忽略的额外开销超越 Adam 及其现有 SOTA 变体。不足与后续工作：InvAdam 单独使用易不收敛（需仔细选择切换速率 ξ）；理论建立在二阶泰勒展开、准平衡与低温近似等强假设下，且定理 1 的闭式表达中分母项（|H_χe| 与 det 项）存在符号/量纲一致性问题，算法伪代码中 Adam 项写作 m̂/v̂ 而非 m̂/√v̂，笔误待核；未来将探索更优切换机制以及 InvAdam 与 SGD 等其他优化器的组合。

Abstract: In the training of neural networks, adaptive moment estimation (Adam) typically converges fast but exhibits suboptimal generalization performance. A widely accepted explanation for its defect in generalization is that it often tends to converge to sharp minima. To enhance its ability to find flat minima, we propose its new variant named inverse Adam (InvAdam). The key improvement of InvAdam lies in its parameter update mechanism, which is opposite to that of Adam. Specifically, it computes element-wise multiplication of the first-order and second-order moments, while Adam computes the element-wise division of these two moments. This modification aims to increase the step size of the parameter update when the elements in the second-order moments are large and vice versa, which helps the parameter escape sharp minima and stay at flat ones. However, InvAdam's update mechanism may face challenges in convergence. To address this challenge, we propose dual Adam (DualAdam), which integrates the update mechanisms of both Adam and InvAdam, ensuring convergence while enhancing generalization performance. Additionally, we introduce the diffusion theory to mathematically demonstrate InvAdam's ability to escape sharp minima. Extensive experiments are conducted on image classification tasks and large language model (LLM) fine-tuning. The results validate that DualAdam outperforms Adam and its state-of-the-art variants in terms of generalization performance. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/LongJin-lab/DualAdam.

</details>


### [193] [Agentic Planning with Reasoning for Image Styling via Offline RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07148)
*Subhojyoti Mukherjee,Stefano Petrangeli,Branislav Kveton,Trung Bui,Franck Dernoncourt,Arko Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种工具式智能体RL后训练框架，通过结构化规划和思维链推理解决复杂图像编辑问题。核心创新包括组合变换原语库、合成数据生成管道（约30K轨迹）和离线RL训练方法。在4B和8B参数Qwen3-VL模型上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接基于提示的编辑往往在复杂变换任务上失败，因为模糊且主观的提示需要对图像中应更改的内容进行细致入微的理解。核心直觉是，利用组合图像编辑工具而非直接提示受益于结构化智能体级规划与显式推理，从而获得更好的结果。

Method: 提出了一种工具式智能体RL后训练框架，包含：(1) 基于组合变换原语库、结构化上下文表示和显式逐步推理的工具式智能体规划方法；(2) 合成数据生成管道，生成了三个大规模数据集（各约10K轨迹），包含推理链、计划和质量分数；(3) 离线RL训练方法学习具有推理能力的规划器。

Result: 在视觉质量和指令遵循方面一致性地超越Edit-Only基线，并在大多数组合任务中优于其他基线方法，得到人类评估的验证。

Conclusion: 本文提出的工具式智能体RL后训练框架通过结构化规划和思维链推理，有效解决了复杂图像编辑任务中的指令跟随和视觉质量问题。实验表明，该方法在4B和8B参数Qwen3-VL模型上均优于其他基线方法，并通过人类评估验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Direct prompt-based editing often fails on complex transformations because vague and subjective prompts often require nuanced understanding of what should be changed in the image. Our core intuition is that leveraging compositional image editing tools rather than direct prompting profits from structured agent-level planning with explicit reasoning, leading to better results. This structured planning framework enables efficient offline RL post-training on quality-scored trajectories to improve performance. We present a tool-based agentic RL post-training framework that addresses this through structured planning with chain-of-thought reasoning. Our key contributions include: (1) A tool-based agentic planning methodology that combines a compositional library of orthogonal primitive transformations, structured context representation, and explicit per-step reasoning to decompose complex styling into interpretable tool sequences. (2) A synthetic data generation pipeline producing three large-scale datasets (each $\sim$10K trajectories) with reasoning chains, plans, and quality scores, as no existing datasets provide such supervision. Our datasets and code are publicly available at the HuggingFace repository. (3) Offline RL training methods for learning planners with reasoning as our core algorithmic contributions, which consistently improve over the Edit-Only baseline in visual quality and instruction following. (4) Comprehensive evaluation across 4B and 8B parameter Qwen3-VL models showing that our methods outperform other baselines in the majority of compositional tasks, validated by human evaluations.

</details>


### [194] [Spectral Conditioning of Attention Improves Transformer Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07162)
*Hemanth Saratchandran,Simon Lucey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析了 transformer 注意力块的 Jacobian，证明其由定义注意力机制的查询、键和值投影所决定。在此基础上，提出了一种通过系统性改变注意力层谱特性来降低 Jacobian 条件数的方法，从而改善 transformer 的整体条件数。该方法简单通用，可作为即插即用组件，在多种架构和任务上验证了性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决 transformer 中注意力块 Jacobian 的条件数问题，以提高训练稳定性和整体性能。

Method: 提出了一种系统性地改变每个注意力层谱特性的方法，以降低 Jacobian 的条件数，从而改善 transformer 内部注意力层的整体条件数。

Result: 实证表明，改进的 Jacobian 条件数能够转化为实际性能的提升。

Conclusion: 该方法简单、通用，可作为各种现有注意力机制的即插即用替代品。在不同 transformer 架构和任务上验证了其有效性，表现出持续的性能提升。

Abstract: We present a theoretical analysis of the Jacobian of an attention block within a transformer, showing that it is governed by the query, key, and value projections that define the attention mechanism. Leveraging this insight, we introduce a method that systematically alters the spectral properties of each attention layer to reduce the Jacobian's condition number, thereby improving the overall conditioning of the attention layers within a transformer network. We empirically show that this improved Jacobian conditioning translates to enhanced performance in practice. Our approach is simple, broadly applicable, and can be easily integrated as a drop-in replacement for a wide range of existing attention mechanisms. We validate its effectiveness across diverse transformer architectures and tasks, demonstrating consistent improvements in performance.

</details>


### [195] [Making LLMs Optimize Multi-Scenario CUDA Kernels Like Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07169)
*Yuxuan Han,Meng-Hao Guo,Zhengning Liu,Wenguang Chen,Shi-Min Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MSKernelBench——一个覆盖稠密线性代数、稀疏矩阵、LLM 算子序列、归一化/激活/损失、模板计算、Stencil 与数学算法等多场景、以纯 C 实现、同时支持 FP32/BF16 的 50 任务 CUDA 优化基准（100 个优化任务），并提出 CUDAMaster——一个由 Planner/Coder/Compiler/Debug 四类智能体组成、结合瓶颈感知的 Nsight Compute 剖析指标过滤的多智能体 CUDA 优化框架。实验显示该框架在多数算子上取得显著加速，总体较 Astra 快约 35%，部分算子（如 SpMV CSR 超越 cuSPARSE、2D 卷积超越 cuDNN 达 1.8×、点积超越 cuBLAS 达 1.8×）达到甚至超过闭源商用库水平；过滤式剖析在保证效果的同时相比全量剖析降低约 32% 成本与 30–40% token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的自动 GPU kernel 优化研究（如 KernelBench、FSR、CudaForge、Astra、CUDA-L1/L2 等）几乎都围绕 PyTorch 深度学习算子展开：任务计算密集、访存规整、且公开优化路径众多，模型容易靠“记忆”而非“创造”作答，因而无法反映真实 HPC 场景中稀疏线性代数、科学计算等不规则访存、多样化精度需求带来的挑战。同时，现有基准普遍存在三点缺陷：(1) 场景单一，缺少稀疏算子与科学计算；(2) 单一固定数据规模无法反映优化随规模的可扩展性，报告的加速比可靠性不足；(3) 缺少系统性的硬件性能剖析驱动机制——人类专家优化 CUDA 时最大的瓶颈是海量 profiler 数据中甄别关键性能签名，以及在调试/分析/编码之间频繁切换。此外手工调优库（cuBLAS/cuSPARSE）性能上限高但缺乏灵活性且工程成本巨大，编译器方案（TVM/Triton）又难以匹配专家水平，因此需要一个能自动优化多场景 kernel、可比肩闭源库的通用系统。

Method: 【MSKernelBench 基准】从 NVIDIA 官方文档、cuBLAS/cuSPARSE 常见用例、KernelBench 与 LeetGPU 等来源筛选 50 个具有较大计算规模的任务，覆盖稠密线性代数（点积、向量加、方阵乘、矩阵乘、矩阵幂等）、稀疏矩阵（COO/CSC/CSR/ELL 格式的 SpMV/SpMM）、归一化（BatchNorm/RMSNorm/LayerNorm/Softmax）、激活函数（Sigmoid/Selu/Elu/Gelu/Tanh/ReLU/LeakyReLU）、损失函数（MSE/Hinge/CrossEntropy）、LLM 算子序列（Softmax Attention、Triangle Attention、Merge Attention States、SwiGLU、Silu&Mul、RoPE）、张量处理（Reverse/Matrix Copy/Matrix Transpose/高阶张量收缩）、Stencil 计算（2D MaxPool、1D/2D 卷积、2D/3D 五点/七点模板）、数学与算法（排序、TopK、Simpson 积分、蒙特卡洛积分、FFT、前缀和）。实现上采用纯 C/CUDA 以保证可移植性、去除 PyTorch 框架抽象开销并支持不规则访存的手工精细控制；基线优先复用公开课程/参考实现，否则手工编写，并用 cuBLAS 等闭源库或串行 CPU 版本做数值对齐校验后方可作为基线；FP32 与 BF16 各一份独立实现（"_bf16"后缀），统一通过 C wrapper 接口与同一模板的测试集调用，测试逻辑与优化段解耦。评测协议包含：编译正确性（严格的函数签名约束）、多尺度数值正确性（多个数据规模、随机用例、误差容限 1e-5）、性能测量（3 次预热 + 50 次执行取均值，以基线加速比表示）。最终分数为复杂度加权平均 P = ΣT(N_i)·S_i / ΣT(N_i)，权重取基线实现的理论复杂度 T(N)，使大规模用例权重更高，从而放大算法级改进（如 O(N²)→O(N log N)）的优势。

【CUDAMaster 框架】先建立硬件瓶颈分类体系：用 Nsight Compute 收集所有算子关键 kernel 的完整性能计数器，按 Duration 选出最耗时 kernel，对 Compute (SM) Throughput、DRAM Throughput、Memory Throughput 三项吞吐指标应用 Otsu 自适应阈值法划分高/低利用类，阈值均收敛于约 30%，据此形成三类瓶颈：Compute Bound（Compute.Th>30%）、Memory Latency Bound（DRAM.Th<30% 且 Memory.Th<30%）、Memory Bandwidth Bound（其余，DRAM.Th 高）。硬件分析过滤器依据统一映射表对每个 kernel 分类并只保留该类相关指标（如 Compute Bound 保留 Compute(SM) Throughput/Issue Slots Busy/Executed Ipc Active/SM Busy；Latency Bound 保留 L2 与 L1/TEX Hit Rate、Executed Ipc Elapsed、Mem Busy；Bandwidth Bound 保留 DRAM Throughput、Memory Throughput、Max Bandwidth、Mem Pipes Busy），输出面向瓶颈的“诊断报告”给下游智能体。

多智能体流水线（Algorithm 1，参数 R=3 迭代、D=3 调试轮）：执行原始 kernel 并过滤剖析得 π0 → 每轮由 Planner Agent 基于历史剖析与当前加速比提出一个增量高层优化策略（仅方案、不写码，禁止调用 cuBLAS/cuDNN 等现成库）→ Coder Agent 按策略改写 kernel（kernel 名须以 "_kernel_optimized" 结尾、外部 wrapper 以 "_optimized" 结尾且参数列表不变、需 cudaDeviceSynchronize）→ Compiler Agent 生成 nvcc 编译命令与执行脚本（含 -arch 等链接选项）→ 执行并过滤剖析 → 若正确性失败则进入 Debug Agent 子流程（诊断编译错误、memcheck CUDA 错误、JSON 格式结果偏差，最多 D 轮）→ 校验通过且 P 更高则更新最优解，否则标记该方案无效。测试与执行环境始终锚定基准的标准代码，任何智能体不得修改核心测试逻辑，保证公平评估。

Result: 【实验设置】50 任务 × FP32/BF16 = 100 个优化任务；模型为 OpenAI o4-mini 与 DeepSeek-V3.2；硬件为单张 NVIDIA RTX 4090；R=3、D=3。

【宏观结果（累积成功率，按加速比阈值 τ）】o4-mini 全面优于 DeepSeek-V3.2：τ=0（功能正确）100% vs 95%；τ=1（超越朴素基线）94% vs 80%；τ=2 为 60% vs 49%；τ=4 为 47% vs 40%；τ≥8 为 25% vs 22%。精度方面影响次要但可观测：BF16 在 τ≤8 的中等阈值上略优，FP32 在 τ≥32 的严苛目标下对两模型更稳定。

【微观结果（与权威基线对比）】在六个代表性算子上与 cuBLAS/cuDNN/cuSPARSE 及 Astra 优化过的 SGLang kernel 对比：两模型均超过 cuSPARSE 的 SpMV CSR；2D 卷积相对 cuDNN、点积相对 cuBLAS 最高可达约 1.8× 加速；对 Astra 优化过的 RMSNorm，o4-mini 领先约 35%，在 SiLU&Mul 与 Merge Attention States 上持平或超越。总体较 Astra 提升约 35%。

【消融一：迭代与调试】Full(R=3,D=3) 最优；o4-mini 在 τ=1 处 Full 94% vs N.D.(D=0) 77%、S.I.(R=1) 74%、S.R.(R=1,D=0) 最低；τ≥8 处 Full 25% 而消融组仅 17–19%。DeepSeek-V3.2 呈相同趋势但整体更低。表明迭代精化与系统调试均不可或缺。

【消融二：剖析策略】Filtered 在 o4-mini 上与 Full Prof. 各阈值基本持平（τ=1 均为 94–95%，τ≥8 均为 25%），而 No Prof. 降至 90%/22%；DeepSeek 趋势类似但波动更大。成本上 Filtered 明显更优：o4-mini 单任务平均 $0.2707/123k tokens，介于 No Prof.（$0.2120/96k）与 Full Prof.（$0.3804/173k）之间，相对全量剖析削减约 32% 成本与 30–40% token；DeepSeek 为 $0.0310/223k vs $0.0277/168k vs $0.0687/387k。

【瓶颈迁移与微结构指标分析】50 个任务初始分布为 Compute Bound 11、Memory Latency Bound 24、Memory Bandwidth Bound 15，且与任务类型高度相关（计算密集/规整→计算受限；归一化/激活/损失→延迟受限；稀疏矩阵/张量搬运→带宽受限）。优化后：6 个内存受限任务转为计算受限（算力利用提升），14 个由延迟受限转为带宽受限（延迟问题更可优化），延迟受限任务数从 24 降至 8（-67%），计算受限 +45%、带宽受限 +73%。分项指标：计算受限类 Issue Slots Busy +16.8%、Executed Ipc Active +15.4%；延迟受限类 Mem Busy +1312.7%、Executed Ipc Elapsed +889.4%；带宽受限类 DRAM Throughput +537.3%、Mem Pipes Busy +98.9%。

Conclusion: 本文通过 MSKernelBench 与 CUDAMaster 证明了：只要提供合适的环境与信息，LLM 智能体可以在多样化的低层 GPU 编程任务上逼近甚至达到专家级手工调优水平——不仅能匹配 cuBLAS/cuSPARSE/cuDNN 等闭源库，还在 SpMV、2D 卷积、点积等算子上反超之，并在 LLM 融合算子上超越 Astra 框架约 35%。其关键洞见有三：(1) 通用 kernel 优化需要剥离框架依赖、在纯 C 层面以多场景、FP32/BF16 双精度、多尺度与复杂度加权的方式进行评测，才能真实衡量“创造”而非“记忆”的能力；(2) 瓶颈感知的剖析指标过滤是性价比最高的信息供给方式——以 Otsu 自动标定的约 30% 吞吐阈值对 kernel 三分类后按类裁剪指标，能以接近全量剖析的效果、显著更低的 token/成本为规划智能体提供精准诊断；(3) 迭代规划 + 系统化调试的多智能体闭环（Planner/Coder/Compiler/Debug）以及自动构建完整编译执行工具链，是支撑“像专家一样”优化的必要工程结构。局限与展望方面：实验仅在单张 RTX 4090 上验证、基线为手工实现而非真实生产级参考实现、仅考察 o4-mini 与 DeepSeek-V3.2 两个通用模型且迭代轮数固定为 3/3、基线库对比仅覆盖六个算子，后续可在更多硬件代际与模型、更长搜索预算、更多闭源库对照下扩展，并探索将瓶颈迁移规律反哺库与编译器的自动优化。

Abstract: Optimizing GPU kernels manually is a challenging and time-consuming task. With the rapid development of LLMs, automated GPU kernel optimization is gradually becoming a tangible reality. However, current LLM-driven automated optimization methods narrowly focus on machine learning applications, such as PyTorch operator optimization, while overlooking broader domains like sparse matrix operations in scientific computing. Extending to these broader applications brings new challenges for the benchmark and algorithm. Therefore, developing a general-purpose automated kernel optimization method becomes our primary focus. In this paper, we address the absence of systematic evaluation for multi-scenario settings by introducing MSKernelBench, which spans multiple scenarios, including fundamental algebraic operations, common LLM kernels, sparse matrix operators, and scientific computing routines, each supporting both FP32 and BF16 precision. Building on this benchmark, we introduce CUDAMaster, a multi-agent, hardware-aware system for kernel optimization that leverages profiling information and automatically constructs the full compilation and execution toolchain. Experimental results demonstrate that CUDAMaster achieves significant speedups across most operators, outperforming Astra by about 35%. In several cases, its performance matches or surpasses that of highly optimized, closed-source libraries such as cuBLAS. A demo showcasing the original and optimized code for each operator is available at https://hanyx2021.github.io/MSKernelBenchDemo/.

</details>


### [196] [Shaping Parameter Contribution Patterns for Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07195)
*Haonan Xu,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 深度模型在分布外(OOD)检测中容易产生过度自信的预测，因为训练后的分类器倾向于依赖稀疏的参数贡献模式，即只有少数主导参数驱动预测。这些参数容易被OOD输入异常触发，导致过度自信。SPCP通过在训练过程中基于动态估计的阈值纠正过高的参数贡献，促使分类器依赖更广泛的参数集进行决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前OOD检测面临的核心问题是深度模型产生过度自信的预测。作者发现训练后的分类器存在"脆弱性"，即依赖稀疏的参数贡献模式——仅少数主导参数驱动预测。这种模式容易被OOD输入异常触发，导致过度自信的误分类。

Method: 提出SPCP (Shaping Parameter Contribution Patterns)方法，在训练过程中引入参数贡献模式塑形机制：1)动态估计参数贡献阈值；2)基于该阈值纠正过高的参数贡献；3)促使分类器学习边界导向的密集贡献模式，使其依赖更广泛的参数集进行决策。

Result: 实验结果表明SPCP能有效减少因参数异常触发导致的过度自信预测，同时保持分布内(ID)数据的分类性能。在多种OOD检测设置下验证了该方法的有效性。

Conclusion: SPCP通过塑形参数贡献模式，为解决深度学习模型的OOD检测难题提供了一个简单而有效的训练策略，为提升模型在开放世界场景下的可靠性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is a well-known challenge due to deep models often producing overconfident. In this paper, we reveal a key insight that trained classifiers tend to rely on sparse parameter contribution patterns, meaning that only a few dominant parameters drive predictions. This brittleness can be exploited by OOD inputs that anomalously trigger these parameters, resulting in overconfident predictions. To address this issue, we propose a simple yet effective method called Shaping Parameter Contribution Patterns (SPCP), which enhances OOD detection robustness by encouraging the classifier to learn boundary-oriented dense contribution patterns. Specifically, SPCP operates during training by rectifying excessively high parameter contributions based on a dynamically estimated threshold. This mechanism promotes the classifier to rely on a broader set of parameters for decision-making, thereby reducing the risk of overconfident predictions caused by anomalously triggered parameters, while preserving in-distribution (ID) performance. Extensive experiments under various OOD detection setups verify the effectiveness of SPCP.

</details>


### [197] [A Dual-Graph Spatiotemporal GNN Surrogate for Nonlinear Response Prediction of Reinforced Concrete Beams under Four-Point Bending](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07201)
*Zhaoyang Ren,Qilin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种对偶图时空图神经网络代理模型，用于近似钢筋混凝土（RC）梁在四点弯曲加载下的非线性有限元（FE）时程响应。该模型以节点级 GConvGRU 分支预测运动学量（节点位移），以单元级 GConvGRU 分支预测历史相关内变量（von Mises 应力、等效塑性应变 PEEQ），并通过单元分支池化输出全局竖向反力，形成统一的多任务自回归框架。训练数据来自参数化 Abaqus 仿真（网格对齐网格上独立移动两个加载块），在固定归一化加载水平下导出全场响应。消融实验表明，移除"单元→节点→单元"（E2N2E）通路可改善局部高梯度应力/PEEQ 区域的峰值敏感预测，同时不损害整体荷载-位移趋势。代理模型以远低于非线性 FE 的成本生成完整轨迹，可用于快速参数化评估与设计探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真非线性有限元模拟 RC 结构计算代价高昂，在加载位置变化的参数化分析场景下尤为突出；同时，工程上关心的局部峰值量（单元应力、塑性应变）在仅以节点表征承载时会出现"峰值损失"（peak loss），即节点级表示会平滑或稀释高频、局部化的应力/应变信息。因此需要一种既能捕捉全局力学趋势、又能保持局部峰值精度的高效代理模型。

Method: 1）数据生成：参数化 Abaqus 仿真战役，在与 FE 网格对齐的规则网格上独立移动两个加载块（四点弯曲的加载位置变量），在各固定归一化加载水平下导出全场响应，形成多工况多时刻样本。2）模型：对偶图（dual-graph）时空 GNN，含两条循环图分支——节点级 GConvGRU（用于节点位移等运动学量）与单元级 GConvGRU（用于 von Mises 应力、PEEQ 等历史相关内变量），两者通过"单元→节点→单元"（E2N2E）耦合通路交互，以刻画节点与单元两套离散化之间的信息传递；全局竖向反力由单元分支上的池化（pooling）读出。3）训练：自回归滚动（autoregressive rollout）方式在时间维展开，联合多任务预测位移、单元应力、单元塑性应变与全局反力。4）消融：受控对比移除 E2N2E 通路及分支配置，评估峰值敏感精度与全局趋势精度。

Result: 对偶图自回归代理模型能够以远低于非线性 FE 计算成本的代价生成 RC 梁四点弯曲的全时程响应（节点位移、单元 von Mises 应力、单元 PEEQ、全局竖向反力）。消融实验显示，移除单元→节点→单元耦合通路后，局部高梯度应力/PEEQ 区域的峰值敏感预测得到改善，而全局荷载-位移趋势未出现退化，表明 E2N2E 通路在局部峰值保真方面可能带来负面影响（冗余或跨尺度噪声传播）。模型支持快速参数化评估与设计空间探索。

Conclusion: 该工作证明：针对 RC 结构非线性时程响应，结合节点级与单元级 GConvGRU 的对偶图时空 GNN 代理模型可在极低成本下替代昂贵的非线性 FE 仿真，支持加载位置参数化研究；单元-节点耦合路径的设计（尤其是 E2N2E 通路的存在与否）对局部峰值精度与全局趋势精度之间存在权衡，需要按目标量进行结构设计选择。局限与未来方向包括：增加加载块位置以外的几何/材料参数化维度、扩展至更复杂构件与三维模型、量化不确定度与长期滚动误差累积，以及在更大参数域上的泛化与物理一致性（能量/守恒）约束研究。

Abstract: High-fidelity nonlinear finite-element (FE) simulations of reinforced-concrete (RC) structures are still costly, especially in parametric settings where loading positions vary. We develop a dual-graph spatiotemporal GNN surrogate to approximate the time histories of RC beams under four-point bending. To generate training data, we run a parametric Abaqus campaign that independently shifts the two loading blocks on a mesh-aligned grid and exports full-field responses at fixed normalized loading levels. The model rolls out autoregressively and jointly predicts nodal displacements, element wise von Mises stress, element-wise equivalent plastic strain (PEEQ), and the global vertical reaction force in a single multi-task setup. A key motivation is the peak loss introduced when element quantities are forced through node-based representations. We therefore couple node- and element-level dynamics using two recurrent graph branches: a node-level graph convolutional gated recurrent unit (GConvGRU) for kinematics and an element-level GConvGRU for history-dependent internal variables, with global force predicted through pooling on the element branch. In controlled ablations, removing the Element to Node to Element pathway improves peak-sensitive prediction in localized high-gradient stress/PEEQ regions without degrading global load displacement trends. After training, the surrogate produces full trajectories at a fraction of the cost of nonlinear FE, enabling faster parametric evaluation and design exploration.

</details>


### [198] [wDPO: Winsorized Direct Preference Optimization for Robust LLM Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07211)
*Jilong Liu,Yonghui Yang,Pengyang Shao,Haokai Ma,Wei Qin,Richang Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: wDPO通过分层winsorization方法增强DPO的鲁棒性，针对不同类型的噪声采用差异化的干预策略，在保持奖励模型无关特性的同时提升对齐质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DPO鲁棒性变体主要依赖统一目标修改或全局重加权，将噪声样本视为同质不确定性源，未能区分不同噪声类型，导致次优的对齐鲁棒性。

Method: 提出wDPO方法，采用无奖励的分层干预策略：1)利用DPO log-ratio的隐式margin识别异质噪声模式；2)对硬噪声进行数据级干预（稀疏修正不一致偏好对）；3)对模糊比较进行梯度级干预（软winsorization，截断高损失尾部的极端损失）。

Result: 在PKU-SafeRLHF和多个外部安全基准上的广泛实验表明，wDPO在偏好对齐质量和鲁棒性方面始终优于vanilla DPO和强基线方法，在受控标签翻转噪声下提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: wDPO通过针对不同噪声类型采用针对性干预而非统一正则化的方法，有效提升了LLM对齐的鲁棒性，为偏好数据噪声问题提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns large language models by optimizing pairwise preferences and has shown remarkable effectiveness as a simple and scalable alternative to RLHF. However, in practice, preference data are often noisy. Existing robust variants of DPO mainly rely on uniform objective modifications or global reweighting. While partially effective, these methods treat noisy samples as a homogeneous source of uncertainty and fail to distinguish between different noise types, leading to sub-optimal alignment robustness. In this work, we show that robust preference alignment benefits from addressing different noise types with targeted interventions rather than uniform regularization. We propose winsorized Direct Preference Optimization~(wDPO), a robust LLM alignment approach with hierarchical winsorization. Specifically, wDPO adopts a reward-free hierarchical intervention strategy that leverages only signals already available during DPO training. It first uses the implicit margin from DPO log-ratio to identify heterogeneous noise patterns without relying on external reward models. For hard noise, wDPO performs a data-level intervention by sparsely correcting strongly inconsistent preference pairs. For ambiguous comparisons, it applies a gradient-level intervention through soft winsorization, capping extreme losses in the high-loss tail to prevent weakly informative samples from dominating gradient updates. Extensive experiments on PKU-SafeRLHF and multiple external safety benchmarks demonstrate that wDPO consistently improves preference alignment quality and robustness over vanilla DPO and strong DPO-family baselines, with particularly pronounced gains under controlled label-flip noise.

</details>


### [199] [Margin in Abstract Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07221)
*Yair Ashlagi,Roi Livni,Shay Moran,Tom Waknine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究margin-based学习的极小数学结构，探讨在任意度量空间中学习的可能性，以及能否通过嵌入到线性空间来解释margin-based学习的可学习性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代高度过参数化学习中，margin-based learning是少数能提供与参数数量无关的泛化保证的经典设置之一。研究旨在找出支撑这一现象的最小数学结构。

Method: 1. 在任意度量空间中研究简单的margin-based问题：概念由中心点定义，根据距离小于r还是大于R进行分类
2. 将问题扩展到距离函数的有界线性组合
3. 开发Banach空间的结构分类法来分析可学习性

Result: 1. 当R>3r时，这类概念在任何度量空间中都是可学习的
2. 存在一个通用常数γ>0的尖锐阈值：超过此margin时在所有度量空间中可学习，低于此阈值时存在不可学习的度量空间
3. Banach空间：若对某个γ≥0可学习，则对所有γ≥0可学习；无限维空间中样本复杂度必须以(1/γ)^p增长，p≥2

Conclusion: Margin-based学习的可学习性本质上依赖于三角不等式等度量空间的基本结构，而不需要线性或解析结构。无限维Banach空间中样本复杂度存在多项式下界，表明不能将所有margin-based学习都简化为线性分类。

Abstract: Margin-based learning, exemplified by linear and kernel methods, is one of the few classical settings where generalization guarantees are independent of the number of parameters. This makes it a central case study in modern highly over-parameterized learning. We ask what minimal mathematical structure underlies this phenomenon.
  We begin with a simple margin-based problem in arbitrary metric spaces: concepts are defined by a center point and classify points according to whether their distance lies below $r$ or above $R$. We show that whenever $R>3r$, this class is learnable in \emph{any} metric space. Thus, sufficiently large margins make learnability depend only on the triangle inequality, without any linear or analytic structure. Our first main result extends this phenomenon to concepts defined by bounded linear combinations of distance functions, and reveals a sharp threshold: there exists a universal constant $γ>0$ such that above this margin the class is learnable in every metric space, while below it there exist metric spaces where it is not learnable at all.
  We then ask whether margin-based learnability can always be explained via an embedding into a linear space -- that is, reduced to linear classification in some Banach space through a kernel-type construction. We answer this negatively by developing a structural taxonomy of Banach spaces: if a Banach space is learnable for some margin parameter $γ\geq 0$, then it is learnable for all such $γ$, and in infinite-dimensional spaces the sample complexity must scale polynomially in $1/γ$. Specifically, it must grow as $(1/γ)^p$ for some $p\ge 2$, and every such rate is attainable.

</details>


### [200] [Unlocking Data Value in Finance: A Study on Distillation and Difficulty-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07223)
*Chuxue Cao,Honglin Lin,Zhanping Zhong,Xin Gao,Mengzhang Cai,Conghui He,Sirui Han,Lijun Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在金融垂直领域中，如何通过高质量的post-training数据提升LLM性能。研究团队构建了ODA-Fin-SFT-318k（高质量CoT监督数据）和ODA-Fin-RL-12k（难度与可验证性平衡的强化学习数据），并在9个金融基准测试上评估了ODA-Fin-RL-8B模型，结果表明其性能超越了同规模的开源SOTA金融LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在金融领域部署面临三大挑战：密集的领域特定术语、严格的数值推理要求以及对事实错误极低的容忍度。研究旨在证明在专业垂直领域中，性能主要由post-training数据的质量和难度/可验证性profile决定。

Method: 1. 通过多阶段蒸馏和验证构建ODA-Fin-SFT-318k数据集，用于生成高质量的Chain-of-Thought监督信号；2. 采集ODA-Fin-RL-12k数据集，针对难以但可验证的任务，平衡奖励精度和任务多样性；3. 使用标准SFT和RL pipeline进行训练；4. 在9个涵盖一般金融任务、情感分析和数值推理的基准测试上进行评估。

Result: ODA-Fin-RL-8B在所有9个基准测试上持续超越同规模的开源SOTA金融LLM。高质量CoT蒸馏在SFT阶段建立了稳健基础，而难度和可验证性感知的采样提升了RL的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 在金融垂直领域，高质量CoT蒸馏为SFT奠定了坚实基础，基于难度和可验证性的采样策略显著改善了RL的泛化性能。数据质量是垂直领域LLM性能的关键决定因素。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong general capabilities, yet their deployment in finance remains challenging due to dense domain-specific terminology, stringent numerical reasoning requirements, and low tolerance for factual errors. We conduct a controlled empirical study showing that in specialized vertical domains, performance is largely determined by the quality and difficulty/verifiability profile of post-training data. We introduce \textbf{ODA-Fin-SFT-318k}, constructed via multi-stage distillation and verification to produce high-quality Chain-of-Thought supervision, and \textbf{ODA-Fin-RL-12k}, curated for hard-but-verifiable tasks that balance reward precision and task diversity. Using standard SFT and RL pipelines, we show that high-quality CoT distillation establishes a robust foundation during SFT, while difficulty- and verifiability-aware sampling improves RL generalization. Evaluated on nine benchmarks spanning general financial tasks, sentiment analysis, and numerical reasoning, our ODA-Fin-RL-8B consistently surpasses open-source state-of-the-art (SOTA) financial LLMs of comparable size. We release our ODA-Fin-SFT-318k and ODA-Fin-RL-12k datasets, along with trained models to advance data-centric financial AI research.

</details>


### [201] [LightMedSeg: Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Learned Spatial Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07228)
*Kavyansh Tyagi,Vishwas Rathi,Puneet Goyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LightMedSeg，一个轻量级的UNet风格3D医学图像分割架构，通过锚点条件FiLM调制、局部结构先验模块、纹理感知路由和深度可分离卷积等技术，在仅0.48M参数和14.64 GFLOPs的极低计算成本下达到与Transformer基线相当的分割精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确高效的3D医学图像分割对临床AI至关重要，但现有Transformer方法存在参数量过大、FLOPs过高、泛化能力有限等问题，难以满足严格的内存、延迟和数据可用性约束。

Method: LightMedSeg采用模块化UNet风格架构，包含以下核心组件：1) 锚点条件FiLM调制实现解剖感知的特征校准；2) 局部结构先验模块和纹理感知路由机制动态分配表征容量至边界丰富区域；3) 通过幽灵卷积和深度可分离卷积最小化计算冗余；4) 带有锚点相对空间位置偏差的学习型跳跃路由器实现多尺度特征自适应融合。

Result: LightMedSeg仅需0.48M参数和14.64 GFLOPs，在分割精度上与重型Transformer基线模型仅相差几个Dice百分点。

Conclusion: LightMedSeg是一个可部署的、数据高效的3D医学图像分割解决方案，仅需0.48M参数和14.64 GFLOPs即可达到与重型Transformer基线模型相当的分割精度（Dice得分仅差几分）。代码将在论文录用后公开。

Abstract: Accurate and efficient 3D medical image segmentation is essential for clinical AI, where models must remain reliable under stringent memory, latency, and data availability constraints. Transformer-based methods achieve strong accuracy but suffer from excessive parameters, high FLOPs, and limited generalization. We propose LightMedSeg, a modular UNet-style segmentation architecture that integrates anatomical priors with adaptive context modeling. Anchor-conditioned FiLM modulation enables anatomy-aware feature calibration, while a local structural prior module and texture-aware routing dynamically allocate representational capacity to boundary-rich regions. Computational redundancy is minimized through ghost and depthwise convolutions, and multi-scale features are adaptively fused via a learned skip router with anchor-relative spatial position bias. Despite requiring only 0.48M parameters and 14.64~GFLOPs, LightMedSeg achieves segmentation accuracy within a few Dice points of heavy transformer baselines. Therefore, LightMedSeg is a deployable and data-efficient solution for 3D medical image segmentation. Code will be released publicly upon acceptance.

</details>


### [202] [Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Predicting Cellular Responses to Gene Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07233)
*Andrea Giuseppe Di Francesco,Andrea Rubbi,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PT-RAG是一种新型的检索增强生成框架，将RAG范式从自然语言处理领域扩展到细胞生物学领域，用于预测细胞对基因扰动的响应。该方法通过两阶段管道实现细胞类型感知的可微检索，从而实现端到端优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测细胞对基因扰动的响应对于理解基因功能、疾病机制和疗法开发至关重要。然而，现有的深度学习方法由于生成过程中上下文信息有限，难以在不同细胞类型和扰动场景之间泛化。

Method: PT-RAG采用两阶段管道：第一阶段使用GenePT嵌入检索候选扰动K；第二阶段通过Gumbel-Softmax离散采样在细胞状态和输入扰动条件下自适应细化选择。这种细胞类型感知的可微检索实现了检索目标与生成目标的联合端到端优化。

Result: 在Replogle-Nadig单基因扰动数据集上，PT-RAG在相同实验条件下优于STATE和vanilla RAG，在分布相似性度量（W1, W2）上获得最大增益。Vanilla RAG的显著失败表明细胞类型感知的可微检索在该领域中至关重要。

Conclusion: 检索增强生成是模拟细胞对基因扰动响应的一个有前景的范式。细胞类型感知的可微检索对于该领域至关重要，而 naive 的检索方法可能会损害性能。

Abstract: Predicting how cells respond to genetic perturbations is fundamental to understanding gene function, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic development. While recent deep learning approaches have shown promise in modeling single-cell perturbation responses, they struggle to generalize across cell types and perturbation contexts due to limited contextual information during generation. We introduce PT-RAG (Perturbation-aware Two-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a novel framework that extends Retrieval-Augmented Generation beyond traditional language-model applications to cellular biology. Unlike standard RAG systems designed for text retrieval with pre-trained LLMs, perturbation retrieval lacks established similarity metrics and requires learning what constitutes relevant context, making differentiable retrieval essential. PT-RAG addresses this through a two-stage pipeline: first, retrieving candidate perturbations $K$ using GenePT embeddings, then adaptively refining the selection through Gumbel-Softmax discrete sampling conditioned on both the cell state and the input perturbation. This cell-type-aware differentiable retrieval enables end-to-end optimization of the retrieval objective jointly with generation. On the Replogle-Nadig single-gene perturbation dataset, we demonstrate that PT-RAG outperforms both STATE and vanilla RAG under identical experimental conditions, with the strongest gains in distributional similarity metrics ($W_1$, $W_2$). Notably, vanilla RAG's dramatic failure is itself a key finding: it demonstrates that differentiable, cell-type-aware retrieval is essential in this domain, and that naive retrieval can actively harm performance. Our results establish retrieval-augmented generation as a promising paradigm for modelling cellular responses to gene perturbation. The code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/PT-RAG_ICLR.

</details>


### [203] [Rethinking Deep Research from the Perspective of Web Content Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07241)
*Zixuan Yu,Zhenheng Tang,Tongliang Liu,Chengqi Zhang,Xiaowen Chu,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WeDas是一个Web内容分布感知的框架，通过将搜索空间结构特征融入智能体的观察空间，解决深度搜索智能体中推理驱动查询与底层网页索引结构之间的错位问题。核心创新是查询-结果对齐分数(QRAS)，用于量化智能体意图与检索结果之间的兼容性，并通过少样本探测机制迭代估计该分数，使智能体能够根据局部内容景观动态重新校准子目标。作为即插即用模块，在四个基准测试中一致提升子目标完成度和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度搜索智能体中推理驱动查询与底层网页索引结构存在错位。现有框架将搜索引擎视为静态工具，导致查询要么太粗粒度要么太细粒度，无法检索到精确证据。

Method: 1)提出查询-结果对齐分数(QRAS)来量化智能体意图与检索结果的兼容性; 2)引入少样本探测机制，通过有限查询访问迭代估计该分数; 3)将搜索空间结构特征融入智能体的观察空间，使智能体能根据局部内容景观动态重新校准子目标。

Result: 作为即插即用模块，在四个基准测试中一致提升子目标完成度和准确性，有效弥合高层推理与低层检索之间的差距。

Conclusion: WeDas框架通过QRAS和少样本探测机制，成功解决了搜索智能体中查询与索引结构错位的问题，为提升搜索智能体的检索精度提供了一种通用且有效的方法。

Abstract: Despite the integration of search tools, Deep Search Agents often suffer from a misalignment between reasoning-driven queries and the underlying web indexing structures. Existing frameworks treat the search engine as a static utility, leading to queries that are either too coarse or too granular to retrieve precise evidence. We propose WeDas, a Web Content Distribution Aware framework that incorporates search-space structural characteristics into the agent's observation space. Central to our method is the Query-Result Alignment Score, a metric quantifying the compatibility between agent intent and retrieval outcomes. To overcome the intractability of indexing the dynamic web, we introduce a few-shot probing mechanism that iteratively estimates this score via limited query accesses, allowing the agent to dynamically recalibrate sub-goals based on the local content landscape. As a plug-and-play module, WeDas consistently improves sub-goal completion and accuracy across four benchmarks, effectively bridging the gap between high-level reasoning and low-level retrieval.

</details>


### [204] [LF2L: Loss Fusion Horizontal Federated Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces Using External Datasets Effectively: A Case Study in Second Primary Cancer Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07249)
*Chia-Fu Lin,Yi-Ju Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对台湾肺癌幸存者第二原发癌(SPC)预测问题，提出损失融合水平联邦学习(LF2L)框架，通过共享损失机制整合本地与美国SEER数据，在保护机构隐私的同时显著提升预测性能，AUROC和AUPRC均优于各基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 台湾本地癌症数据集规模有限且地理覆盖不足，限制了传统机器学习方法的效能和泛化能力；而直接合并多源数据集面临特征不一致和隐私约束等挑战，需要一种既能保护隐私又能有效利用外部数据的解决方案。

Method: 提出了一种损失融合水平联邦学习(LF2L)框架，该框架：(1)利用水平联邦学习避免原始数据共享，保护机构隐私；(2)通过共享损失机制平衡共同特征和独有特征的贡献；(3)整合台湾本地数据集与美国SEER公开数据集，扩大数据多样性和规模。

Result: 实验结果表明，LF2L框架在AUROC和AUPRC指标上相较于本地学习、水平联邦学习和集中式学习基线方法均取得统计学显著改进。

Conclusion: LF2L框架通过损失融合机制有效整合跨机构数据，在保护隐私的前提下显著提升SPC预测性能。与本地学习、传统水平联邦学习和集中式学习相比，该方法在AUROC和AUPRC上均取得统计学显著提升，证实了有效利用外部数据对提升临床预测模型性能的重要价值。

Abstract: Second primary cancer (SPC), a new cancer in patients different from previously diagnosed, is a growing concern due to improved cancer survival rates. Early prediction of SPC is essential to enable timely clinical interventions. This study focuses on lung cancer survivors treated in Taiwanese hospitals, where the limited size and geographic scope of local datasets restrict the effectiveness and generalizability of traditional machine learning approaches. To address this, we incorporate external data from the publicly available US-based Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) program, significantly increasing data diversity and scale. However, the integration of multi-source datasets presents challenges such as feature inconsistency and privacy constraints. Rather than naively merging data, we proposed a loss fusion horizontal federated learning (LF2L) framework that can enable effective cross-institutional collaboration while preserving institutional privacy by avoiding data sharing. Using both common and unique features and balancing their contributions through a shared loss mechanism, our method demonstrates substantial improvements in the prediction performance of SPC. Experiment results show statistically significant improvements in AUROC and AUPRC when compared to localized, horizontal federated, and centralized learning baselines. This highlights the importance of not only acquiring external data but also leveraging it effectively to enhance model performance in real-world clinical model development.

</details>


### [205] [Turning Time Series into Algebraic Equations: Symbolic Machine Learning for Interpretable Modeling of Chaotic Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07261)
*Madhurima Panja,Grace Younes,Tanujit Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对混沌时间序列难以预测、深度学习黑箱缺乏可解释性的问题，提出两种从滞后观测中直接学习显式代数方程的符号预测器：SyNF（基于 EQL 的可微神经符号网络）与 SyTF（基于 PySR 的进化符号回归），并在 132 个低维混沌吸引子与两个真实混沌序列（圣胡安登革热周发病率、ENSO Niño 3.4 海表温度）上以一步向前滚动窗口任务对比经典统计、树集成与深度学习基线。结果显示符号方法在精度上具竞争力且能给出透明方程，其中 SyTF/SyTF-Div-Exp 在合成混沌数据上最优，SyNF-Reg 与 SyNF-Div-Reg 在真实数据上最优，并可用保形预测给出 90% 预测区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混沌系统的敏感初值依赖、强非线性和状态依赖的可变异性使得长时预测困难，现代深度学习虽短期精度高但为黑箱，缺乏科学洞见与信任度；现有符号回归研究多聚焦于恢复微分方程或静态函数关系，缺乏在滚动式时序预测场景下对符号回归的系统基准评测。作者提出的核心问题是：符号回归能否发现紧凑、可解释的混沌时序预测方程，并在精度上与现代机器学习模型竞争？选择混沌场景还具有实际意义（ENSO 预测、登革热暴发、极端海洋波、金融市场不稳定监测、公共卫生与气候风险管理等）。

Method: （1）基准数据：从 'dysts' 仓库构建 132 个低维混沌吸引子（Lorenz、Rössler、Chua 等）单变量序列，每周期 100 个采样点，共 1200 点，按时间顺序前 1000 训练、后 200 测试，并计算最大 Lyapunov 指数确认全部为正；真实数据为圣胡安登革热周报数（1196 点，1144 训练/52 测试）与 Niño 3.4 周 SST（1634 点，1582/52），并用 Terasvirta 非线性检验、KPSS 平稳性、Ollech-Webel 季节性、Anderson-Darling 正态性检验及 ACF/PACF 做先验分析（两者均平稳、呈混沌、显著偏离正态，ACF 显示短记忆与周期性）。\n（2）SyNF：把 EQL 的激活函数替换为固定代数算子（identity/sin/cos 一元 + 逐元素乘法二元），单隐藏层、线性输入层与输出层，全部可微，用 Adam 最小化 MSE；SyNF-Reg 加 ℓ1 稀疏正则；SyNF-Div 在输出层引入带阈值 γ 的除法单元 h_γ，并对小/负分母加惩罚 P^γ，间隔 50 epoch 施加惩罚训练（附加输出界惩罚 P^bound），γ 按 1/√(t+1) 逐步放松，验证测试固定 1e-4；SyNF-Div-Reg 叠加 ℓ1。\n（3）SyTF：基于 PySR 的多种群进化算法，采用 evolve–simplify–optimize 循环，锦标赛选择 + 变异/交叉 + 模拟退火，simplify 用代数恒等式化简，optimize 用 BFGS 精调常数；以表达式树节点数衡量复杂度，用 'frecency' 自适应惩罚与 Pareto 前沿做准确率—复杂度权衡；基础版算子含 +、−、×、sin、cos，扩展版 SyTF-Div-Exp 加入除法与指数。\n（4）实验：滚动窗口一步向前预测，滞后阶数取 5/10/25（真实数据取 4 阶），指标为 SMAPE、RMSE、MAE、MARRE；基线包括 RandomForest、XGBoost、LightGBM、NLinear、NBeats、NHiTS、LSTM、Transformer、TiDE；用 Nemenyi MCB 检验做统计显著性比较；并对最优的 SyNF-Div-Reg 用加权保形预测（独立校准集）构建 90% 预测区间。

Result: 合成混沌吸引子（5/10/25 阶滞后）：SyTF 与 SyTF-Div-Exp 在四项指标上中位误差最低且离散度最小，SyNF/SyNF-Reg 具竞争力但方差更大；深度模型（NBeats、NHiTS、TiDE、LSTM）中位表现中等但泛化差，Transformer 因样本量小而误差最高，树集成方差偏大。MCB 检验显示 SyTF 平均秩最低（RMSE 秩 1.98），其余模型临界距离超出参考区间，差异显著。真实数据：圣胡安登革热上 SyNF-Reg 最优（SMAPE 20.95、RMSE 20.69、MAE 15.76、MARRE 6.91），优于 NHiTS、NBeats、TiDE、LightGBM 等，LSTM 与 Transformer 明显最差；ENSO Niño 3.4 上 SyNF-Div-Reg 全指标最优（SMAPE 0.79、RMSE 0.26、MAE 0.20、MARRE 6.30）。SyTF 在真实数据上收敛与效率较差，SyNF 家族更优。得到的方程具明确结构：SyTF 给出类自回归紧凑式（如 Niño SST：0.985y_{t-1}+0.417），SyNF 给出含多项式与三角函数的非线性式（如 SyNF-Div-Reg：-8.2e-3y_{t-1}²+0.017y_{t-1}y_{t-2}+0.553y_{t-1}+0.019y_{t-2}²-0.324y_{t-2}+0.031）。保形预测显示 90% 区间覆盖多数观测点且随波动性动态扩张/收缩。

Conclusion: 论文建立了首个面向混沌时序预测的大规模符号机器学习基准，证明符号模型（SyNF 与 SyTF）在一步向前预测上既具竞争力又能给出透明、可解析的显式方程，在合成数据上表达树方法（SyTF、SyTF-Div-Exp）占优，在真实数据上稀疏化与有理（除法）算子的神经符号家族（SyNF-Reg、SyNF-Div-Reg）泛化更好，并可配合保形预测提供随波动率自适应的可靠区间，适合高风险应用。局限与未来方向：仅评估滚动式一步预测，需扩展到多步预测并考察迭代预测下方程的稳定性；引入多变量与外生驱动因素（气候、疫情）；将符号发现与动力系统约束（稳定性、不变性先验）结合以缩小搜索空间并提升鲁棒性；探索移动健康监测、心率/ECG/EEG 等连续健康时序中可解释预测的应用。代码与数据已开源于 GitHub（mad-stat/Symbolic_Forecasting）。

Abstract: Chaotic time series are notoriously difficult to forecast. Small uncertainties in initial conditions amplify rapidly, while strong nonlinearities and regime dependent variability constrain predictability. Although modern deep learning often delivers strong short horizon accuracy, its black box nature limits scientific insight and practical trust in settings where understanding the underlying dynamics matters. To address this gap, we propose two complementary symbolic forecasters that learn explicit, interpretable algebraic equations from chaotic time series data. Symbolic Neural Forecaster (SyNF) adapts a neural network based equation learning architecture to the forecasting setting, enabling fully differentiable discovery of compact and interpretable algebraic relations. The Symbolic Tree Forecaster (SyTF) builds on evolutionary symbolic regression to search directly over equation structures under a principled accuracy complexity trade off. We evaluate both approaches in a rolling window nowcasting setting with one step ahead forecasting using several accuracy metrics and compare against a broad suite of baselines spanning classical statistical models, tree ensembles, and modern deep learning architectures. Numerical experiments cover a benchmark of 132 low dimensional chaotic attractors and two real world chaotic time series, namely weekly dengue incidence in San Juan and the Nino 3.4 sea surface temperature index. Across datasets, symbolic forecasters achieve competitive one step ahead accuracy while providing transparent equations that reveal salient aspects of the underlying dynamics.

</details>


### [206] [Adaptive Double-Booking Strategy for Outpatient Scheduling Using Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07270)
*Ninda Nurseha Amalina,Heungjo An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种自适应门诊双重预约框架，结合个体化患者爽约预测与多目标强化学习，以动态决定单约、双约或拒绝预约请求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 门诊患者爽约扰乱诊所运营、降低生产力并可能延误治疗。现有方法采用超订或双订策略，但校准不当会增加拥塞和等待时间，且现有方法依赖固定启发式规则，无法适应实时调度条件或患者特异性爽约风险。

Method: 将调度问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，使用Multi-Head Attention Soft Random Forest模型预测患者爽约概率并纳入强化学习状态；开发了配备多策略协同进化机制的Multi-Policy Proximal Policy Optimization方法，提出基于Kullback-Leibler散度的τ规则实现行为相似策略间的选择性知识转移；使用SHAP解释爽约风险预测和智能体调度决策。

Result: 框架能够动态决定何时单约、双约或拒绝预约请求，τ规则提高了收敛速度并扩展了权衡多样性，SHAP提供了可解释性。

Conclusion: 该框架为传统门诊预约策略提供了动态且数据驱动的替代方案，在适应实时条件和患者特异性风险方面具有优势。

Abstract: Patient no-shows disrupt outpatient clinic operations, reduce productivity, and may delay necessary care. Clinics often adopt overbooking or double-booking to mitigate these effects. However, poorly calibrated policies can increase congestion and waiting times. Most existing methods rely on fixed heuristics and fail to adapt to real-time scheduling conditions or patient-specific no-show risk. To address these limitations, we propose an adaptive outpatient double-booking framework that integrates individualized no-show prediction with multi-objective reinforcement learning. The scheduling problem is formulated as a Markov decision process, and patient-level no-show probabilities estimated by a Multi-Head Attention Soft Random Forest model are incorporated in the reinforcement learning state. We develop a Multi-Policy Proximal Policy Optimization method equipped with a Multi-Policy Co-Evolution Mechanism. Under this mechanism, we propose a novel τ rule based on Kullback-Leibler divergence that enables selective knowledge transfer among behaviorally similar policies, improving convergence and expanding the diversity of trade-offs. In addition, SHapley Additive exPlanations is used to interpret both the predicted no-show risk and the agent's scheduling decisions. The proposed framework determines when to single-book, double-book, or reject appointment requests, providing a dynamic and data-driven alternative to conventional outpatient scheduling policies.

</details>


### [207] [Spectral Discovery of Continuous Symmetries via Generalized Fourier Transforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07299)
*Pavan Karjol,Kumar Shubham,Prathosh AP*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于谱结构发现连续对称性的新框架，通过广义傅里叶变换(GFT)识别不可约表示上的稀疏性模式来检测单参数子群对称性，在双摆和顶夸克标记任务上验证了方法的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续对称性在许多科学和学习问题中至关重要，但通常事先未知。现有对称性发现方法通常直接在变换生成元空间搜索或依赖学习的增强方案，作者认为需要一种基于谱结构的根本不同的视角。

Method: 核心观察：对子群的不变性会在函数的谱分解中诱导出跨不可约表示的结构化稀疏性。开发了在极大环面(maximal tori)上的对称性检测程序，此时GFT简化为多维傅里叶分析。

Result: 在双摆和顶夸克标记等结构化任务上验证了谱稀疏性可靠地揭示单参数对称性。

Conclusion: 谱分析是一种原则性强且可解释的生成元对称性发现方法的替代方案。

Abstract: Continuous symmetries are fundamental to many scientific and learning problems, yet they are often unknown a priori. Existing symmetry discovery approaches typically search directly in the space of transformation generators or rely on learned augmentation schemes. We propose a fundamentally different perspective based on spectral structure.
  We introduce a framework for discovering continuous one-parameter subgroups using the Generalized Fourier Transform (GFT). Our central observation is that invariance to a subgroup induces structured sparsity in the spectral decomposition of a function across irreducible representations. Instead of optimizing over generators, we detect symmetries by identifying this induced sparsity pattern in the spectral domain.
  We develop symmetry detection procedures on maximal tori, where the GFT reduces to multi-dimensional Fourier analysis through their irreducible representations. Across structured tasks, including the double pendulum and top quark tagging, we demonstrate that spectral sparsity reliably reveals one-parameter symmetries. These results position spectral analysis as a principled and interpretable alternative to generator-based symmetry discovery.

</details>


### [208] [AutoResearch-RL: Perpetual Self-Evaluating Reinforcement Learning Agents for Autonomous Neural Architecture Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07300)
*Nilesh Jain,Rohit Yadav,Sagar Kotian,Claude AI*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoResearch-RL：一个由强化学习智能体在无人工干预下自主进行开放式神经架构与超参数研究的框架。智能体每轮对目标训练脚本提出代码修改，在固定的墙钟时间预算内执行，以验证集 bits-per-byte (val-bpb) 导出的标量奖励为反馈，用 PPO 更新策略，直至收敛预言机或资源耗尽。在单 GPU 的 nanochat 预训练基准上，约 300 次通宵迭代后，所发现配置达到或超过手工调优基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经网络架构与超参数搜索高度依赖专家的先验知识与人工试错，过程难以复现、效率低下且不可扩展；同时端到端的语言模型预训练管线包含大量耦合的实现细节（数据处理、优化器设置、学习率调度、模型配置等），单纯依赖网格/贝叶斯优化等黑盒方法难以在高维离散-连续混合空间中有效探索。该文动机在于：若把"研究"本身形式化为一个可学习的序贯决策问题，就能让自动化方法在无人在环的情况下持续提出假设、验证并累积经验，从而实现类似研究者直觉的迭代式改进，突破固定搜索预算与人工监督的瓶颈。

Method: 方法的核心是三部分关注点的解耦设计：(i) 冻结环境——数据管线、评估协议与常量固定不变，保证不同实验之间的公平可比性与奖励信号无偏；(ii) 可变目标文件 train.py——构成智能体唯一可编辑的内部状态，使得"研究"表现为对训练脚本的代码级修改，而非参数向量上的微调；(iii) 元学习器——即 RL 智能体本身，累积不断增长的实验结果轨迹，并以此指导后续提案。该过程被形式化为 MDP（状态为训练脚本当前内容与历史轨迹，动作空间为代码修改/补丁，奖励由 val-bpb 单调映射得到），并采用 PPO 进行策略更新以保证样本高效与训练稳定。智能体在固定的墙钟时间预算内执行每次候选配置，通过终止预言机（convergence oracle）或资源耗尽来判定结束。论文在温和假设下推导了收敛性保证，并在单 GPU 的 nanochat 预训练基准上进行实证评估。

Result: 在单 GPU 的 nanochat 预训练基准上，AutoResearch-RL 在完全无人在环的条件下，经过约 300 次通宵（over-the-night）迭代后，所发现的网络架构与超参数配置在验证集 bits-per-byte 指标上达到或超过手工调优的基线水平，表明该框架能够在真实预训练场景中实现有效的自动化开放探索。论文同时在温和假设下给出了该 MDP 形式化的收敛性理论保证。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，把开放式研究建模为带冻结环境、可编辑代码状态与元学习器的 MDP，并配合 PPO 策略优化，可以实现完全自主、无人监督的架构与超参数发现，且在小型单 GPU 基准上可匹敌人类专家调优结果。其贡献不仅在于一个可运行的自动化研究框架，更在于确立了"固定评估协议 + 代码级动作空间 + 轨迹记忆"的可扩展设计范式，为后续向更大规模模型、更丰富搜索空间（数据配方、损失函数、课程设计）以及多智能体协同研究扩展提供了基础；局限包括单基准、单 GPU、约 300 次迭代的高计算成本、动作空间与提案机制的表达力约束，以及收敛性结论依赖的温和假设。

Abstract: We present AutoResearch-RL, a framework in which a reinforcement learning agent conducts open-ended neural architecture and hyperparameter research without human supervision, running perpetually until a termination oracle signals convergence or resource exhaustion. At each step the agent proposes a code modification to a target training script, executes it under a fixed wall clock time budget, observes a scalar reward derived from validation bits-per-byte (val-bpb), and updates its policy via Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO).
  The key design insight is the separation of three concerns: (i) a frozen environment (data pipeline, evaluation protocol, and constants) that guarantees fair cross-experiment comparison; (ii) a mutable target file (train.py) that represents the agent's editable state; and (iii) a meta-learner (the RL agent itself) that accumulates a growing trajectory of experiment outcomes and uses them to inform subsequent proposals.
  We formalise this as a Markov Decision Process, derive convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, and demonstrate empirically on a single GPU nanochat pretraining benchmark that AutoResearch-RL discovers configurations that match or exceed hand-tuned baselines after approximately 300 overnight iterations, with no human in the loop.

</details>


### [209] [Retrieval-Augmented Multi-scale Framework for County-Level Crop Yield Prediction Across Large Regions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07305)
*Yiming Sun,Qi Cheng,Licheng Liu,Runlong Yu,Yiqun Xie,Xiaowei Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的作物产量预测框架，通过结合短期和长期时间依赖建模与基于检索的适应策略来解决跨区域和跨时间预测的性能退化问题


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的作物产量预测方法在应用于大地理区域和长期时性能下降，原因包括：1. 难以联合捕获短期和长期时间模式；2. 无法有效适应农业系统中空间数据的变异性

Method: 1. 提出新的骨干模型架构，同时捕获短期的日尺度作物生长动态和长期的年份间依赖关系；2. 采用基于检索的适应策略来提高跨空间区域的泛化能力；3. 设计了检索-精化流水线，通过移除输入特征无法解释的跨年偏差来调整检索样本

Result: 在630个美国县级玉米产量数据的实验中，该方法 consistently outperforms 各种类型的基线模型，验证了检索增强方法在空间异质性下提高模型鲁棒性的有效性

Conclusion: 所提出的方法在630个美国县级玉米产量数据上 consistently outperforms different types of baselines，验证了检索增强方法在空间异质性下提高模型鲁棒性的有效性

Abstract: This paper proposes a new method for crop yield prediction, which is essential for developing management strategies, informing insurance assessments, and ensuring long-term food security. Although existing data-driven approaches have shown promise in this domain, their performance often degrades when applied across large geographic regions and long time periods. This limitation arises from two key challenges: (1) difficulty in jointly capturing short-term and long-term temporal patterns, and (2) inability to effectively accommodate spatial data variability in agricultural systems. Ignoring these issues often leads to unreliable predictions for specific regions or years, which ultimately affects policy decisions and resource allocation. In this paper, we propose a new predictive framework to address these challenges. First, we introduce a new backbone model architecture that captures both short-term daily-scale crop growth dynamics and long-term dependencies across years. To further improve generalization across diverse spatial regions, we augment this model with a retrieval-based adaptation strategy. Recognizing the substantial yield variation across years, we design a novel retrieval-and-refinement pipeline that adjusts retrieved samples by removing cross-year bias not explained by input features. Our experiments on real-world county-level corn yield data over 630 counties in the US demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms different types of baselines. The results also verify the effectiveness of the retrieval-based augmentation method in improving model robustness under spatial heterogeneity.

</details>


### [210] [Adversarial Latent-State Training for Robust Policies in Partially Observable Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07313)
*Angad Singh Ahuja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究解决了部分可观测强化学习中潜在分布偏移下的鲁棒性问题，提出了对抗性潜在初始状态POMDP形式化框架，证明了潜在 minimax 原理，推导了近似最佳响应证书，并在Battleship基准测试中将鲁棒性差距从10.3降低到3.1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习(PORL)在潜在分布偏移下缺乏鲁棒性保证，当前缺乏形式化的方法来处理对手在 episode 前选择隐藏初始潜在分布的设置。

Method: 1) 形式化了对抗性潜在初始状态 POMDP 设置；2) 证明了潜在 minimax 原理并刻画了最坏情况防御者分布；3) 推导出具有有限样本保证的近似最佳响应证书；4) 在 Battleship 基准上验证了方法有效性。

Result: 使用 Battleship 基准测试表明，针对性暴露于偏移的潜在分布将 Spread 和 Uniform 分布之间的平均鲁棒性差距从 10.3 降低到 3.1 发（同等预算下）。迭代最佳响应训练表现出与近似证书理论完全一致预算敏感行为。

Conclusion: 对于潜在初始状态问题，所提框架提供精确的诊断原则，证实了结构化对抗暴露有效缓解最坏情况漏洞。

Abstract: Robustness under latent distribution shift remains challenging in partially observable reinforcement learning. We formalize a focused setting where an adversary selects a hidden initial latent distribution before the episode, termed an adversarial latent-initial-state POMDP. Theoretically, we prove a latent minimax principle, characterize worst-case defender distributions, and derive approximate best-response certificates with finite-sample guarantees, providing formal meaning to empirical training diagnostics. Empirically, using a Battleship benchmark, we demonstrate that targeted exposure to shifted latent distributions reduces average robustness gaps between Spread and Uniform distributions from 10.3 to 3.1 shots at equal budget. Furthermore, iterative best-response training exhibits budget-sensitive behavior entirely consistent with our approximate certificate theory. Ultimately, we show that for latent-initial-state problems, our framework yields precise diagnostic principles and confirms that structured adversarial exposure effectively mitigates worst-case vulnerabilities.

</details>


### [211] [ShakyPrepend: A Multi-Group Learner with Improved Sample Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07319)
*Lujing Zhang,Daniel Hsu,Sivaraman Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多组学习问题，提出ShakyPrepend方法利用差分隐私工具获得更好的理论保证，实验表明该方法能适应群体结构和空间异质性，并提供实际部署指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多组学习任务需要控制预测器在指定子群体上的条件损失，现有方法可能存在理论保证不足或无法适应复杂数据分布的问题

Method: 提出ShakyPrepend方法，利用差分隐私工具来控制预测器在指定子群体上的条件损失

Result: ShakyPrepend在理论上获得了比现有方法更好的保证，数值实验表明该方法能够适应群体结构和空间异质性

Conclusion: ShakyPrepend通过差分隐私工具获得了比现有方法更好的理论保证，数值实验表明该方法能够适应群体结构和空间异质性，为多组学习算法在实际场景中的部署提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Multi-group learning is a learning task that focuses on controlling predictors' conditional losses over specified subgroups. We propose ShakyPrepend, a method that leverages tools inspired by differential privacy to obtain improved theoretical guarantees over existing approaches. Through numerical experiments, we demonstrate that ShakyPrepend adapts to both group structure and spatial heterogeneity. We provide practical guidance for deploying multi-group learning algorithms in real-world settings.

</details>


### [212] [Norm-Hierarchy Transitions in Representation Learning: When and Why Neural Networks Abandon Shortcuts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07323)
*Truong Xuan Khanh,Truong Quynh Hoa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"范数层级跃迁"（Norm-Hierarchy Transition, NHT）框架，声称可统一解释 grokking、捷径学习、延迟特征发现与涌现能力：在 ℓ2 权重衰减下，当存在范数不同的多重插值解时，网络通过权重衰减的乘法式范数收缩缓慢"爬"过范数层级，其转变延迟满足紧界 T = Θ(γ_eff⁻¹·log(V_sc/V_st))，并给出三区制（弱/中/强正则）。理论在四个域验证，但仅模算术完全成立（6/6，R²>0.97，且该验证被推给"并行工作"），CIFAR-10 5/6、CelebA 4/6、Waterbirds 2/6，且核心定量标度 T∝1/λ 在 CIFAR-10 上明确失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作分别确立了梯度下降收敛到最小范数解（Soudry et al., 2018）与网络的简单性偏置（Shah et al., 2020），但都没有回答"表征从捷径到结构化的时间尺度由什么决定、能否预测"这一核心问题。作者观察到多类现象（捷径学习、grokking、简单性偏置、lazy-to-rich 转变）在形式上共享同一模式：延迟的表征跃迁——网络先停留于一种表征，再跳转到定性不同的表征。作者希望寻找一个与域无关的纯优化动力学机制，并给出可预测的转变时刻。

Method: 框架假设五项技术条件：(A1) 损失 L-光滑；(A2) 插值流形上梯度为零；(A3) 步长 η≤λ/L；(A4) 多重表征插值 + 范数层级（V_sc>V_st）；(A5) 捷径可达性（先到达高范数捷径解）。核心量是参数平方范数 V_t=‖θ_t‖²。定理3.1（Lyapunov 收缩上界）给出 E[V_{t+1}|F_t]≤(1−ηλ)V_t+η²σ²，展开后得逃逸时间 Θ((ηλ)⁻¹log(V_sc/V_st))；定理3.4（信息论/动力学下界）证明任何一阶正则化算法都不可能更快，构成紧界；定理3.5 综合为"范数层级跃迁定律"及三区制预测（弱正则：捷径持续；中正则：延迟跃迁；强正则：学习被压制）。推论将 grokking 特化为记忆流形→傅里叶流形的 Norm-Separation Delay Law。命题4.2（层级范数层级）引入"捷径编码容量"α_ℓ 与曲率κ_ℓ，得出每层逃逸时间 T^(ℓ)=Θ(γ_eff^(ℓ)⁻¹log(V_sc^(ℓ)/V_st^(ℓ)))，γ_eff^(ℓ)=ηλ+2ηα_ℓκ_ℓ，预测跃迁从输出层向输入层反向传播。定义4.1 提出"干净范数分离"（存在标量 φ 在捷径流形取1、结构流形取0，且与‖θ‖²单调相关、跃迁锐利）与可量化的范数分离分数 S，用以判别何时定量标度可迁移。实验：Coloured CIFAR-10（边框颜色伪特征，ρ∈{0.5,0.8,0.95,1.0}，λ∈{0.001…1.0}，6层 CNN 287,850 参数，无 BN，AdamW）；ResNet18 四变体消融（无归一化/GroupNorm/BatchNorm）；Waterbirds（224×224，最差组精度）；CelebA（Smiling 为目标、Blond Hair 为伪属性）；模算术（推迟至并行工作）。
