Result: CIFAR-10：确认三区制——弱正则范数单调增至 5000–14000（衰减<1%），中正则范数先峰后衰（最大 21.6%）且干净精度最优（≈58%），强正则范数被压制（衰减 42–64%）精度降至 26–44%；相关性越强跃迁越难（干净精度 78.2%→74.8%→58.5%→10.2%，ρ=1.0 为完美捷径负对照，捷径依赖=1.0）；13 次运行 4 种子可复现（58.5%±2.3%）；(λ,ρ) 相图呈现四区（结构化/NHT/捷径主导/抑制）。层级分析：fc 层自峰值收缩 45%、conv1 仅 31%，尽管总范数增长 73%，与 α_L>α_1 的反向跃迁一致，并给出比总范数更灵敏的早期预警指标。架构消融：ResNet18+BN 干净精度 78.1%（较无归一化 69.8% 提升 8.3 点，峰值提前至 epoch 50），四变体均呈先峰后衰；GroupNorm 异常——范数衰减 67% 与 BN 的 66% 相当，精度却仅 50.5%，说明范数收缩是必要非充分条件，BN 借 σ_c⁻² 通道放大实现选择性去除捷径。CelebA：范数按 λ 单调分离（37×），三区制可见，最差组精度单调 89.1%>88.0%>87.0%（即更强正则不改善鲁棒性），fc/conv1 比值 0.65×→2.33×，但 S=−0.11 属"无分离"情景，无延迟跃迁。Waterbirds：仅范数排序成立，S≈0，预期最差组精度无改善，WG 约 7.2–9.3%，符合"框架在违反前提时正确弃权"的负面结果。汇总：模算术 6/6、CIFAR-10 5/6、CelebA 4/6、Waterbirds 2/6，预测力随分离分数 S 优雅退化。唯一失败项 T∝1/λ（CIFAR-10 上 r=−0.43）被归因于缺乏干净范数分离。另提出涌现能力假设：若 ΔV(N) 随规模缩小，则转变延迟下降，能力在临界规模 N* 处"突然"出现（grokking 变时间、涌现变规模），给出四条可检验预测。

Conclusion: 论文主张延迟表征学习是"正则化优化下范数层级缓慢遍历"的单一机制表现，grokking、捷径学习、简单性偏置与 LLM 涌现能力共享同一动力学。贡献在于：给出首个跨域、带紧延迟界与明确失效诊断（干净范数分离准则）的统一框架；层级范数层级命题揭示跃迁由输出向输入反向传播；并把尺度律与延迟律接上。但需谨慎评估其强度：理论依赖理想化假设（精确插值 A2、步长界 A3、捷径可达性 A5 未形式化）；附录A证明中 (1−2ηλ)²≤1−ηλ 的不等式在一般 ηλ 下不成立，且 Remark 2.5 出现与定义2.2 相反的表述（误写 V_sc<V_st），γ_eff 的定义在正文与附录D中亦不一致（ηλ+ηα_ℓκ_ℓ vs ηλ+2ηα_ℓκ_ℓ），这些削弱了"紧界"的严谨性。最强的定量验证（模算术 R²>0.97）被推迟到并行工作，本文中仅为引用性证据；主实验域 CIFAR-10 的核心定量标度 T∝1/λ 明确失败，Waterbirds 与 CelebA 均无跃迁，Waterbirds 的"确认率 2/6"与 Table 2 中 P1/P2 标注与正文叙述存在内部不一致；CIFAR-10 干净精度在中等正则下仅 55–58%（弱正则下反而更高），实际上未展示"中间正则更优"的清晰倒 U。总体而言，这是一个结构清晰、有启发性且诊断性较强的假说型框架与经验报告，其对 grokking/涌现能力的推广仍属未经验证的猜想。

Abstract: Neural networks often rely on spurious shortcuts for many epochs before discovering structured representations. However, the mechanism governing when this transition occurs and whether its timing can be predicted remains unclear. Prior work shows that gradient descent converges to low norm solutions and that neural networks exhibit simplicity bias, but neither explains the timescale of the transition from shortcut features to structured representations.
  We introduce the Norm-Hierarchy Transition (NHT) framework, which explains delayed representation learning as the slow traversal of a hierarchy of parameter norms during regularized optimization. When multiple interpolating solutions exist with different norms, weight decay gradually moves the model from high norm shortcut solutions toward lower norm structured representations. We derive a tight bound showing that the transition delay grows logarithmically with the ratio between shortcut and structured norms.
  Experiments on modular arithmetic, CIFAR-10 with spurious features, CelebA, and Waterbirds support the predictions of the framework. The results suggest that grokking, shortcut learning, and delayed feature discovery arise from a common mechanism based on norm hierarchy traversal during training.

</details>


### [213] [Learning Concept Bottleneck Models from Mechanistic Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07343)
*Antonio De Santis,Schrasing Tong,Marco Brambilla,Lalana Kagal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: M-CBM是一种新型概念瓶颈模型，通过稀疏自编码器从黑盒模型中提取概念，并使用多模态LLM进行命名和注释，解决了传统CBM概念预测能力不足的问题，在多个数据集上性能超越先前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的概念瓶颈模型(CBM)通常通过人工指定、使用知识图谱、提示LLM或通用CLIP概念来选择要学习的概念。然而，这些先验定义的概念可能不具备足够的任务预测能力，甚至可能无法从可用数据中学习。这导致CBM在控制信息泄漏的情况下，其性能显著落后于黑盒模型。

Method: 提出了一种名为Mechanistic CBM (M-CBM)的新型CBM管道。核心方法是：1)使用稀疏自编码器(SAE)从黑盒模型中提取学习到的概念；2)使用多模态大语言模型在选定的图像子集上对这些概念进行命名和注释；3)引入NCC(Number of Contributing Concepts)作为决策级稀疏性度量指标，用于公平比较和泄漏控制。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，M-CBM在匹配稀疏性条件下一致性地超越之前的CBM方法，同时改善了概念预测性能并提供了简洁的解释。

Conclusion: M-CBMs通过从黑盒模型自身提取概念构建瓶颈层，在匹配稀疏性条件下一致性地超越之前的CBM方法，同时提供更精确的概念预测和更简洁的解释。该方法有效解决了传统CBM中概念预测能力不足的问题。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) aim for ante-hoc interpretability by learning a bottleneck layer that predicts interpretable concepts before the decision. State-of-the-art approaches typically select which concepts to learn via human specification, open knowledge graphs, prompting an LLM, or using general CLIP concepts. However, concepts defined a-priori may not have sufficient predictive power for the task or even be learnable from the available data. As a result, these CBMs often significantly trail their black-box counterpart when controlling for information leakage. To address this, we introduce a novel CBM pipeline named Mechanistic CBM (M-CBM), which builds the bottleneck directly from a black-box model's own learned concepts. These concepts are extracted via Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and subsequently named and annotated on a selected subset of images using a Multimodal LLM. For fair comparison and leakage control, we also introduce the Number of Contributing Concepts (NCC), a decision-level sparsity metric that extends the recently proposed NEC metric. Across diverse datasets, we show that M-CBMs consistently surpass prior CBMs at matched sparsity, while improving concept predictions and providing concise explanations. Our code is available at https://github.com/Antonio-Dee/M-CBM.

</details>


### [214] [Learning Clinical Representations Under Systematic Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07348)
*Yuanyun Zhang,Shi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种实践不变表示学习框架(Practice Invariant Representation Learning)，用于解决临床预测模型在不同医院间因测量策略、文档实践和工作流程差异导致的分布偏移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床机器学习模型通常在大规模、多模态的基础范式下训练，但部署环境与训练数据生成设置存在系统性差异。这种差异源于不同机构的测量策略、文档实践和工作流程，导致生理信号与实践特定人工制品的表示纠缠。

Method: 将临床观察建模为由潜在生理因素和环境依赖过程产生，结合监督风险最小化与对抗环境正则化以及跨医院的不变风险惩罚，联合优化预测性能同时抑制嵌入表示中的环境预测信息。

Result: 在多个纵向EHR预测任务和跨机构评估中，该方法相对于掩码预训练和标准监督基线，将分布外AUROC提高2-3个百分点，同时保持分布内性能并改善校准。

Conclusion: 显式考虑表示学习中的系统性分布偏移可产生更稳健和可迁移的临床模型，强调了结构不变性在医疗AI中的重要性，与架构规模化同等重要。

Abstract: Clinical machine learning models are increasingly trained using large scale, multimodal foundation paradigms, yet deployment environments often differ systematically from the data generating settings used during training. Such shifts arise from heterogeneous measurement policies, documentation practices, and institutional workflows, leading to representation entanglement between physiologic signal and practice specific artifacts. In this work, we propose a practice invariant representation learning framework for multimodal clinical prediction. We model clinical observations as arising from latent physiologic factors and environment dependent processes, and introduce an objective that jointly optimizes predictive performance while suppressing environment predictive information in the learned embedding. Concretely, we combine supervised risk minimization with adversarial environment regularization and invariant risk penalties across hospitals. Across multiple longitudinal EHR prediction tasks and cross institution evaluations, our method improves out of distribution AUROC by up to 2 to 3 points relative to masked pretraining and standard supervised baselines, while maintaining in distribution performance and improving calibration. These results demonstrate that explicitly accounting for systematic distribution shift during representation learning yields more robust and transferable clinical models, highlighting the importance of structural invariance alongside architectural scale in healthcare AI.

</details>


### [215] [Latent Generative Models with Tunable Complexity for Compressed Sensing and other Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07357)
*Sean Gunn,Jorio Cocola,Oliver De Candido,Vaggos Chatziafratis,Paul Hand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于嵌套dropout的可调复杂度生成模型先验方法，适用于扩散模型、归一化流和变分自编码器，在压缩感知、图像修复、去噪和相位检索等逆问题上取得更低的重建误差，并在线性去噪场景下提供了理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型通常使用固定复杂度/维度表示自然信号，这种限制性导致当维度太小时表示误差过高，维度太大时对噪声过拟合。现有方法缺乏根据具体问题动态调整模型复杂度的能力。

Method: 开发了基于嵌套dropout的可调复杂度先验方法，可应用于扩散模型、归一化流和变分自编码器三种主流生成模型架构。

Result: 在压缩感知、图像修复、去噪和相位检索等任务中，可调复杂度先验相比固定复杂度基线方法 consistently achieves lower reconstruction errors。在线性去噪场景下，理论分析明确描述了最优调参参数与噪声和模型结构的关系。

Conclusion: 本研究证明了可调复杂度生成模型先验的潜力，推动了相关理论发展，并为其在广泛逆问题中的应用提供了 motivation。

Abstract: Generative models have emerged as powerful priors for solving inverse problems. These models typically represent a class of natural signals using a single fixed complexity or dimensionality. This can be limiting: depending on the problem, a fixed complexity may result in high representation error if too small, or overfitting to noise if too large. We develop tunable-complexity priors for diffusion models, normalizing flows, and variational autoencoders, leveraging nested dropout. Across tasks including compressed sensing, inpainting, denoising, and phase retrieval, we show empirically that tunable priors consistently achieve lower reconstruction errors than fixed-complexity baselines. In the linear denoising setting, we provide a theoretical analysis that explicitly characterizes how the optimal tuning parameter depends on noise and model structure. This work demonstrates the potential of tunable-complexity generative priors and motivates both the development of supporting theory and their application across a wide range of inverse problems.

</details>


### [216] [N-Tree Diffusion for Long-Horizon Wildfire Risk Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07361)
*Yucheng Xing,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NT-Diffusion是一种用于长视野野火风险预测的分层扩散模型，通过共享早期去噪阶段并在不同视野水平分支，解决了传统扩散模型在多步预测中计算冗余的问题，实现了精度提升和推理成本降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野野火风险预测需要在稀疏事件监督下生成概率空间字段，同时在多个预测视野中保持计算效率。现有扩展扩散模型进行多步预测的方法需要对每个视野独立重复去噪过程，导致计算冗余。

Method: NT-Diffusion采用分层扩散模型架构，共享早期去噪阶段并在后期针对不同预测视野进行分支细化。火灾发生被表示为连续的火灾风险图(FRMs)，提供适合概率建模的平滑空间风险场。

Result: NT-Diffusion在新建的真实世界野火数据集上进行评估，结果表明相比基线预测方法，该框架实现了持续的精度提升和降低的推理成本。

Conclusion: NT-Diffusion通过分层共享早期去噪阶段并在后期分支的方法，在长视野野火风险预测中实现了更高的精度和更低的推理成本，为稀疏事件监督下的概率空间预测提供了一种高效且准确的解决方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon wildfire risk forecasting requires generating probabilistic spatial fields under sparse event supervision while maintaining computational efficiency across multiple prediction horizons. Extending diffusion models to multi-step forecasting typically repeats the denoising process independently for each horizon, leading to redundant computation. We introduce N-Tree Diffusion (NT-Diffusion), a hierarchical diffusion model designed for long-horizon wildfire risk forecasting. Fire occurrences are represented as continuous Fire Risk Maps (FRMs), which provide a smoothed spatial risk field suitable for probabilistic modeling. Instead of running separate diffusion trajectories for each predicted timestamp, NT-Diffusion shares early denoising stages and branches at later levels, allowing horizon-specific refinement while reducing redundant sampling. We evaluate the proposed framework on a newly collected real-world wildfire dataset constructed for long-horizon probabilistic prediction. Results indicate that NT-Diffusion achieves consistent accuracy improvements and reduced inference cost compared to baseline forecasting approaches.

</details>


### [217] [Scaling Laws in the Tiny Regime: How Small Models Change Their Mistakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07365)
*Mohammed Alnemari,Rizwan Qureshi,Nader Begrazadah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统刻画了 20M 参数以下（TinyML/边缘 AI 所处区间）的模型缩放行为：在 CIFAR-100 上以 90 次训练（18 种配置 × 5 种子）、2 个架构族（ScaleCNN 与 MobileNetV2）、22K–19.8M 参数、近三个数量级范围内，发现误差率仍近似服从幂律（α=0.156 与 α=0.106），但局部指数随规模衰减、MobileNetV2 在 19.8M 处饱和；更重要的结论是缩放会重塑错误结构（最小与最大模型错误集 Jaccard 仅 0.35）、小模型采取"类别分诊"策略（Gini 0.26→0.09，bottom-5 准确率 10%→53%）、且最小模型反而最校准（ECE=0.013，ScaleCNN 呈倒 U 型）。因此边缘部署必须在目标模型尺寸上做验证，不能依赖聚合准确率或大模型误差模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典缩放定律（Kaplan/Hoffmann/Hestness 等）几乎都建立在 10M 参数以上、且以交叉熵损失为拟合目标；TinyML 与边缘 AI 实际运行的区间（≤20M 参数、微控制器 ≤256KB RAM / ≤1mW）几乎无人系统研究。核心待答问题有三：(1) 幂律形式在小模型区间是否延续；(2) 压缩是仅提高错误率，还是改变"哪些输入出错"；(3) 校准与类别级公平性如何随规模变化。对安全关键部署而言，失败分布与失败率同等重要——压缩后误差若转移到某个稀有子群体，可能比均匀分布的低准确率更危险。

Method: 实验：在 CIFAR-100（50K 训练/10K 测试/100 类，32×32）上，ScaleCNN（4 block，通道 [c,2c,4c,8c]，c∈{4..64}，N∝c²，22K–4.7M）与 MobileNetV2（宽度系数 m∈{0.10..3.00}，214K–19.8M，首层 stride 改 1），共 18 配置 × 5 种子 = 90 次训练。训练协议全族统一：SGD+momentum 0.9、weight decay 5e-4、cosine 1e-1→1e-5、200 epoch、batch 128、随机裁剪+翻转+Cutout(8×8)；取第 200 epoch 模型（无早停/最优检查点）以保证等训练预算。测量：top-1/top-5、每类准确率向量、逐样本错误掩码、Gini、ECE(15 bins)、正确/错误预测的平均置信度。理论：沿用并扩展 Sharma & Kaplan 的数据流形本征维谱理论——数据协方差特征值 λ_k~k^{-β}，有效秩 K(N)~N^γ，残余损失 L~K^{1-β} ⇒ α=γ(β-1)；作者直接在 CIFAR-100 50,000×3,072 数据矩阵上做 PCA 拟合 β（k=10–500），并由实测 α 反推 γ 作定量对账。统计分析：对每种子指数做双样本 t 检验，Jaccard 用 25 组种子配对 + 10,000 次 bootstrap 95% CI，Gini 另设二项零模型（每类 100 张测试图）作为采样噪声下界。

Result: (1) 幂律成立但为"近似"：ScaleCNN error~N^{-0.156±0.002}（R²=0.965），MobileNetV2 error~N^{-0.106±0.001}（R²=0.914），两者差异显著（t=50.9, p<10^-6）；名义上比 LLM 的 α≈0.076 陡 1.4–2×，但因拟合目标为误差率而非交叉熵损失（训练损失指数高达 0.84 / 0.30），跨指标比较只能视为近似提示。(2) 非均匀性：局部指数从极小区间 0.23 单调衰减到 0.10（ScaleCNN，符 BNSL 的平滑弯折幂律）；MobileNetV2 在小宽度处剧烈振荡（0.44→0.08→0.23，跨种子稳定但机制未明，作者推测为瓶颈投影维度跨越整数阈值），m=2.0→3.0（9M→19.8M）仅 +0.14% 准确率、α_local=0.006，参数/样本比 396:1 呈过参数化饱和。(3) 错误重分布：ScaleCNN c=4 与 c=64 的错误集 Jaccard=0.349±0.004（25 种子对，95% CI [0.342,0.356]），显著低于独立错误基线 0.21 与最大包含 0.42；同配置跨种子基线为 0.704±0.007，说明约 30% 误差变化来自随机初始化，额外部分源于规模；相邻尺寸共享 65–72% 误差，重分布渐进累积；跨架构比较显示"规模比架构更主导误差模式"。(4) 类别分诊（"公平税"）：每类准确率 Gini 从 0.257±0.011 降至 0.087±0.005（差值 95% CI [0.153,0.187]，p<0.001），而二项零模型下期望 Gini 仅 0.067/0.032，说明是真实类别差异；bottom-5 类准确率提升 5.3×（10.2%→52.6%），top-5 仅 1.2×（78.3%→94.0%），最难类为 boy/girl、maple/oak tree、leopard/tiger 等细粒度对。(5) 校准倒 U：ScaleCNN ECE 由 0.013(c=4) 升至峰值 0.110(c=32, 1.2M) 再回落至 0.082(c=64)；MobileNetV2 单调上升 0.016→0.072 且在饱和端 m=3.0 跳升。作者重要澄清：小模型低 ECE 主要源于全局平均置信度 0.425 与准确率 41.7% 的偶然匹配（对正确样本置信 0.57、错误 0.32），并非真正的逐 bin 精细校准。(6) 谱理论对账：CIFAR-100 实测 β=1.45±0.004（R²=0.996），远陡于自然图像 β≈1.1；理论预测 α=γ(β-1) 的函数形式与 α_CNN>α_MobNet 的定性排序正确，反推 γ_CNN≈0.35、γ_MobNet≈0.24（均低于宽度计数的 0.5），但 γ 未独立测量，对账部分循环。(7) 参数效率对照：ScaleCNN c=64（4.7M，75.32%）比 MobileNetV2 m=3.0（19.8M，70.15%）准确率高逾 5 个百分点而参数少 4.2×；在配平参数（~2.5M）下仍领先约 4 点。

Conclusion: 缩放定律确实延伸至 20M 以下区间，但呈"断裂/弯折"而非单一幂律，且强架构依赖：简单卷积在小参数预算下缩放更陡（α=0.156 vs 0.106），因其无结构冗余开销；MobileNetV2 的深度可分离设计在 sub-1M 区间先付容量税、却在 19.8M 率先撞上数据容量天花板。因此对 TinyML 实践者的建议是：<500K 参数预算优先选朴素卷积而非推理优化结构；容量应与数据集规模匹配（在 CIFAR-100 上 m>1.5 的扩容只增过自信不增能力）；最重要的是部署验证必须在目标尺寸上进行——大模型（哪怕同架构更大尺寸）的误差模式不能预测压缩模型的失败样本，"训练大模型→压缩→检查聚合准确率→部署"这一流程不充分，稀有/细粒度类别的性能损失与置信度可靠性须在目标尺寸单独评估。论文明确列出局限：单一数据集与两架构、仅按宽度缩放导致参数/FLOPs/激活完全共线、γ 未独立测量、与大模型文献存在指标错配、8–10 个规模点无法用 AIC/BIC 严格区分幂律与 log-linear/BNSL 等其他光滑函数。

Abstract: Neural scaling laws describe how model performance improves as a power law with size, but existing work focuses on models above 100M parameters. The sub-20M regime -- where TinyML and edge AI operate -- remains unexamined. We train 90 models (22K--19.8M parameters) across two architectures (plain ConvNet, MobileNetV2) on CIFAR-100, varying width while holding depth and training fixed. Both follow approximate power laws in error rate: $α= 0.156 \pm 0.002$ (ScaleCNN) and $α= 0.106 \pm 0.001$ (MobileNetV2) across five seeds. Since prior work fit cross-entropy loss rather than error rate, direct exponent comparison is approximate; with that caveat, these are 1.4--2x steeper than $α\approx 0.076$ for large language models. The power law does not hold uniformly: local exponents decay with scale, and MobileNetV2 saturates at 19.8M parameters ($α_{\mathrm{local}} = 0.006$). Error structure also changes. Jaccard overlap between error sets of the smallest and largest ScaleCNN is only 0.35 (25 seed pairs, $\pm 0.004$) -- compression changes which inputs are misclassified, not merely how many. Small models
  concentrate capacity on easy classes (Gini: 0.26 at 22K vs. 0.09 at 4.7M) while abandoning the hardest (bottom-5 accuracy: 10% vs. 53%). Counter to expectation, the smallest models are best calibrated (ECE = 0.013 vs. peak 0.110
  at mid-size). Aggregate accuracy is therefore misleading for edge deployment; validation must happen at the target model size.

</details>


### [218] [Learning to Reflect: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for CSI-Free mmWave Beam-Focusing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07370)
*Hieu Le,Oguz Bedir,Mostafa Ibrahim,Jian Tao,Sabit Ekin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于分层多智能体强化学习(HMARL)的可重构智能表面(RIS)控制框架，采用无CSI范式利用用户定位数据替代信道估计，通过MAPPO算法在CTDE范式下处理大规模组合动作空间，实现高层用户-反射器分配和低层焦点优化的分层控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可重构智能表面(RIS)的实际部署面临两大核心挑战：1) 信道状态信息(CSI)估计带来巨大开销；2) 集中式优化在规模化系统中面临维度爆炸问题。毫米波系统需要高精度波束聚焦，但传统方法依赖复杂的信道估计和集中式优化，难以实用化。

Method: 1) 提出"无CSI"范式，用用户定位数据替代基于导频的信道估计；2) 采用分层多智能体强化学习架构，融合MAPPO算法与CTDE范式；3) 将控制问题分解为两层：高层控制器负责用户-反射器分配，低层分布式控制器负责焦点优化；4) 使用射线追踪进行评估。

Result: 相比集中式基线，框架实现2.81-7.94 dB的RSSI提升，性能优势随系统复杂度增加而扩大；可扩展性分析显示用户密度翻倍时单用户性能降级最小，总功率稳定；鲁棒性验证表明在反射器孔径(45-99单元)和定位误差高达0.5m下仍保持有效性。

Conclusion: HMARL框架通过消除CSI开销同时保持高精度波束聚焦，为智能毫米波环境提供了一种实用解决方案。该方法在性能、可扩展性和鲁棒性之间取得了良好平衡，为RIS在毫米波通信中的实际部署铺平了道路。

Abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces promise to transform wireless environments, yet practical deployment is hindered by the prohibitive overhead of Channel State Information (CSI) estimation and the dimensionality explosion inherent in centralized optimization. This paper proposes a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (HMARL) framework for the control of mechanically reconfigurable reflective surfaces in millimeter-wave (mmWave) systems. We introduce a "CSI-free" paradigm that substitutes pilot-based channel estimation with readily available user localization data. To manage the massive combinatorial action space, the proposed architecture utilizes Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) under a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm. The proposed architecture decomposes the control problem into two abstraction levels: a high-level controller for user-to-reflector allocation and decentralized low-level controllers for low-level focal point optimization. Comprehensive ray-tracing evaluations demonstrate that the framework achieves 2.81-7.94 dB RSSI improvements over centralized baselines, with the performance advantage widening as system complexity increases. Scalability analysis reveals that the system maintains sustained efficiency, exhibiting minimal per-user performance degradation and stable total power utilization even when user density doubles. Furthermore, robustness validation confirms the framework's viability across varying reflector aperture sizes (45-99 tiles) and demonstrates graceful performance degradation under localization errors up to 0.5 m. By eliminating CSI overhead while maintaining high-fidelity beam-focusing, this work establishes HMARL as a practical solution for intelligent mmWave environments.

</details>


### [219] [ConfHit: Conformal Generative Design with Oracle Free Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07371)
*Siddhartha Laghuvarapu,Ying Jin,Jimeng Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ConfHit框架，为药物发现中的生成模型提供分布无关的有效性保证，解决预算限制、缺乏oracle访问和分布偏移问题。该框架通过加权可交换性、多样本密度比加权共形p值和嵌套检验程序，实现对生成候选集的认证和精炼。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The success of deep generative models in scientific discovery requires reliable guarantees that generated candidates satisfy desired properties. Existing conformal prediction methods face limitations in drug discovery applications due to budget constraints, lack of oracle access, and distribution shift.

Method: ConfHit leverages weighted exchangeability between historical and generated samples to eliminate the need for an experimental oracle, constructs multiple-sample density-ratio weighted conformal p-values to quantify statistical confidence in hits, and proposes a nested testing procedure to certify and refine candidate sets while maintaining statistical guarantees.

Result: Across representative generative molecule design tasks and a broad range of methods, ConfHit consistently delivers valid coverage guarantees at multiple confidence levels while maintaining compact certified sets.

Conclusion: ConfHit establishes a principled and reliable framework for generative modeling in drug discovery, providing distribution-free validity guarantees under budget constraints, lack of oracle access, and distribution shift conditions.

Abstract: The success of deep generative models in scientific discovery requires not only the ability to generate novel candidates but also reliable guarantees that these candidates indeed satisfy desired properties. Recent conformal-prediction methods offer a path to such guarantees, but its application to generative modeling in drug discovery is limited by budget constraints, lack of oracle access, and distribution shift. To this end, we introduce ConfHit, a distribution-free framework that provides validity guarantees under these conditions. ConfHit formalizes two central questions: (i) Certification: whether a generated batch can be guaranteed to contain at least one hit with a user-specified confidence level, and (ii) Design: whether the generation can be refined to a compact set without weakening this guarantee. ConfHit leverages weighted exchangeability between historical and generated samples to eliminate the need for an experimental oracle, constructs multiple-sample density-ratio weighted conformal p-value to quantify statistical confidence in hits, and proposes a nested testing procedure to certify and refine candidate sets of multiple generated samples while maintaining statistical guarantees. Across representative generative molecule design tasks and a broad range of methods, ConfHit consistently delivers valid coverage guarantees at multiple confidence levels while maintaining compact certified sets, establishing a principled and reliable framework for generative modeling.

</details>


### [220] [Sparsity and Out-of-Distribution Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07388)
*Scott Aaronson,Lin Lin Lee,Jiawei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向分布外（OOD）泛化的原则性理论框架，通过三个核心要素解释为什么稀疏假设能够实现跨分布泛化：世界以区分性特征呈现、奥卡姆剃刀偏好稀疏假设、以及稀疏假设在训练与测试分布关于相关特征充分重叠时能够泛化。论文证明了一个推广Blumer等人经典样本复杂度 bound 到 OOD 环境的定理，并将稀疏分类器推广到子空间 junta（真相分类器仅依赖特征的低维线性子空间）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决分布外泛化（OOD generalization）问题。这一问题源于1946年Goodman的"grue"悖论，是认识论的核心难题，如今也是机器学习和AI对齐中的关键挑战。

Method: 1）提出三要素原则化描述：世界以区分性特征呈现、Occam剃刀偏好稀疏假设、稀疏假设在相关特征重叠处可泛化；2）证明推广Blumer等人经典样本复杂度 bound 到 OOD 环境的定理；3）将稀疏分类器推广到子空间 junta（真相分类器仅依赖低维线性子空间）。

Result: 建立了形式化理论框架，证明稀疏假设在训练和测试分布关于假设所依赖的特征充分重叠时能够泛化，两分布在其他特征上可任意发散。

Conclusion: 为OOD泛化提供了 principled 理论解释，统一了经典样本复杂度理论与现代分布外泛化问题，为AI对齐等领域提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Explaining out-of-distribution generalization has been a central problem in epistemology since Goodman's "grue" puzzle in 1946. Today it's a central problem in machine learning, including AI alignment.
  Here we propose a principled account of OOD generalization with three main ingredients. First, the world is always presented to experience not as an amorphous mass, but via distinguished features (for example, visual and auditory channels). Second, Occam's Razor favors hypotheses that are "sparse," meaning that they depend on as few features as possible. Third, sparse hypotheses will generalize from a training to a test distribution, provided the two distributions sufficiently overlap on their restrictions to the features that are either actually relevant or hypothesized to be. The two distributions could diverge arbitrarily on other features.
  We prove a simple theorem that formalizes the above intuitions, generalizing the classic sample complexity bound of Blumer et al. to an OOD context. We then generalize sparse classifiers to subspace juntas, where the ground truth classifier depends solely on a low-dimensional linear subspace of the features.

</details>


### [221] [Feed m Birds with One Scone: Accelerating Multi-task Gradient Balancing via Bi-level Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07389)
*Xuxing Chen,Yun He,Jiayi Xu,Minhui Huang,Xiaoyi Liu,Boyang Liu,Fei Tian,Xiaohan Wei,Rong Jin,Sem Park,Bo Long,Xue Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MARIGOLD框架，将多任务梯度平衡建模为双层优化问题，利用零阶方法高效求解，在公开和工业规模数据集上验证了其效率和优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MGDA类方法虽能通过动态调整任务权重缓解多任务冲突，但主要局限在于计算效率低，需要访问所有任务梯度。

Method: MARIGOLD框架将多任务梯度平衡建模为双层优化问题，利用零阶方法（zeroth-order method）高效求解耦合的模型训练和梯度平衡问题。

Result: 在公开数据集和工业规模数据集上的广泛实验验证了该方法的效率和优越性。

Conclusion: MARIGOLD通过将梯度平衡问题建模为双层优化问题，并利用零阶方法高效求解，在保证性能的同时显著降低了计算成本，为多任务学习提供了一种高效且可扩展的统一算法框架。

Abstract: In machine learning, the goal of multi-task learning (MTL) is to optimize multiple objectives together. Recent works, for example, Multiple Gradient Descent Algorithm (MGDA) and its variants, show promising results with dynamically adjusted weights for different tasks to mitigate conflicts that may potentially degrade the performance on certain tasks. Despite the empirical success of MGDA-type methods, one major limitation of such methods is their computational inefficiency, as they require access to all task gradients. In this paper we introduce MARIGOLD, a unified algorithmic framework for efficiently solving MTL problems. Our method reveals that multi-task gradient balancing methods have a hierarchical structure, in which the model training and the gradient balancing are coupled during the whole optimization process and can be viewed as a bi-level optimization problem. Moreover, we showcase that the bi-level problem can be solved efficiently by leveraging zeroth-order method. Extensive experiments on both public datasets and industrial-scale datasets demonstrate the efficiency and superiority of our method.

</details>


### [222] [Deterministic Fuzzy Triage for Legal Compliance Classification and Evidence Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07390)
*Rian Atri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于确定性双编码器和透明模糊分类区间的可重现法律合同分类方法，使用 RoBERTa-base 双编码器在 ACORD 和 CUAD 派生数据集上训练，实现高 AUC（0.98-0.99）和可解释的三层分类系统，平衡了可解释性与模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律团队越来越多地使用机器学习对大量合同证据进行分类，但许多模型不透明、非确定性且难以与 HIPAA 或 NERC-CIP 等框架对齐。

Method: 使用 RoBERTa-base 双编码器，512维投影和余弦相似度，在 ACORD 基准上进行分级条款检索训练，然后在 CUAD 派生的二分类合规数据集上进行微调。将标量合规分数映射到三个区域：自动不合规、自动合规和人工审核，阈值在验证数据上调整以最大化自动决策覆盖率，同时约束自动决策示例的错误率不超过 2%。

Result: 在 ACORD 风格检索任务上，NDCG@5 达 0.38-0.42，NDCG@10 达 0.45-0.50，4 星 Precision@5 约 0.37；在 CUAD 派生二分类任务上，AUC 达 0.98-0.99，F1 达 0.22-0.30（取决于正类权重），在正类率约 0.6% 的高度不平衡设置下优于多数和随机基线。通过种子稳定系统实现了最大自动决策覆盖率，同时保持约 2% 的错误率约束。

Conclusion: 该方法通过确定性编码器、校正模糊 bands 和显式错误约束，在不透明大语言模型和手工规则之间提供了实用的中间方案，支持可解释的证据分类、可重现的审计追踪和法律审查概念的具体映射。

Abstract: Legal teams increasingly use machine learning to triage large volumes of contractual evidence, but many models are opaque, non-deterministic, and difficult to align with frameworks such as HIPAA or NERC-CIP. We study a simple, reproducible alternative based on deterministic dual encoders and transparent fuzzy triage bands. We train a RoBERTa-base dual encoder with a 512-dimensional projection and cosine similarity on the ACORD benchmark for graded clause retrieval, then fine-tune it on a CUAD-derived binary compliance dataset. Across five random seeds (40-44) on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, the model achieves ACORD-style retrieval performance of NDCG@5 0.38-0.42, NDCG@10 0.45-0.50, and 4-star Precision@5 about 0.37 on the test split. On CUAD-derived binary labels, it achieves AUC 0.98-0.99 and F1 0.22-0.30 depending on positive-class weighting, outperforming majority and random baselines in a highly imbalanced setting with a positive rate of about 0.6%. We then map scalar compliance scores into three regions: auto-noncompliant, auto-compliant, and human-review. Thresholds are tuned on validation data to maximize automatic decision coverage subject to an empirical error-rate constraint of at most 2% over auto-decided examples. The result is a seed-stable system summarized by a small number of scalar parameters. We argue that deterministic encoders, calibrated fuzzy bands, and explicit error constraints provide a practical middle ground between hand-crafted rules and opaque large language models, supporting explainable evidence triage, reproducible audit trails, and concrete mappings to legal review concepts.

</details>


### [223] [Generalizing Linear Autoencoder Recommenders with Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07402)
*Ruixin Guo,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Yang Zhou,Ruoming Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将EDLAE目标函数推广为解耦期望二次损失(DEQL)，通过Miller矩阵逆定理设计高效算法，实现了b>0参数下的闭式解，在基准数据集上验证了优于b=0基线的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EDLAE模型仅支持b=0时的闭式解，限制了模型的表达能力，需要推广到更广泛的超参数范围b>0。

Method: 1.将EDLAE目标函数推广为解耦期望二次损失(DEQL)形式；2.利用Miller矩阵逆定理设计高效求逆算法保证计算可行性；3.在基准数据集上验证b>0解的有效性。

Result: DEQL成功推导出b>0参数范围下的闭式解，实验表明b>0的解性能优于b=0的EDLAE基线。

Conclusion: DEQL扩展了EDLAE的解空间，使得能够发现测试性能更优的模型，为线性自编码器在推荐系统中的应用提供了更大的超参数调节自由度。

Abstract: Linear autoencoders (LAEs) have gained increasing popularity in recommender systems due to their simplicity and strong empirical performance. Most LAE models, including the Emphasized Denoising Linear Autoencoder (EDLAE) introduced by (Steck, 2020), use quadratic loss during training. However, the original EDLAE only provides closed-form solutions for the hyperparameter choice $b = 0$, which limits its capacity. In this work, we generalize EDLAE objective into a Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss (DEQL). We show that DEQL simplifies the process of deriving EDLAE solutions and reveals solutions in a broader hyperparameter range $b > 0$, which were not derived in Steck's original paper. Additionally, we propose an efficient algorithm based on Miller's matrix inverse theorem to ensure the computational tractability for the $b > 0$ case. Empirical results on benchmark datasets show that the $b > 0$ solutions provided by DEQL outperform the $b = 0$ EDLAE baseline, demonstrating that DEQL expands the solution space and enables the discovery of models with better testing performance.

</details>


### [224] [Context Channel Capacity: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Understanding Catastrophic Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07415)
*Ran Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Context Channel Capacity (C_ctx)理论，证明了零遗忘需要C_ctx >= H(T)，并建立了"不可能三角"——零遗忘、在线学习和有限参数无法同时满足。HyperNetworks通过将参数重新定义为函数值来绕过该限制。实验表明C_ctx完美预测遗忘行为：C_ctx=0的方法产生6-97%灾难性遗忘，而C_ctx≈1的HyperNetwork达到98.8%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习核心挑战，但缺乏统一的信息论解释来说明为何某些架构会遗忘而其他不会。现有方法缺乏从信息论角度对遗忘机制的深刻理解。

Method: 1) 引入C_ctx（上下文通道容量）作为上下文信号与生成参数之间的互信息；2) 证明零遗忘的充分条件C_ctx >= H(T)；3) 建立不可能三角理论；4) 提出Wrong-Context Probing (P5)诊断协议；5) 设计Gradient Context Encoder用于CIFAR-10。

Result: 在Split-MNIST上1300+实验中，C_ctx完美预测遗忘行为：C_ctx=0方法(NaiveSGD, EWC, SI, LwF, CFlow)产生6-97%灾难性遗忘；C_ctx≈1的HyperNetwork实现98.8%零遗忘。CIFAR-10上Gradient Context Encoder将oracle差距从23.3pp缩小到0.7pp。

Conclusion: 架构设计优于算法优化——上下文路径必须具有结构不可绕过性。提供了15+闭环研究方向的系统分类学，包括Hebbian零结果、θ0-记忆器现象、SN对称性障碍等。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting remains a central challenge in continual learning (CL), yet lacks a unified information-theoretic explanation for why some architectures forget catastrophically while others do not. We introduce \emph{Context Channel Capacity} ($C_\mathrm{ctx}$), the mutual information between a CL architecture's context signal and its generated parameters, and prove that zero forgetting requires $C_\mathrm{ctx} \geq H(T)$, where $H(T)$ is the task identity entropy. We establish an \emph{Impossibility Triangle} -- zero forgetting, online learning, and finite parameters cannot be simultaneously satisfied by sequential state-based learners -- and show that conditional regeneration architectures (HyperNetworks) bypass this triangle by redefining parameters as function values rather than states.
  We validate this framework across 8 CL methods on Split-MNIST (1,130+ experiments over 86 days, 4 seeds each), showing that $C_\mathrm{ctx}$ perfectly predicts forgetting behavior: methods with $C_\mathrm{ctx} = 0$ (NaiveSGD, EWC, SI, LwF, CFlow) exhibit catastrophic forgetting (6--97\%), while methods with $C_\mathrm{ctx} \approx 1$ (HyperNetwork) achieve zero forgetting (98.8\% ACC). We further propose \emph{Wrong-Context Probing} (P5), a practical diagnostic protocol for measuring $C_\mathrm{ctx}$, and extend the framework to CIFAR-10 via a novel \emph{Gradient Context Encoder} that closes the oracle gap from 23.3pp to 0.7pp. A systematic taxonomy of 15+ closed research directions -- including the Hebbian null result (frozen random features outperform learned features), CFlow's $θ_0$-memorizer phenomenon, and the $S_N$ symmetry barrier to column specialization -- provides the community with precisely diagnosed negative results. Our central design principle: \emph{architecture over algorithm} -- the context pathway must be structurally unbypassable.

</details>


### [225] [DualSpec: Accelerating Deep Research Agents via Dual-Process Action Speculation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07416)
*Shuzhang Zhong,Baotong Lu,Qi Chen,Chuanjie Liu,Fan Yang,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DualSpec提出了一种针对深度研究智能体的异构推测框架，通过区分Search和Visit动作的不同推理需求，实现高达3.28倍端到端加速同时保持与完全推理智能体相当的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型驱动的深度研究智能体在处理长时域信息检索任务时，由于频繁的推理和工具调用导致高端到端延迟。现有的推测框架采用统一策略和严格动作匹配，限制了推理加速效果和鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 基于熵的分析揭示Search和Visit动作的本质差异：Search决策具有更高不确定性且受益于显式推理，而Visit决策熵较低主要依赖模型容量；2) 提出DualSpec异构推测框架，配备轻量级基于置信度的语义验证器

Result: 在多个模型和基准测试上的实验表明，DualSpec实现了最高3.28倍的端到端加速，同时保持与完全推理智能体相当的准确性。

Conclusion: 通过识别Search和Visit动作的异质性特征并采用差异化的推测策略，DualSpec成功在深度研究智能体中实现了延迟与准确性的有效权衡，为提升LLM智能体效率提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language model-based deep research agents have been increasingly popular for addressing long-horizon information-seeking tasks, but they often incur high end-to-end latency due to extensive reasoning and frequent tool use. Speculation frameworks aim to reduce latency by overlapping action execution with reasoning; however, existing approaches typically rely on uniform speculation strategies and strict action matching, which limits inference speedups and robustness. In this work, we revisit the speculate-verify paradigm for deep research agents through the lens of action heterogeneity. We show that \textit{Search} and \textit{Visit} actions exhibit fundamentally different reasoning and model capacity requirements: entropy-based analysis reveals that Search decisions have higher uncertainty and benefit significantly from explicit reasoning, whereas Visit decisions have lower entropy and depend primarily on model capacity. Motivated by this dual-process characteristic, we propose DualSpec, a heterogeneous speculation framework equipped with a lightweight, confidence-based semantic verifier. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that DualSpec achieves up to 3.28$\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining accuracy comparable to fully reasoning agents.

</details>


### [226] [OrthoFormer: Instrumental Variable Estimation in Transformer Hidden States via Neural Control Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07431)
*Charles Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OrthoFormer，通过将工具变量估计嵌入Transformer解决相关性学习的根本缺陷。框架融合结构方向性、表示正交性、因果稀疏性和端到端一致性四个理论支柱，实现严格优于OLS的偏差性能。该工作为分布外泛化提供了因果建模新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer架构虽擅长序列建模，但根本受限于相关性学习——它们捕获由潜在混杂因素诱导的虚假关联而非不变因果机制，导致分布外泛化灾难性失败。这是一个认识论挑战：标准Transformer将静态背景因素（内在身份、风格、上下文）与动态因果流（状态演化、机制）混为一谈。

Method: 提出OrthoFormer——一种因果嵌入的Transformer架构，通过神经控制函数将工具变量估计直接嵌入Transformer模块。框架基于四个理论支柱：1）结构方向性（时间箭头 enforcement）；2）表示正交性（潜在噪声分离）；3）因果稀疏性（马尔可夫毯近似）；4）端到端一致性（梯度解耦阶段分离）。

Result: 证明OrthoFormer对任何有效工具变量滞后期达到严格小于OLS的偏差，残余偏差以O(ρ^k)几何衰减；刻画了自工具化固有的偏差-方差-外生性三难困境；识别了"神经禁止回归"现象——移除梯度解耦可改善预测损失但破坏因果有效性。实验验证了所有理论预测。

Conclusion: OrthoFormer代表从相关性到因果序列建模的范式转变，对分布漂移下的鲁棒性、可解释性和可靠决策具有深远意义。

Abstract: Transformer architectures excel at sequential modeling yet remain fundamentally limited by correlational learning - they capture spurious associations induced by latent confounders rather than invariant causal mechanisms. We identify this as an epistemological challenge: standard Transformers conflate static background factors (intrinsic identity, style, context) with dynamic causal flows (state evolution, mechanism), leading to catastrophic out-of-distribution failure. We propose OrthoFormer, a causally grounded architecture that embeds instrumental variable estimation directly into Transformer blocks via neural control functions. Our framework rests on four theoretical pillars: Structural Directionality (time-arrow enforcement), Representation Orthogonality (latent-noise separation), Causal Sparsity (Markov Blanket approximation), and End-to-End Consistency (gradient- detached stage separation). We prove that OrthoFormer achieves bias strictly less than OLS for any valid instrument lag, with residual bias decaying geometrically as O(\r{ho}k ). We characterize the bias-variance-exogeneity trilemma inherent in self-instrumenting and identify the neural forbidden regression - where removing gradient detachment improves prediction loss while destroying causal validity. Experiments confirm all theoretical predictions. OrthoFormer represents a paradigm shift from correlational to causal sequence modeling, with implications for robustness, interpretability, and reliable decision-making under distribution shift.

</details>


### [227] [Data Agent: Learning to Select Data via End-to-End Dynamic Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07433)
*Suorong Yang,Fangjian Su,Hai Gan,Ziqi Ye,Jie Li,Baile Xu,Furao Shen,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Data Agent——一个端到端的动态数据选择框架，将在线训练中的样本筛选建模为「训练感知的序贯决策问题」，用轻量级 PPO 智能体学习逐样本的选择策略，并与模型优化协同演化。其核心是「训练感知」的复合奖励：基于损失的难度信号（对应更大的优化影响）与基于预测熵的不确定性信号（对应更高的信息增益），并以奖励方差归一化实现免调参的自适应加权。大量实验显示该方法在 ImageNet-1k、MMLU 上可降低 50% 以上训练成本且性能无损/提升，并能即插即用地迁移到目标检测、语义分割与 LLM 指令微调，且对噪声/损坏数据具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习依赖超大规模数据集，训练成本高昂且数据存在大量冗余。数据选择方法（静态/动态）是提升数据效率的关键，但现有工作存在两大根本局限：(1) 依赖任务/架构特定的手工指标（聚类统计、梯度范数等），常为图像分类定制，难以迁移到目标检测等不同监督与优化结构的范式，扩展需大量任务特定重设计；(2) 样本效用本身随训练演化，但多数方法依赖已收敛的代理模型或快照式打分，容易偏向后期才显现价值或受训练波动影响的样本。作者据此提出核心问题：能否设计一个既能在训练中即时自适应选数据、又能跨任务即插即用的「智能体」？

Method: 【问题形式化】把动态数据选择写成 MDP M=(S,A,P,r,ρ,H)。状态 s = f_θ^feat(x)（backbone 特征嵌入，如分类任务中最后全连接层之前的输出），既编码样本属性也编码模型训练进展；动作为连续值 a∈[0,1] 的逐样本「选择权重」，将离散子集选择转为可微控制问题，训练时取 top-k 权重样本。【复合奖励】损失型难度奖励 R_diff = L(f_θ(x_i), y_i)，可直接从标准前向传播获得、随训练阶段自适应、任务与架构无关；置信型不确定性奖励 R_conf = 预测熵 -Σ_c p(c|x)log p(c|x)，无需额外计算。Proposition 3.1 证明在一阶 SGD 下 ‖∇_θℓ‖ ∝ 1-p_θ(y|x)，即损失与梯度更新幅度单调相关，优先高损失样本可加速经验风险最小化；Proposition 3.2 证明单样本学习的期望信息增益（KL 散度期望）∝ 预测熵，优先高不确定样本近似最大化信息增益；两者互补。【自适应加权】r = Var(R_diff)/(Var(R_diff)+Var(R_conf)+ε)，最终 R = r·R_diff + (1-r)·R_conf，利用信号方差反映其信息量，免超参调参，自动形成「先难后不确定」的自适应课程。【PPO 优化】Actor/Critic 均为三层 MLP，采用 PPO 裁剪目标 + GAE 优势估计 + TD 误差的价值函数损失，约束策略更新幅度以稳定与模型训练的协同演化；奖励模块化，可插入跨模态语义一致性信号以应对噪声标签。

Result: 1) CIFAR-10/100、Tiny-ImageNet（ResNet-18/50）：30%/50%/70% 选择比例下全面超越 EL2N、GraNd、Forgetting、RL-Selector、Herding、Moderate、Glister、DP、MoSo、CLIP-Sel、InfoBatch、UCB、ε-Greedy 等静态与动态基线；50% 数据的 CIFAR-100 与 30% 数据的 Tiny-ImageNet 即达到或超过全量训练精度（如 Tiny-ImageNet 50% 时 47.0% vs 全量 45.0%）。2) ImageNet-1k（ResNet-50, 60% 比例）：精度 76.4%（全量 71.1%，InfoBatch 76.8% 附近），训练时间 7.5h + 开销 0.03h，总体 84 GPU 小时，对比 InfoBatch 的 96.8h 与静态方法的 >224h，成本降低近 40% 并节省 55+ GPU 小时；ViT-B/ViT-L/Swin-T 上 60% 数据可省 150+ GPU 小时且性能无损，高比例下甚至超过全量训练。3) 跨范式：YOLOv8/MS-COCO 70–90% 数据 mAP 与全量持平或更优；UperNet/ADE20K 70–90% 数据 mIoU 高于全量（46.4–46.6 vs 45.4）；LLaMA-7B 指令微调 50% 数据在 MMLU（34.9→36.9）、AlpacaEval 2.0（LC 胜率 1.9→2.0，胜率 6.7→7.7）全面提升。4) 分布偏移：ImageNet-Hard/R/O 上 60–90% 数据均优于全量训练（如 ImageNet-R 38.0–38.7 vs 36.2）。5) 鲁棒性：Tiny-ImageNet 20% 噪声标签下准确率 38.1/41.9，比 CLIP-Sel 等基线高 8% 以上；损坏数据下 41.9/46.7。6) 消融：仅用 R_diff（42.1/45.0/48.2）、仅用 R_conf（42.2/45.8/48.4）均优于随机（41.5/42.8/43.1），二者结合（42.5/46.1/48.6）更优，加上自适应权重 r 后达 44.9/47.0/49.4；用复合奖励直接 top-k 选取（无 PPO）在各比例下均弱于引入 PPO 智能体，验证策略学习的增益。

Conclusion: Data Agent 将数据选择从「启发式打分」转为「可学习的决策问题」，通过训练感知的复合奖励（优化影响 + 信息增益）、方差驱动的免调参自适应加权与轻量 PPO 策略优化，实现了与模型训练闭环协同演化的动态数据选择。其数据集无关、奖励模块化的设计使其可作为即插即用模块跨任务（分类、检测、分割、LLM 微调）、跨架构（ResNet/ViT/Swin/YOLO/UperNet/LLaMA）与跨场景（分布偏移、噪声/损坏数据）迁移，在显著削减训练成本的同时保持甚至提升性能。作者期望该框架能推动数据高效学习研究，降低社区训练强模型算力门槛。

Abstract: Dynamic Data selection aims to accelerate training by prioritizing informative samples during online training. However, existing methods typically rely on task-specific handcrafted metrics or static/snapshot-based criteria to estimate sample importance, limiting scalability across learning paradigms and making it difficult to capture the evolving utility of data throughout training. To address this challenge, we propose Data Agent, an end-to-end dynamic data selection framework that formulates data selection as a training-aware sequential decision-making problem. The agent learns a sample-wise selection policy that co-evolves with model optimization, guided by a composite reward that integrates loss-based difficulty and confidence-based uncertainty signals. The reward signals capture complementary objectives of optimization impact and information gain, together with a tuning-free adaptive weighting mechanism that balances these signals over training. Extensive experiments across a wide range of datasets and architectures demonstrate that Data Agent consistently accelerates training while preserving or improving performance, e.g., reducing costs by over 50\% on ImageNet-1k and MMLU with lossless performance. Moreover, its dataset-agnostic formulation and modular reward make it plug-and-play across tasks and scenarios, e.g., robustness to noisy datasets, highlighting its potential in real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [228] [Cost-Driven Representation Learning for Linear Quadratic Gaussian Control: Part II](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07437)
*Yi Tian,Kaiqing Zhang,Russ Tedrake,Suvrit Sra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究基于成本驱动的状态表示学习用于LQG控制，提出了两种方法（显式和隐式潜在动态学习），建立了有限样本理论保证，并证明了新随机过程的持续激励性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决从部分和高维观测中进行控制的状态表示学习问题。传统方法在处理高维观测时效率低下，需要学习有效的低维潜在状态表示来实现近优控制。

Method: 提出成本驱动的状态表示学习方法，通过预测累积成本在潜在状态空间学习动态模型。包含两种方法：显式潜在状态转移函数学习（对应Part I的有限时域时变LQG）和隐式动态学习（类似MuZero，通过预测累积成本学习）。

Result: 建立了有限样本保证，找到近优表示函数和近优控制器，用于无限时域时不变LQG控制。

Conclusion: 证明了一种新的随机过程的持续激励性，该随机过程源于二次回归分析，可能具有独立的研究价值。

Abstract: We study the problem of state representation learning for control from partial and potentially high-dimensional observations. We approach this problem via cost-driven state representation learning, in which we learn a dynamical model in a latent state space by predicting cumulative costs. In particular, we establish finite-sample guarantees on finding a near-optimal representation function and a near-optimal controller using the learned latent model for infinite-horizon time-invariant Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control. We study two approaches to cost-driven representation learning, which differ in whether the transition function of the latent state is learned explicitly or implicitly. The first approach has also been investigated in Part I of this work, for finite-horizon time-varying LQG control. The second approach closely resembles MuZero, a recent breakthrough in empirical reinforcement learning, in that it learns latent dynamics implicitly by predicting cumulative costs. A key technical contribution of this Part II is to prove persistency of excitation for a new stochastic process that arises from the analysis of quadratic regression in our approach, and may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [229] [Discrete Tokenization Unlocks Transformers for Calibrated Tabular Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07448)
*Yael S. Elmatad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的表格数据方法，通过简单离散化词汇表结合高斯平滑，在600K实体（5M训练样本）上比调优后的XGBoost性能提升10.8%（MAE 35.94s vs 40.31s），KS=0.0045。消融实验表明序列顺序和time-delta tokens对性能有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度提升方法（如XGBoost）目前在表格数据基准测试中仍占主导地位。本文旨在探索即使是基本的tokenization（离散化）是否也能释放注意力机制在表格特征上的潜力。

Method: 1）使用刻意简化的离散化词汇表进行tokenization；2）对环境上下文进行离散化；3）使用自适应高斯函数平滑标签，生成校准的概率密度函数（PDF）；4）选择最小化KS统计量的自适应sigma检查点。

Result: 在600K实体（5M训练样本）上：1）比调优XGBoost提升10.8%（中位MAE 35.94s vs 40.31s）；2）KS=0.0045；3）消融实验：丢失序列顺序损失约2.0%，删除time-delta tokens损失约1.8%；4）分层校准分析揭示了仍存在校准不足的区域。

Conclusion: 架构设计对表格数据任务至关重要。即使是基本的tokenization与注意力机制结合也能超越调优后的梯度提升方法，自适应高斯平滑和上下文离散化是有效的策略。

Abstract: Gradient boosting still dominates Transformers on tabular benchmarks. Our tokenizer uses a deliberately simplistic discretized vocabulary so we can highlight how even basic tokenization unlocks the power of attention on tabular features, yet it already outperforms tuned gradient boosting when combined with Gaussian smoothing. Our solution discretizes environmental context while smoothing labels with adaptive Gaussians, yielding calibrated PDFs. On 600K entities (5M training examples) we outperform tuned XGBoost by 10.8% (35.94s vs 40.31s median MAE) and achieve KS=0.0045 with the adaptive-sigma checkpoint selected to minimize KS rather than median MAE. Ablations confirm architecture matters: losing sequential ordering costs about 2.0%, dropping the time-delta tokens costs about 1.8%, and a stratified calibration analysis reveals where miscalibration persists.

</details>


### [230] [Contact-Guided 3D Genome Structure Generation of E. coli via Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07472)
*Mingxin Zhang,Xiaofeng Dai,Yu Yao,Ziqi Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散Transformer的框架，用于根据Hi-C接触图生成大肠杆菌基因组的三维构象集合。该方法将基因组重建建模为条件生成问题，能够采样与输入Hi-C数据一致的多样化构象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基因组三维结构重建方法通常产生单一确定性结构，而实际上基因组存在异质性构象。需要一种能够生成符合Hi-C数据的构象集合（ensemble）的方法，以更准确地描述基因组的动态特性。

Method: 1. 使用粗粒化分子动力学模拟构建合成数据集，生成染色质集合及对应的圆环拓扑Hi-C图；2. 采用潜空间扩散设置，结合变分自编码器（VAE）保持per-bin对齐并支持复制感知表示；3. 通过基于Transformer的编码器和交叉注意力机制注入Hi-C信息，强制执行从Hi-C到结构的单向物理约束；4. 使用流匹配（flow-matching）目标函数进行稳定优化。

Result: 在保留的测试集合上，生成的结构成功复现了输入Hi-C的距离衰减特性和结构相关性指标，同时保持了显著的构象多样性。

Conclusion: 扩散生成建模对于集合级别的三维基因组重建是有效的，为研究基因组异质性和动态特性提供了新途径。

Abstract: In this study, we present a conditional diffusion-transformer framework for generating ensembles of three-dimensional Escherichia coli genome conformations guided by Hi-C contact maps. Instead of producing a single deterministic structure, we formulate genome reconstruction as a conditional generative modeling problem that samples heterogeneous conformations whose ensemble-averaged contacts are consistent with the input Hi-C data. A synthetic dataset is constructed using coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations to generate chromatin ensembles and corresponding Hi-C maps under circular topology. Our models operate in a latent diffusion setting with a variational autoencoder that preserves per-bin alignment and supports replication-aware representations. Hi-C information is injected through a transformer-based encoder and cross-attention, enforcing a physically interpretable one-way constraint from Hi-C to structure. The model is trained using a flow-matching objective for stable optimization. On held-out ensembles, generated structures reproduce the input Hi-C distance-decay and structural correlation metrics while maintaining substantial conformational diversity, demonstrating the effectiveness of diffusion-based generative modeling for ensemble-level 3D genome reconstruction.

</details>


### [231] [Interpretable-by-Design Transformers via Architectural Stream Independence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07482)
*Clayton Kerce,Alexis Fox*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究提出通过架构约束实现可解释性的方法，通过 Late Fusion Architecture (LFA) 维持token流和上下文语义流的独立处理，延迟整合至输出层，从而实现可解释的符号头部。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer模型性能强大但内部决策过程不透明，研究旨在探索架构约束是否可以通过设计强制实现可解释性。

Method: 提出架构流独立性原则：维持token流（携带符号结构）和上下文语义在分离的流中，保持独立可观察性，整合延迟至输出。通过Late Fusion Architecture (LFA)验证，引入Token-Position Dependence Score (PDS)量化符号结构保留程度。

Result: LFA在所有最终层保持可解释符号头部，标准transformer在第六层第三层即溶解。PDS_max: LFA=0.276, 基线=0.058。干预实验显示功能模块化：抑制LFA的recency heads造成最小语义损害(Cohen's d=-0.158)，基线则灾难性纠缠(d=-0.672)。LFA平均42%稳定性vs基线19%和11%。

Conclusion: 架构独立性通过防止过早纠缠，引导模型走向语义理解而非位置启发式。可解释性可作为架构设计标准，通过结构约束而非后验分析实现。

Abstract: While transformers achieve strong performance, their internal decision-making processes remain opaque. We investigate whether architectural constraints can enforce interpretability by design through architectural stream independence: maintaining a token stream (carrying symbolic structure) and contextual semantics in separated streams that remain independently observable throughout processing, with integration delayed until output. We validate this principle through the Late Fusion Architecture (LFA), which demonstrates interpretable symbolic heads through all the final layers, while standard transformers show dissolution by the third of six layers; we quantify this effect by introducing the Token-Position Dependence Score (PDS), with $PDS_{max}$ = 0.276 and 0.058, respectively. Crucially, intervention experiments demonstrate functional modularity: suppressing LFA's recency heads causes minimal semantic damage (Cohen's d = -0.158) versus catastrophic entanglement in baselines (d = -0.672). LFA demonstrates that architectural constraints improve underlying learning mechanisms, averaging 42% stability versus 19% and 11% for baseline comparisons, with extremes from 50% on LFA's best pairs (6 of 12 heads position-invariant) down to 0% complete collapse in over-constrained cases. By preventing premature entanglement, architectural independence steers models toward semantic understanding over positional heuristics, establishing interpretability as an architectural design criterion enforceable through structural constraints rather than post-hoc analysis.

</details>


### [232] [Enhanced Random Subspace Local Projections for High-Dimensional Time Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07500)
*Eman Khalid,Moimma Ali Khan,Zarmeena Ali,Abdullah Illyas,Muhammad Usman,Saoud Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对高维时间序列预测中的过拟合问题，提出增强型随机子空间局部投影(RSLP)框架，通过加权聚合、自适应子空间选择和Bootstrap推断等增强措施，显著改善了估计器稳定性和有限样本推断的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维时间序列预测中，当预测变量数量超过观测值时，会遭受严重过拟合问题，导致标准局部投影方法不稳定且不可靠。

Method: 提出增强型随机子空间局部投影(RSLP)框架，包含加权子空间聚合、类别感知子空间采样、自适应子空间尺寸选择以及针对依赖数据的Bootstrap推断程序。

Result: 在合成数据、宏观经济指标和FRED-MD数据集上的实验表明：(1)通过自适应子空间尺寸选择，在h>=3的预测水平上估计器变异性降低33%；(2)在高维环境（FRED-MD，126个预测变量）中，Bootstrap推断产生的置信区间在政策相关水平上窄14%，同时保持适当的覆盖率。

Conclusion: 该框架为实践者提供了一种原则性方法，将丰富的信息集纳入脉冲响应分析，同时避免了传统高维方法的不稳定性问题。

Abstract: High-dimensional time series forecasting suffers from severe overfitting when the number of predictors exceeds available observations, making standard local projection methods unstable and unreliable. We propose an enhanced Random Subspace Local Projection (RSLP) framework designed to deliver robust impulse response estimation in the presence of hundreds of correlated predictors. The method introduces weighted subspace aggregation, category-aware subspace sampling, adaptive subspace size selection, and a bootstrap inference procedure tailored to dependent data. These enhancements substantially improve estimator stability at longer forecast horizons while providing more reliable finite-sample inference. Experiments on synthetic data, macroeconomic indicators, and the FRED-MD dataset demonstrate a 33 percent reduction in estimator variability at horizons h >= 3 through adaptive subspace size selection. The bootstrap inference procedure produces conservative confidence intervals that are 14 percent narrower at policy-relevant horizons in very high-dimensional settings (FRED-MD with 126 predictors) while maintaining proper coverage. The framework provides practitioners with a principled approach for incorporating rich information sets into impulse response analysis without the instability of traditional high-dimensional methods.

</details>


### [233] [A Unified Framework for Knowledge Transfer in Bidirectional Model Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07506)
*Jianlu Shen,Fu Feng,Jiaze Xu,Yucheng Xie,Jiaqi Lv,Xin Geng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BoT框架利用离散小波变换(DWT/IDWT)将模型权重视为连续信号，将小到大和大到小模型缩放统一为信号处理的上采样/下采样操作，在DeiT、BERT、GPT上实现高达67.1%的S2L和52.8%的L2S FLOPs节省，并在GLUE和SQuAD达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前参数空间方法将小到大(S2L)和大到小(L2S)缩放视为分离且不兼容的问题，分别专注于参数合成和选择。这种碎片化视角导致专用工具的产生，阻碍了统一双向框架的发展。

Method: 提出BoT(Bidirectional knowledge Transfer)，首个统一S2L和L2S缩放的尺寸无关框架。核心观点是将模型权重视为连续信号，不同尺寸的模型代表可转移知识的不同离散化。将S2L和L2S缩放问题转化为信号处理中的上采样和下采样操作，自然地采用离散小波变换(DWT)及其逆变换(IDWT)。利用小波的递归性质，使用分解级别作为动态缩放因子来桥接不同模型尺寸。

Result: 在DeiT、BERT和GPT上进行了广泛实验，展示了显著的预训练FLOPs节省(S2L高达67.1%，L2S高达52.8%)，并在GLUE和SQuAD基准测试上实现了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: BoT是首个能够统一处理双向模型知识转移的框架，通过将模型权重视为多分辨率信号并利用小波变换实现参数自由且计算高效的不同尺寸模型桥接。

Abstract: Transferring pre-trained knowledge from a source model to a target model of a different architectural size is a key challenge for flexible and efficient model scaling. However, current parameter-space methods treat Small-to-Large (S2L) and Large-to-Small (L2S) scaling as separate, incompatible problems, focusing on parameter synthesis and selection, respectively. This fragmented perspective has resulted in specialized tools, hindering a unified, bidirectional framework. In this paper, we propose BoT (Bidirectional knowledge Transfer), the first size-agnostic framework to unify S2L and L2S scaling. Our core insight is to treat model weights as continuous signals, where models of different sizes represent distinct discretizations of the transferable knowledge. This multi-resolution perspective directly casts S2L and L2S scaling as the signal processing operations of upsampling and downsampling, naturally leading to the adoption of the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and its Inverse (IDWT). BoT leverages the recursive nature of wavelets, using the decomposition level as a dynamic scaling factor to bridge disparate model sizes in a parameter-free and computationally efficient manner. Extensive experiments on DeiT, BERT, and GPT demonstrate significant pre-training FLOPs savings (up to 67.1% for S2L, 52.8% for L2S) and state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like GLUE and SQuAD.

</details>


### [234] [Online Continual Learning for Anomaly Detection in IoT under Data Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07507)
*Matea Marinova,Shashi Raj Pandey,Junya Shiraishi,Martin Voigt Vejling,Valentin Rakovic,Petar Popovski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OCLADS是一种针对非稳态环境下物联网异常检测的新型通信框架，结合持续学习技术，通过智能样本选择和分布偏移检测机制，在边缘服务器与资源受限的物联网设备之间实现高效的模型更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在物联网异常检测场景中，随着时间推移观察数据的统计特性会发生变化，导致设备上的推理模型变得过时，需要进行战略性模型更新。现有方法难以有效应对非稳态环境下的分布漂移问题。

Method: 提出两个核心机制：1) 设备端的智能样本选择机制，用于数据传输；2) 边缘服务器端的分布偏移检测机制，用于模型更新。通过TinyML进行实验验证。

Result: 实验结果表明，OCLADS框架在实现高推理精度的同时，与基线方案相比显著减少了模型更新次数。

Conclusion: 该框架成功解决了非稳态环境下物联网异常检测的模型更新难题，通过智能通信策略在资源受限设备上实现了高效的持续学习。

Abstract: In this work, we present OCLADS, a novel communication framework with continual learning (CL) for Internet of Things (IoT) anomaly detection (AD) when operating in non-stationary environments. As the statistical properties of the observed data change with time, the on-device inference model becomes obsolete, which necessitates strategic model updating. OCLADS keeps track of data distribution shifts to timely update the on-device IoT AD model. To do so, OCLADS introduces two mechanisms during the interaction between the resource-constrained IoT device and an edge server (ES): i) an intelligent sample selection mechanism at the device for data transmission, and ii) a distribution-shift detection mechanism at the ES for model updating. Experimental results with TinyML demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves high inference accuracy while realizing a significantly smaller number of model updates compared to the baseline schemes.

</details>


### [235] [A Unified View of Drifting and Score-Based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07514)
*Chieh-Hsin Lai,Bac Nguyen,Naoki Murata,Yuhta Takida,Toshimitsu Uesaka,Yuki Mitsufuji,Stefano Ermon,Molei Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了漂移模型与分数匹配原理的精确联系。对于高斯核，证明population mean-shift场与高斯平滑分布的分数差精确等同，揭示了漂移本质上等价于平滑分布上的分数匹配目标。进一步推广到一般径向核并为拉普拉斯核建立误差边界，统一了对漂移、DMD和扩散模型的理论理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本文旨在建立漂移模型(drifting models)与扩散模型中得分匹配原理之间的精确关系。漂移模型通过核函数诱导的均值偏移差异(mean-shift discrepancy)来训练单步生成器，默认使用拉普拉斯核。作者指出需要澄清这种差异与分数匹配原则的具体联系。

Method: 1. 使用Tweedie公式建立高斯核下均值场与分数差异之间的联系<br>2. 对高斯核证明 population mean-shift 场与高斯平滑后的数据和模型分布的分数差一致<br>3. 对一般径向核推导出精确分解<br>4. 对拉普拉斯核证明严格误差边界

Result: 对于高斯核，population mean-shift场与高斯平滑后的数据和模型分布的分数差精确等同，这表明高斯核漂移本质上就是平滑分布上的分数匹配目标。同时澄清了漂移与DMD(Distribution Matching Distillation)的关系：两者都使用分数不匹配的传输方向，但漂移通过核邻域非参数地实现分数信号，而DMD使用预训练的扩散教师模型。

Conclusion: 本文建立了漂移模型与分数匹配原理的精确对应关系，证明了高斯核漂移等价于平滑分布上的分数匹配目标。对于拉普拉斯核，在低温和高维情况下漂移仍然是分数匹配的准确近似。这一理论框架统一了对漂移、DMD和扩散模型的理解。

Abstract: Drifting models train one-step generators by optimizing a mean-shift discrepancy induced by a kernel between the data and model distributions, with Laplace kernels used by default in practice. At each point, this discrepancy compares the kernel-weighted displacement toward nearby data samples with the corresponding displacement toward nearby model samples, yielding a transport direction for generated samples. In this paper, we make its relationship to the score-matching principle behind diffusion models precise by showing that drifting admits a score-based formulation on kernel-smoothed distributions. For Gaussian kernels, the population mean-shift field coincides with the score difference between the Gaussian-smoothed data and model distributions. This identity follows from Tweedie's formula, which links the score of a Gaussian-smoothed density to the corresponding conditional mean, and implies that Gaussian-kernel drifting is exactly a score-matching-style objective on smoothed distributions. It also clarifies the connection to Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD): both methods use score-mismatch transport directions, but drifting realizes the score signal nonparametrically from kernel neighborhoods, whereas DMD uses a pretrained diffusion teacher. Beyond Gaussians, we derive an exact decomposition for general radial kernels, and for the Laplace kernel we prove rigorous error bounds showing that drifting remains an accurate proxy for score matching in low-temperature and high-dimensional regimes.

</details>


### [236] [Reinforcement learning-based dynamic cleaning scheduling framework for solar energy system](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07518)
*Heungjo An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出基于强化学习的光伏面板清洁调度优化框架，在阿联酋阿布扎比进行案例验证，PPO算法相比SAC和Sim-Opt方法可实现最高13%的成本节约


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在干旱地区，灰尘和其他颗粒物的污染会显著降低光伏面板的能源输出，因此需要优化清洁调度以提高可持续性和效率

Method: 采用近端策略优化(PPO)和软演员-评论家(SAC)两种先进强化学习算法，根据不确定的环境条件动态调整清洁间隔

Result: PPO算法表现优于SAC和传统模拟优化方法，实现了高达13%的成本节约，能够动态响应天气不确定性

Conclusion: PPO算法在动态响应天气不确定性方面展现出显著优势，为可再生能源系统中的自主决策优化提供了新思路。未来需提升RL模型的泛化能力，并考虑更多因素以应用于不同地区。

Abstract: Advancing autonomous green technologies in solar photovoltaic (PV) systems is key to improving sustainability and efficiency in renewable energy production. This study presents a reinforcement learning (RL)-based framework to autonomously optimize the cleaning schedules of PV panels in arid regions, where soiling from dust and other airborne particles significantly reduces energy output. By employing advanced RL algorithms, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), the framework dynamically adjusts cleaning intervals based on uncertain environmental conditions. The proposed approach was applied to a case study in Abu Dhabi, UAE, demonstrating that PPO outperformed SAC and traditional simulation optimization (Sim-Opt) methods, achieving up to 13% cost savings by dynamically responding to weather uncertainties. The results highlight the superiority of flexible, autonomous scheduling over fixed-interval methods, particularly in adapting to stochastic environmental dynamics. This aligns with the goals of autonomous green energy production by reducing operational costs and improving the efficiency of solar power generation systems. This work underscores the potential of RL-driven autonomous decision-making to optimize maintenance operations in renewable energy systems. In future research, it is important to enhance the generalization ability of the proposed RL model, while also considering additional factors and constraints to apply it to different regions.

</details>


### [237] [One-for-All Model Initialization with Frequency-Domain Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07523)
*Jianlu Shen,Fu Feng,Yucheng Xie,Jiaqi Lv,Xin Geng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FRONT（FRequency dOmain kNowledge Transfer）框架：利用 3D/2D/4D 离散余弦变换（DCT）将预训练模型权重的低频分量提取为“learngene”（learn 基因），通过频域截断/零填充 + IDCT 重建，零训练开销地初始化任意深度/宽度的下游模型；可选的谱正则化精炼（FRONT+/FRONT++）进一步提升迁移效果。实验表明视觉任务收敛加速最高 15×，语言任务训练 FLOPs 平均减少 40.5%，达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练大模型的知识与「单体式」架构深度耦合，难以在任意规模的模型间灵活复用。现有两条路线各有缺陷：(1) 参数选择类（Wt Select、Heur-LG、Auto-LG 等）把知识视为离散局部片段（层/神经元），破坏参数间相互依赖的结构；(2) 生成式参数预测类（GHN-3 等超网络）依赖庞大且同质的模型集合，且算力开销高。本文承接「learngene」（类似遗传密码的、与架构和任务无关的紧凑知识载体）理念，但已有实现要么做片段启发式挑选、要么需高成本辅助模型训练，仍与「通用高效初始化」的愿景存在落差。作者转而从权重的频谱属性出发：受优化过程（低秩流形、神经元间强相关）诱导偏置与谱偏置（spectral bias）驱动，权重的能量集中于低频分量，因此任务无关的奠基性知识应编码在低频系数中，而与架构/任务耦合的任务特异细节位于高频。附录 A 进一步形式化证明：微调起始处梯度几乎全部集中于高频子空间（‖P_H(G)‖ ≫ ‖P_L(G)‖），故低频权重在微调中保持稳定，可视为「不变的 learngene」。

Method: 框架分四部分。(1) 变换基选择：对权重张量做可逆 DCT（ViT 用 3D-DCT 覆盖「层×输入维×输出维」，MLP 用 2D-DCT，CNN 用 4D-DCT），频域「低频」具有平滑性这一普适语义，且实数-实数变换避免 DFT 的复数相位歧义。(2) FRONT（直接提取）：对 Ω={W_qkv, W_o, W_fc1, W_fc2} 施加 DCT 得 Φ，用二值掩码 M_r 沿三轴保留满足 l≤⌊rL⌋、m≤⌊r·d_in⌋、n≤⌊r·d_out⌋ 的低频系数，所得 G 即 learngene；完全免训练，CPU 上毫秒级完成。(3) FRONT+（精炼）：引入软维度的频率惩罚掩码 M_{r+}[l,m,n]=Π_d[1−exp(−f_d/γ_d)]，按归一化频率对高频系数能量做归一化惩罚 L_reg=(1/‖M⊙Φ‖₀)Σ(M·Φ)²，总损失 L=(1−λ)L_task+λL_reg（L_task 可叠加 KD 蒸馏损失）；可从零训练（150 epoch，LeViT-384/RegNetY-16GF 作教师）或仅短暂微调已训模型（FRONT++，约 20 epoch 即可达到从零训练 150 epoch 的水平）。精炼后再按同样方式截断提取 learngene，得到更平滑、抗伪影的谱表示。(4) 变尺寸初始化：learngene 在频域按需零填充（扩维）或截断（缩维，可逐维混合），再经 IDCT 重建目标权重。

Result: 视觉（ImageNet-1K，源模型 DeiT-Ti/S/B）：直接提取的 FRONT（0 epoch）在所有深度/宽度组合上超过 LiGO 约 2%、He-Init 约 19.8%，并优于 Wt Select/Heur-LG/Cluster-LG/GHN-3/Share-Init/Auto-LG/TLEG；FRONT+ 全面超过 WAVE，且传输参数量少 25% 以上（Ti 0.8M vs 1.1M），仅 10 epoch 即超过 150 epoch 完整预训练（加速 15×），第 7 epoch 达 70.08%，距 150 epoch 基准 70.20% 仅 0.12pt（预热期压缩约 21×）。宽度扩展（L6，W384–1536）FRONT+ 达 78.7%，优于 WAVE 78.3%、LiGO 73.7%。跨数据集：7 个分类数据集上 FRONT+ 平均 85.8%（DeiT-S），与直接微调预训练模型相当且传输参数更少；ResNet-101→ResNet-50/152 在 Flowers、CUB、Cars 等小样本细粒度数据集上提升巨大（如 ResNet-152 Flowers +59.7pt）。语言（BERT/RoBERTa/GPT-2，Base→Small）：训练 FLOPs 平均降低 40.5%（BERT-S 47.5%、RoBERTa-S 42.9%、GPT-S 31.0%）；GLUE 上 BERT-S 平均 64.63，远超从零训练 53.31 与 KD 52.81（STS-B +36.96，QNLI +13.65）。消融：r∈[0.50,0.83]、γ_d∈[0.125,0.25] 时收益饱和且稳定优于 Scratch 13pt 以上；基函数对比 DCT > DWT > DFT > PCA/SVD（跨模型初始化上 PCA/SVD 显著更差）；低频分量初始化（48.6–59.6）远超中频/高频；模块级消融显示视觉可迁移知识集中在 MLP（单模块 54.8 vs 全模块 55.3），语言集中在自注意力（63.61 vs 64.63）；可视化表明 FRONT 初始化的模型继承预训练 ViT 自注意力的对角结构特性。

Conclusion: 本文实证揭示并形式化论证了 learngene 的具体载体——权重低频分量，并据此提出 FRONT 系列：以 DCT 实现「一次提取、任意尺寸初始化」的免训练知识迁移，把单一预训练模型的知识解耦为与架构/任务无关的通用蓝图；可选的谱正则化精炼以极低成本进一步提升可迁移性。实验表明该方法在视觉与语言、ViT/MLP/CNN 多种架构上均取得 SOTA 精度，显著降低训练 FLOPs 与收敛时间，并支持与知识蒸馏等能力增强技术叠加。局限在于源/目标架构差异过大时（如 Transformer→纯 CNN，缺少共享张量轴语义）迁移会退化；未来方向包括更通用的变换机制、自适应高频分量迁移与极端跨范式的中间表示学习。

Abstract: Transferring knowledge by fine-tuning large-scale pre-trained networks has become a standard paradigm for downstream tasks, yet the knowledge of a pre-trained model is tightly coupled with monolithic architecture, which restricts flexible reuse across models of varying scales. In response to this challenge, recent approaches typically resort to either parameter selection, which fails to capture the interdependent structure of this knowledge, or parameter prediction using generative models that depend on impractical access to large network collections. In this paper, we empirically demonstrate that a model's foundational, task-agnostic knowledge, its "learngene", is encoded within the low-frequency components of its weights, and can be efficiently inherited by downstream models. Based on this insight, we propose FRONT (FRequency dOmain kNowledge Transfer), a novel framework that uses the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) to isolate the low-frequency "learngene". This learngene can be seamlessly adapted to initialize models of arbitrary size via simple truncation or padding, a process that is entirely training-free. For enhanced performance, we propose an optional low-cost refinement process that introduces a spectral regularizer to further improve the learngene's transferability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FRONT achieves the state-of-the-art performance, accelerates convergence by up to 15 times in vision tasks, and reduces training FLOPs by an average of 40.5% in language tasks.

</details>


### [238] [Neural Dynamics-Informed Pre-trained Framework for Personalized Brain Functional Network Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07524)
*Hongjie Jiang,Yifei Tang,Shuqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"神经动力学信息驱动的预训练框架"（Shuqiang Wang 等，SIAT），用于在异质场景下构建**个性化脑功能网络**。核心思路：以 UK Biobank 大规模 fMRI 预训练一个潜空间扩散模型基础模型，再用脑波动力学方程约束微调得到个性化神经活动模式表征；该表征同时驱动两个下游模块——(1) 基于 MRF/Gibbs 能量与图割的自适应脑区划分，(2) 基于 Transformer 自注意力+交叉注意力的神经活动相关性估计——最终输出个性化脑功能网络。在 18 个公开数据集（1008 受试者）上的评估显示：网络一致性（1−PDiv 中位数 0.65–0.8 vs 基线 0.55–0.65）、脑疾病诊断准确率（中位 0.73–0.90 vs <0.73）、年龄预测 R²（≈0.90 vs 0.72）、运动想象解码（>0.80 vs <0.75）、个体识别、虚拟神经调制恢复率（PD/ASD/MDD 分别提升 8%/6.3%/2%）、以及跨采集策略异常神经环路一致性（ADHD 余弦相似度 0.64 vs 0.57）均显著优于 Micapipe 基线。局限：预训练仅用 UKB（存在语言/年龄/协议偏置），神经动力学仅建模波模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主导的脑功能网络构建方法（Micapipe、CATO 等）依赖"预定义图谱 + 线性假设"：图谱来自离体标本与群体平均（如 Desikan-Killiany、Schaefer、Von Economo、Koskinas），相关性估计仅用 Pearson/偏相关等线性度量。而脑活动本质上是在解剖空间约束下的神经动力学过程，功能单元具有任务态、被试态依赖性，导致在年龄组、脑疾病类型、种族/语言差异、图像采集策略等异质场景下，神经活动的空间分布模式与相关模式均发生显著变化。固定图谱无法自适应捕捉功能边界差异（如关联皮层跨年龄组分布不同），线性估计也无法刻画相关模式的非线性变化，因而所构建网络的一致性与泛化性受限。这构成了本文的核心动机：需要能刻画"个性化神经活动模式"的框架来指导脑区划分与相关性估计。

Method: **整体架构**："预训练—微调"范式，三模块串联：个性化表征提取 → 自适应脑区划分 → 相关性估计。

**1. 基础模型（预训练）**：以潜空间扩散模型为核心，含 fMRI 编码器 E、解码器 D、潜空间扩散网络 ε_θ 与皮层解码器 D1。三阶段预训练（均基于 UK Biobank）：① 自编码式信号重建（L_Stage1，最小化 ‖B−D(E(B))‖²）；② 冻结 E，在潜空间做前向加噪/反向去噪的噪声预测训练（L_Stage2）；③ 冻结 E/D/扩散模型，取中间层特征 Z_pattern 为个性化表征，训练 D1 将其还原到皮层空间（L_Stage3）。

**2. 神经动力学驱动的微调**：以 fs_LR 32k 皮层网格几何本征模态展开神经活动 φ(r,t)=Σ a_k(t)ψ_k(r)，代入阻尼波模型（(1/γ_s²)∂²/∂t²+(2/γ_s)∂/∂t+1−r_s²∇²）φ=Q，其中 Q 为白噪声外部驱动，γ_s 为时间阻尼、r_s 为空间相关长度；求解受该约束的最小二乘优化问题得到动力学神经活动模式 Φ_dyn(r,t)，并以物理一致性损失 L_phy=E‖D1(Z_pattern)−Φ_dyn‖_F² 联合微调，使表征内嵌 fMRI 数据本身无法提供的动态信息。

**3. 自适应脑区划分**：在皮层网格 G=(V,E) 上将划分表述为 MRF 的 MAP 估计，最小化 Gibbs 能量 E(L)=Σ E_unary(l_v)+λΣ E_pairwise(l_u,l_v)；一元项用对偶 vMF 分布刻画功能一致性+空间聚集，成对项用梯度加权 Potts 模型保边界；初始化由 D1 将表征映射回皮层后做基于特征相似度的自监督聚类，随后交替进行参数重估计与 Graph Cuts 标签优化。

**4. 相关性估计**：按划分结果将体素时间序列平均得 ROI 活动矩阵 H∈R^{K×T}，用 Transformer 自注意力建模 ROI 间活动关联；再以个性化表征作为 key/value、ROI 特征作为 query 做交叉注意力，实现"动态检索并融合个性化先验"，最终对 H_cross 各元素计算相关系数得到个性化脑功能网络。

**5. 联合微调**：L_total = L_task（CE/MSE 下游任务）+ λ1·L_seg（把 Gibbs 能量转为分割损失）。

**评估方法**：一致性用 Portrait Divergence（网络肖像矩阵 + Jensen-Shannon 散度，值域 [0,1]，1 表示完全重叠）；虚拟神经调制流程为：训练神经活动拟合模型 x_t=F_θ(x_{t−3..t−1})+ε → SHAP 选出最优靶点 S_target → 对靶点施加高斯扰动 Δ·e_i → "Virtual Doctors" 分类器判断是否恢复。

**数据与预处理**：18 个数据集、1008 名受试者，覆盖儿童/青少年/老年三种年龄组、AD/ADHD/PD/MDD/ASD 五种疾病、多种采集协议（HCP 长扫描、GSP 短扫描、ADNI、ABIDE I/II、PPMI、TaoWu、NEUROCON、ADHD200/ADHD-RISA/UCLA-CNP、CRF、RFDP/BAML/SRAA-MDD/RfsDP、ISTMDCR-S1、HKMI-fMRI）；用 DeepPrep + Nextflow 完成解剖分割、皮层重建配准、去噪与 fs_LR 32k 重采样；开源 Python 工具已发布。

Result: 1. **一致性**：个性化网络在年龄组、采集策略、疾病类型三个维度上 1−PDiv 中位数为 0.65–0.8，显著高于 Micapipe 基线（0.55–0.65）；表征间相似度与网络一致性线性回归系数 0.49，说明提升源于个性化表征这一中间机制；t-SNE 显示 ASD/AD/ADHD/MDD 仍各自分离、组内紧密，即一致性提升未牺牲判别信息。

2. **诊断与预测**：AD/PD/MDD/ADHD/ASD 五种疾病诊断中位准确率 0.73–0.90（基线多低于 0.73），敏感度/精确率/F1 同步更高；年龄预测平均 R²≈0.90（基线 0.72），BMI 预测 R² 亦显著更高；运动想象解码中位准确率>0.80（基线<0.75）；个体识别准确率显著领先。

3. **虚拟神经调制**：SHAP 定位的靶点更贴合临床经验——PD（TaoWu）中高贡献区为躯体运动网络（SMN），与 rTMS/tDCS/tACS 实证一致，而基线偏向背侧注意网络与默认模式网络（缺乏直接证据）；9 个数据集上恢复率中位数在 PD/ASD/MDD 分别比基线提升 8%、6.3%、2%，NEUROCON 从 11% 提升至 26%；MDD 虚拟调制后与健康态网络的相关系数提升 0.29，说明病理性活动被向健康模式拉回。

4. **异常神经环路**：跨采集策略（分辨率 3.8/3/2.5mm，TR 2–3s）一致性的余弦相似度显著更高——ADNI2/ADNI4/BrainLat 分别提升 0.04/0.07/0.16，三套 AD 数据集之间的相似度比基线高 0.07；ADHD 三数据集相似度中位数 0.64 vs 0.57；Top-5 加权连接拓扑图与复杂网络指标（特征路径长度、聚类系数、全局效率）随阈值变化趋势高度一致。

**批判性观察**：优点是首个把"神经动力学约束 + 大规模预训练 + 个性化自适应划分"引入功能网络构建的端到端范式，覆盖异质场景广、评估维度多（一致性—任务—机制—调制—可复现工具）。不足：① 联合微调使用下游任务标签（L_task），在诊断/解码实验中可能存在任务信息泄漏，需交叉验证说明；② 缺乏与 Infomap/谱聚类等无监督划分及其他基础模型变体的直接对照，改进归因于"个性化表征"尚缺乏消融（如去掉波模型约束、去掉交叉注意力）；③ 扩散基础模型 + Transformer 的计算开销与 Micapipe 的轻量线性方案不具可比性，实用性需进一步验证；④ PDiv 受节点数 K 与划分粒度影响，跨方法比较的公平性依赖超参一致性；⑤ 虚拟调制与"恢复率"依赖模拟器与代理分类器，属间接证据。

Conclusion: 论文提出了"神经动力学信息驱动的预训练框架"，通过在潜空间扩散基础模型上注入皮层波动力学约束获取个性化神经活动模式表征，并以此自适应地完成脑区划分与非线性的相关性估计，从而在异质场景下构建个性化脑功能网络。18 个数据集上的一致性、诊断/预测、个体识别、运动想象解码、虚拟神经调制靶点定位与异常环路跨协议一致性实验均表明其显著优于基于预定义图谱与线性假设的基线方法，挑战了主流构建范式并建立了"个性化脑功能网络"的新范式，同时开源了 Python 工具。作者指出主要局限是预训练数据单一（仅 UKB，存在 40–69 岁、英语母语、单一协议偏置）与仅采用波模型一种神经动力学模型（未涵盖神经质量模型、血流动力学模型等多视角动力学）。未来将构建"基础模型—场景化适配—个体化增强"三阶段范式：整合覆盖全年龄、多协议、多族群、多疾病与多任务的超大规模影像数据训练基础模型并注入多视角神经科学先验，引入场景特异性数据与轻量适配器，再基于个体数据解耦被试特异性活动模式，以推动脑疾病的精准诊断与治疗。

Abstract: Brain activity is intrinsically a neural dynamic process constrained by anatomical space. This leads to significant variations in spatial distribution patterns and correlation patterns of neural activity across variable and heterogeneous scenarios. However, dominant brain functional network construction methods, which relies on pre-defined brain atlases and linear assumptions, fails to precisely capture varying neural activity patterns in heterogeneous scenarios. This limits the consistency and generalizability of the brain functional networks constructed by dominant methods. Here, a neural dynamics-informed pre-trained framework is proposed for personalized brain functional network construction. The proposed framework extracts personalized representations of neural activity patterns in heterogeneous scenarios. Personalized brain functional networks are obtained by utilizing these representations to guide brain parcellation and neural activity correlation estimation. Systematic evaluations were employed on 18 datasets across tasks, such as virtual neural modulation and abnormal neural circuit identification. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework attains superior performance in heterogeneous scenarios. Overall, the proposed framework challenges the dominant brain functional network construction method.

</details>


### [239] [Generative prediction of laser-induced rocket ignition with dynamic latent space representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07525)
*Tony Zahtila,Ettore Saetta,Murray Cutforth,Davy Brouzet,Diego Rossinelli,Gianluca Iaccarino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"动力学自编码器"(DnAE)框架——卷积自编码器(cAE)做空间降维 + 参数化神经微分方程(neural ODE)做隐空间时间演化——用以对激光点火火箭燃烧室的LES时空演化做快速代理建模。该框架在保持物理可解释的时空场预测输出的同时，把单次点火试验的计算成本降低数个数量级，并支持10^6量级蒙特卡洛采样以绘制收敛的点火概率等高线与决策边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激光点火火箭发动机涉及湍流燃料-氧化剂混合、激光能量沉积与高速火焰增长，其尺度解析模拟（LES）极其耗时，而设计空间（激光工况、靶点位置）又十分庞大；同时点火是伯努利型二分类问题，直接用蒙特卡洛估计点火概率收敛极慢（N=100时p=0.5的Wilson区间约为[0.40,0.60]）。此外任务要求输出时序分辨的动态场而非单一标量标签，标准监督分类方法不适用。因此需要一个既能参数化映射输入不确定性、又能保留时空动力学、支持快速不确定性量化的向量到向量代理模型。

Method: 1) 数据与表示：基于实验校准的"定制"LES集合（网格更粗、简化化学、用EnKF对齐高保真激光核与共流射流湍流量），共300次点火试验、每次20个沉积后快照；15维不确定性参数ξ0–ξ14（激光特征、湍流时滞、燃料量、燃烧模型形式、Smagorinsky常数、进气流量、几何）。将3D场以正交投影体积辐射源项的"计算红外(IR)"成像降为2D场（相比Schlieren路径积分更利于聚焦激光核演化），场尺寸592×240，min–max归一化。2) 空间压缩：确定性cAE，三组带残差与池化的卷积块提取多尺度特征，全连接层压缩至8维隐向量，镜像解码器重建；损失为重建L2加权重L2正则（β=1e-6）。3) 时间演化：参数化神经ODE，dV/dt=f(ξ,t,V;θ)，MLP含两个宽度w的隐藏层与tanh激活，固定步长RK4积分；损失含隐空间轨迹误差与隐速度二阶有限差分的曲率惩罚（λ=1e-2）。4) 训练：AE与NODE分开训练；NODE采用课程学习，按时间窗口长度递进扩展预测时域（损失低于ε=1e-4即T→T+ΔT，50折），Adam，学习率1e-3并在10万/15万次迭代降阶。5) 生成与分类：用RBF插值由ξ生成初始隐状态，NODE积分后解码为时空场，以T=1000K等温线围合面积A_T(t)单调增长判定点火成功；大规模采样中改用V5分岔作为分类器。

Result: 隐空间轨迹呈现早期聚集（t<200μs，主要受baroclinic torque/激光参数支配）、中期剪切层相互作用、t≳250μs分岔为点火成功（振荡、火焰增长）与失败（核耗散）的双稳结构，V5分量对成败分离最清晰，V5–V2平面可见清晰的点火演化路径。NODE在训练集能复现隐空间全部多样性；验证集隐空间误差在前两时段小、后两时段显著增大（Fréchet距离0.075→0.289，L2范数0.021→0.080），反映混沌吸引子上的发散。点火分类：训练集近乎完美（精确率0.99、召回率1.00，仅1例错误）；验证集总体准确率80%，精确率与召回率均为0.70且无系统性偏置；重构序列在火焰增长与点火起始时刻上吻合，起始时刻误差约Δt≈25μs，但小尺度结构被平滑。生成10^6次试验可给出收敛的(β,E)与(β,l_axial)联合点火概率分布，并给出Pr(ign)=0.5/0.75/0.9决策边界：更高激光能量、更长轴向沉积长度与更大的沉积瓣不对称性组合显著提高点火成功率。代价：AE在单张Tesla P100上训练24h，NODE在CPU上48h。

Conclusion: DnAE把代理建模从"稳态场/简单谱问题"推进到含湍流、反应与分岔的多物理复杂工程问题，实现了从稀疏CFD样本到收敛的点火概率景观与激光设计阈值/推荐工况的转变，是通向准实时数字孪生的重要一步。局限：时空分离使空间相互作用在低维隐空间中被隐式化为非局部，削弱因果性；隐空间不绑定守恒量，难以强制守恒律（需PINODE类方法且需显式方程）；课程学习的分段扩展不能保证已学段精度不衰减；后期发散需数据同化（EnKF）补救，但与点火时间尺度不相容。

Abstract: Accurate and predictive scale-resolving simulations of laser-ignited rocket engines are highly time-consuming because the problem includes turbulent fuel-oxidizer mixing dynamics, laser-induced energy deposition, and high-speed flame growth. This is conflated with the large design space primarily corresponding to the laser operating conditions and target location. To enable rapid exploration and uncertainty quantification, we propose a data-driven surrogate modeling approach that combines convolutional autoencoders (cAEs) with neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs). The present target application of an ML-based surrogate model to leading-edge multi-physics turbulence simulation is part of a paradigm shift in the deployment of surrogate models towards increasing real-world complexity. Sequentially, the cAE spatially compresses high-dimensional flow fields into a low-dimensional latent space, wherein the system's temporal dynamics are learned via neural ODEs. Once trained, the model generates fast spatiotemporal predictions from initial conditions and specified operating inputs. By learning a surrogate to replace the entirety of the time-evolving simulation, the cost of predicting an ignition trial is reduced by several orders of magnitude, allowing efficient exploration of the input parameter space. Further, as the current framework yields a spatiotemporal field prediction, appraisal of the model output's physical grounding is more tractable. This approach marks a significant step toward real-time digital twins for laser-ignited rocket combustors and represents surrogate modeling in a complex system context.

</details>


### [240] [Obliviator Reveals the Cost of Nonlinear Guardedness in Concept Erasure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07529)
*Ramin Akbari,Milad Afshari,Vishnu Naresh Boddeti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Obliviator是一种后验概念擦除方法，通过迭代核组合优化捕捉非线性统计依赖，在保护表示免受非线性对抗因素攻击的同时保持效用，其性能优于现有基线方法，并展现出良好的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法无法完全捕捉学习表示与不需要属性之间复杂的非线性统计依赖关系，导致其对非线性对抗因素仍然脆弱；同时，擦除过程中效用与擦除之间的权衡动态尚未被研究。

Method: 提出Obliviator，一种后验概念擦除方法，从函数视角形式化擦除问题，形成包含核组合的优化问题，采用迭代渐进式特征空间变形策略来实现更保持效用的擦除。

Result: Obliviator能够保护表示免受非线性对抗因素的攻击，其效用-擦除权衡曲线优于基线方法；并且在更具解耦能力的模型学习的表示上应用时，擦除效果更加保持效用。

Conclusion: Obliviator通过迭代核组合方法成功实现了对非线性对抗因素的概念擦除保护，在效用-擦除权衡曲线上优于基线方法，并展现出更强的泛化能力——当应用于更具解耦能力的模型学习的表示时，擦除效果更加保持效用。

Abstract: Concept erasure aims to remove unwanted attributes, such as social or demographic factors, from learned representations, while preserving their task-relevant utility. While the goal of concept erasure is protection against all adversaries, existing methods remain vulnerable to nonlinear ones. This vulnerability arises from their failure to fully capture the complex, nonlinear statistical dependencies between learned representations and unwanted attributes. Moreover, although the existence of a trade-off between utility and erasure is expected, its progression during the erasure process, i.e., the cost of erasure, remains unstudied. In this work, we introduce Obliviator, a post-hoc erasure method designed to fully capture nonlinear statistical dependencies. We formulate erasure from a functional perspective, leading to an optimization problem involving a composition of kernels that lacks a closed-form solution. Instead of solving this problem in a single shot, we adopt an iterative approach that gradually morphs the feature space to achieve a more utility-preserving erasure. Unlike prior methods, Obliviator guards unwanted attribute against nonlinear adversaries. Our gradual approach quantifies the cost of nonlinear guardedness and reveals the dynamics between attribute protection and utility-preservation over the course of erasure. The utility-erasure trade-off curves obtained by Obliviator outperform the baselines and demonstrate its strong generalizability: its erasure becomes more utility-preserving when applied to the better-disentangled representations learned by more capable models.

</details>


### [241] [ECG Classification on PTB-XL: A Data-Centric Approach with Simplified CNN-VAE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07558)
*Naqcho Ali Mehdi,Amir Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"以数据为中心"的简化 CNN-VAE 模型用于 PTB-XL 心电图多标签五分类（CD/HYP/MI/NORM/STTC）。通过按导联独立 z-score 归一化、有针对性的类别平衡（过采样 HYP、下采样 NORM、类别权重）以及轻量级卷积+变分编码器架构，仅用 197,093 参数即达到 87.01% 二值准确率与 0.745 加权 F1，模型仅 770 KB、推理约 10 ms/样本，适合移动端与低资源场景部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ECG 深度学习研究多聚焦架构复杂度（Transformer、LSTM、集成、ResNet 等，动辄数百万参数），计算代价高、难以在临床受限设备上部署，且普遍忽视数据预处理与类别不平衡这两个真正决定性能的关键因素。PTB-XL 数据集存在严重类别不平衡（NORM 8,564 例 vs HYP 2,392 例），HYP 等少数类检测困难。作者受数据-centric AI 理念（Hancock 等）启发，主张把精力投入数据准备（预处理、平衡策略）而非架构新颖性，以实现高精度、可解释、可复现且轻量的临床 ECG 分类流水线。

Method: 数据集为 PTB-XL 100 Hz 版本（21,837 条 12 导联记录，18,885 名患者，1,000 采样点/10 秒），使用官方 strat_fold 划分：Fold 1–9 为训练集（平衡前 19,631 例），Fold 10 为测试集（2,203 例），另划 20% 验证集（4,413 例）。平衡策略：设定目标样本数，HYP 过采样至 4,000（+67.2%）、NORM 下采样至 4,000（−53.3%），CD/MI/STTC 保持原量，平衡后训练集 22,069 例；样本权重按 w_j = n_total/(n_classes×n_j) 计算，并额外给 HYP 施加 1.5× 权重（最终 0.9716）。预处理对每条导联按训练集统计量独立做 z-score 归一化（ε=1e−8），因各导联幅度与基线不同。模型为简化 CNN-VAE 编码器：Conv1D(64,k=5)+BN+MaxPool(2)+Dropout(0.2) → Conv1D(128,k=5)+BN+MaxPool+Dropout(0.2) → Conv1D(256,k=3)+BN+MaxPool+Dropout(0.3) → GlobalAveragePooling1D 得 256 维特征；潜空间用 Dense(32) 的 z_mean 与 z_log_var，直接取 z_mean 作为潜表示以避免 Lambda 层破坏序列化；两层全连接 Dense(256)+Dense(128)（ReLU+BN+Dropout 0.5），输出 Dense(5, sigmoid) 实现多标签。损失为二元交叉熵，评估用二值准确率、宏/加权精确率召回率、多标签 AUC-ROC。优化器 Adam，lr=0.001，batch 64，最多 50 epoch（实际训练 69 epoch 后早停），回调含 EarlyStopping(patience=10, monitor val_loss)、ReduceLROnPlateau(factor 0.5, patience 5, min_lr 1e−7)、ModelCheckpoint。

Result: 整体测试集：损失 0.4219，二值准确率 87.01%，加权精确率 0.7354、加权召回率 0.7640、加权 F1 0.745，AUC 0.8958，Hamming Loss 0.1299，子集准确率 0.5874。分类别：NORM 表现最佳（F1 0.849，召回 0.910，TP 877/TN 1014）；STTC F1 0.735（召回 0.780）；CD F1 0.713（召回 0.699）；MI F1 0.703（召回 0.678）；HYP 最差，F1 仅 0.537、召回 0.502，263 例中漏检 131 例，是主要短板。训练曲线显示 69 epoch 稳定收敛，训练损失单调下降，验证损失约在 40–50 epoch 进入平台，ReduceLROnPlateau 触发 2–3 次学习率衰减。与相关工作比较：ResNet-50 基线 82.3% 准确率，本文 87.0%、参数比基线少约 60%，与现代方法（82–88% 准确率、0.70–0.78 F1）相当。模型大小 769.89 KB，推理约 10 ms/样本，可序列化部署。

Conclusion: 系统的数据预处理与类别平衡配合轻量 CNN-VAE 架构，能在 PTB-XL 多标签 ECG 分类上以约 197k 参数取得与复杂深度模型竞争的性能，验证了"以数据为中心"的机器学习范式优于盲目堆叠架构复杂度。局限与挑战：HYP 召回仅 50%，受疾病征象细微、特征交叠、过采样伪影与标注不确定性影响；仅在 PTB-XL 上验证，跨库泛化未测；未做集成与交叉验证；潜表示缺乏可视化与可解释性分析；1D 卷积感受野局部，难以捕捉长程时序模式。后续方向包括 SMOTE/高级重采样、focal loss、领域知识特征（QRS 电压、波形模式）、注意力与显著图、潜空间 t-SNE、SHAP/LIME 可解释性、在 CPSC2018/Georgia 等数据集上评估域偏移，以及引入循环层/注意力机制与 ECG+临床数据多模态融合；临床落地仍需前瞻性验证、与心内科医师对比及稳健性测试以满足 FDA/CE 要求。

Abstract: Automated electrocardiogram (ECG) classification is essential for early detection of cardiovascular diseases. While recent approaches have increasingly relied on deep neural networks with complex architectures, we demonstrate that careful data preprocessing, class balancing, and a simplified convolutional neural network combined with a variational autoencoder (CNN-VAE) architecture can achieve competitive performance with significantly reduced model complexity. Using the publicly available PTB XL dataset, we achieve 87.01% binary accuracy and 0.7454 weighted F1-score across five diagnostic classes (CD, HYP, MI, NORM, STTC) with only 197,093 trainable parameters. Our work emphasises the importance of data-centric machine learning practices over architectural complexity, demonstrating that systematic preprocessing and balanced training strategies are critical for medical signal classification. We identify challenges in minority class detection (particularly hypertrophy) and provide insights for future improvements in handling imbalanced ECG datasets.
  Index Terms: ECG classification, convolutional neural networks, class balancing, data preprocessing, variational autoencoders, PTB-XL dataset

</details>
